title: Account Director
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Responsibilities:

  • Verwalten und Überwachen von Projekten vom Start bis zum Abschluss mit Fokus auf Timing, Budget und Qualität.
  • Erstellen und Überwachen von Budgets, Forecasts und Ressourcenplänen.
  • Kundeninteraktion pflegen, um deren Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und das Projektmanagement entsprechend anzupassen.
  • Arbeiten in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams, um unterschiedliche Perspektiven zu integrieren.
  • Entwicklung und Implementierung klarer Abläufe, um transparente und verlässliche Kommunikation sicherzustellen.
  • Status quo hinterfragen und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.
  • Offenheit für KI und neue Technologien zeigen, um innovative Tools und Arbeitsweisen zu erkunden.

Qualifications:

  • Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in der Begleitung von vielseitigen Projekten.
  • Fähigkeit zur sicheren Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Affinität für Zahlen sowie Budget- und Ressourcenmanagement.
  • Freude an der Arbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.
  • Bereitschaft, in einem der Standorte Berlin oder Düsseldorf in Vollzeit zu arbeiten.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Account Director - Financiers
descriptionHtml:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers. We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs. We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Purpose of the role

The successful candidate will own Keyloop's relationships with financiers, both captive (OEM-owned) and independent, while maximising client adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub through a customer retention lens and growing the use of Keyloop's AI-based capabilities within the Retention space. The role is UK-based with a global account book and regular international travel, reporting directly into the Financiers & Fleet Director. The candidate will understand the commercial dynamics of automotive finance and be equally comfortable operating at operational and senior commercial/strategic levels within each financier.


Key Headlines
  • First point of contact for existing and new financier accounts, spanning captive and independent financiers.
  • Own the senior relationship with financiers and grow the Keyloop Retention Hub agenda across their organisations and, where relevant, their dealer networks.
  • Drive adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub with a specific focus on customer retention outcomes.
  • Lead cross-sell of AI-based capabilities within the Retention space (such as AI video and lead nurture), and identify new client opportunities across the wider Keyloop portfolio.
  • UK-based role with regular international travel; account book is global.
  • Monthly face-to-face team meetings in the UK.

    • Key Duties & Responsibilities
  • Deliver excellent account management across captive and independent financier stakeholders.
  • Maintain weekly dialogue with clients on Keyloop Retention Hub adoption and customer retention outcomes.
  • Build and maintain multi-level relationships within financier organisations (commercial, risk, retention/customer, operations and IT), from operational teams through to senior leadership.
  • Develop and apply a thorough understanding of financier commercial models, the customer ownership lifecycle (including PCP/PCH and trade cycle management) and retention dynamics, and how these intersect with dealer network operations.
  • Support contract renewals and commercial negotiations alongside Legal and the Enterprise Team, including liaison with financier procurement and legal teams.
  • Position the Keyloop Retention Hub and its AI-based capabilities as drivers of customer retention and commercial value in client conversations.
  • Produce Quarterly Review Packs covering retention outcomes, adoption of the Retention Hub and AI-based capabilities, and system development delivered.
  • Collaborate with key financier contacts to understand their short, medium and long-term retention strategies, ensuring Keyloop is the partner of choice.
  • Keep product/sales presentation material and POS assets current and available on shared portals.
  • Feed back market intelligence on competitor retention and AI-based offerings to sharpen internal positioning.

    • Skillset and Experience required
  • Experience within the automotive sector, ideally within automotive finance (captive or independent financier).
  • Direct experience working with captive or independent financiers — understanding of their commercial models, customer lifecycle and retention priorities, and relationships with dealer networks. Financier-side experience is strongly favourable.
  • Thorough understanding of the automotive finance customer lifecycle, including origination, contract management, end-of-contract customer journey, and retention and trade cycle management.
  • Experience selling SaaS/cloud-based solutions.
  • Proven track record in account management, ideally managing senior corporate stakeholders within financiers.
  • User or provider experience with customer retention solutions, ideally within automotive finance.
  • Customer- and outcomes-focused, with the maturity and diplomacy to manage engagement across financier stakeholder levels — from operational through to senior commercial/strategic.
  • Able to implement a professional, structured sales approach using MEDDPIC (Keyloop's preferred sales methodology) — covering Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain and Champion — alongside use of Salesforce.
  • Self-driven, ambitious, resilient, highly motivated, competitive, resourceful, excellent communication skills, especially around listening, questioning – politely assertive.
  • Fluency in English is required, and proficiency in another European language — such as French, Spanish, Italian, or German — is preferred.
  • Highly organised within a process-oriented environment. Computer literate and familiarity with SF.com an advantage.
  • Fluency with AI tools such as Claude and Copilot is a plus but not mandatory.
    • Why join us? We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way. An inclusive environment to thrive We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day. Be rewarded for your efforts We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration. Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials. We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. "At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

title: Account Executive (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Wemolo entwickelt die digitale Infrastruktur für die nächste Generation von Parkraum und Immobilien. Mit mehr als 4.000 bewirtschafteten Parkflächen in Europa sind wir bereits international aktiv – und wachsen weiter.

Als Account Executive (all genders) bist du ein zentraler Treiber unseres Wachstums. Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, baust Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf und verantwortest deine Opportunities vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kunden und bestehende Partnerschaften gleichermaßen weiter.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielen und Deals nicht nur begleiten, sondern selbst gewinnen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Die Position ist hybrid mit drei festen Office-Tagen pro Woche an unserem Standort in München-Thalkirchen.

What to expect

  • Build your pipeline: Du identifizierst relevante Accounts und Entscheider, priorisierst deine Targets und baust systematisch eine hochwertige Pipeline auf. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kontakte zu konkreten Opportunities.

  • Understand & qualify: Du führst Discovery-Gespräche, stellst die richtigen Fragen und verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden. So erkennst du, wo Wemolo echten Mehrwert schaffen kann, und entwickelst relevante Business Cases.

  • Own the sales cycle (360° Sales): Du verantwortest deine Deals vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Closing. Du hältst überzeugende Präsentationen, koordinierst relevante Stakeholder und sorgst dafür, dass Opportunities konsequent vorankommen.

  • Negotiate & close: Du führst Verhandlungen auf unterschiedlichen Management-Ebenen, gehst souverän mit Einwänden um und bringst Deals erfolgreich zum Abschluss.

  • Grow your accounts: Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und identifizierst weiteres Potenzial in bestehenden Accounts. Dein Ziel sind nicht nur gewonnene Deals, sondern nachhaltige Partnerschaften.

  • Own your performance: Du kennst deine Pipeline und KPIs, analysierst deine Ergebnisse und entwickelst deinen Sales Approach kontinuierlich weiter.

Inspire us by

  • Sales Experience: Du bringst mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Sales mit und hast bereits eigenständig Kunden gewonnen und Deals abgeschlossen. Erfahrung mit Small und Medium Accounts ist ein Plus.

  • Ambition & Drive: Du setzt dir hohe Ziele, willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse erzielen und bleibst auch dann dran, wenn es herausfordernd wird.

  • Communication: Du trittst selbstbewusst auf, kannst Menschen für dich gewinnen und kommunizierst souverän mit Entscheidern auf unterschiedlichen Management-Ebenen.

  • Commercial Mindset: Du verstehst Geschäftsmodelle und Kundenbedürfnisse und kannst daraus relevante Sales Opportunities entwickeln. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert und datenbasiert.

  • Growth Mindset: Du willst kontinuierlich besser werden, suchst aktiv Feedback und setzt Learnings direkt in bessere Ergebnisse um.

  • Languages: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und sprichst fließend Englisch.

  • Mobility: Du hast einen gültigen Führerschein der Klasse B und bist bereit, regelmäßig innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen (ca. 10–20 %).

What we offer

  • Earn & grow: Attraktives OTE-Modell aus Fixgehalt und ungedeckeltem Bonus – starke Performance soll sich für dich lohnen.

  • Learn fast: Strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching, Shadowing und direktes Feedback helfen dir, deine Sales Skills schnell weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Own your numbers: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und KPIs und hast gleichzeitig den Freiraum, deinen eigenen Sales Style zu entwickeln.

  • Work smarter with AI: KI ist Teil deines täglichen Workflows – für effizienteren Research, bessere Insights und schnellere Vorbereitung.

  • Flexibility & Mobility: Drei feste Office-Tage in München-Thalkirchen, flexibles Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie Bike-Leasing oder Fahrtkostenzuschuss.

  • Team & Culture: Eine ambitionierte Teamkultur, kurze Wege und gemeinsame Erfolge bei Teamevents und OKR-Partys.

  • Health & Balance: EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club mit Zugang zu 1.000+ Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen.

  • Best-in-class setup: Mac oder Windows, ergonomisches Equipment und alles, was du für effizientes Arbeiten im Office und Homeoffice brauchst.

  • Come as you are: Kein Dresscode – uns interessiert, was du bewegst, nicht was du trägst.

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. Deshalb schaffen wir eine Kultur des Miteinanders und des Respekts, in der jedes Teammitglied ein Mitspracherecht hat, sich persönlich weiterentwickeln kann und wertgeschätzt fühlt.

Still here?

Bewirb dich am besten über unser Bewerbungsportal - so landet deine Bewerbung direkt bei uns im Team und wir können sie schnell und unkompliziert prüfen.

title: Account Executive DACH - SMB (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Agicap Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France. Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies. We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024. These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world. We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure! Home page Customer Stories Our Values

About the Account Executive - SMB role:

We are growing our team in Düsseldorf! Working closely with the Business Development team, Outbound SDRs, Inbound SDRs and Partnership Managers on a daily basis, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new clients.

As an SMB Account Executive at Agicap, you will drive sales and expand our customer base within the SMB segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients and closing deals in order to achieve your sales targets.


You will be responsible for:
  • Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs.
  • Identifying and targeting SMB companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions.
  • Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings.
  • Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals.
  • Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations.
  • Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.
  • Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement.
  • Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product.
  • Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

    • What we are looking for:
  • Native/Bilingual level of German
  • 2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS.
  • Studies background in a top business or Engineering school.
  • A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets.
  • A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results.
  • Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs.
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity.
  • Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives.
  • A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills.
  • A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow.

    • 7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE:
  • Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round:
  • Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC)
  • Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2)
  • Gigantic market: over 350k companies in DACH alone
  • Unique company culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, European scale-up (>50% revenue outside France)
  • Opportunities for functional and geographical growth
  • Strong financial situation
  • Team of rockstars, friendly and skilled
  • A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast!
  • Competitive package - with uncapped commissions!

    • Our benefits:
    - Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components. - Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy. - Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with occasional trips to our headquarters in France. - Meal & Grocery Allowance: Receive up to €108/month tax-free for lunch or groceries, easily managed via the Hrmony app. - Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service. - Team culture: Join us and be part of a dynamic environment, enjoying global offsites such as our recent annual seminar on a French island, as well as local team events. AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

title: Account Executive - EMEA Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you're meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you're diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara's new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Account Executive - Enterprise (London)
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE
Enterprise at Baseten means the companies with the most to gain from AI and the most complexity in getting there: large digital natives running products at massive scale, and category leaders in software, financial services, healthcare, and beyond. They have the data, the distribution, and the budget. Most are still deciding what to build, what to run themselves, and what it should cost.

That makes this a consultative sale. You'll spend as much time helping a VP of Engineering pressure-test their AI strategy as you will selling against an alternative, mapping use cases, framing build-vs-buy, and giving clear recommendations grounded in what you've seen work at the frontier. Then you'll do the enterprise work: multithreading across a buying committee, navigating security and procurement, and turning a first workload into an eight-figure relationship.

You'll work alongside our founders, forward-deployed engineers, and GTM leadership, in a seat where the playbook is still being written.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own a revenue target end to end, from prospecting and outbounding through closing Tier 1 accounts in your verticals

  • Act as a strategic advisor on AI adoption: identify use cases, shape architecture decisions, and lead with clear, opinionated recommendations

  • Multithread across large organizations, from the engineers running evals to the executives funding the program to security, legal, and procurement

  • Win lighthouse customers that become references for their entire industry

  • Partner with forward-deployed engineering on technical evaluations, POCs, and architecture reviews

  • Feed signal back to product and engineering. What enterprises need next is a roadmap input we don't get anywhere else

REQUIREMENTS

  • 8+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience in technology, ideally infrastructure, API/platform, or developer tooling

  • A track record of closing seven- and eight-figure deals by navigating multi-stakeholder buying committees and long, complex cycles

  • Demonstrated ability to run a consultative sale. You've helped customers define a strategy, not just evaluate a product

  • Strong technical acumen: you can hold your own on model serving, GPU infrastructure, latency, and API architecture

  • Experience selling into large digital natives or regulated industries (financial services, healthcare/life sciences, insurance, government)

  • Excellent communication and comfort with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment

NICE TO HAVE

  • Direct experience selling AI/ML infrastructure, cloud compute, or model deployment platforms

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

  • (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

  • (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

  • Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

title: Account Executive - Figma Weave (London, United Kingdom)
descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re building the next chapter of AI-native craft and creativity - where craft and technology meet. Our unified platform bridges the gap between AI capabilities and human creativity, and lets professional creatives and designers harness the power of the world’s leading AI models without losing precision, expression, or soul. Together, we’re building tools that help people move faster without sacrificing quality, precision, or craft — a platform where AI supports creativity instead of flattening it.

descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

About the Role

Build new client relationships in a defined territory, combining thoughtful account prioritization with the pace and persistence to create opportunities at scale. With a large pool of untapped accounts still to break into, you’ll build your own book of business rather than inherit a fixed set of relationships.

This role is for a hunter who sells with focus. You’ll prioritise accounts, prospect and create opportunities across multiple buying groups, run well-managed pilots, and close a steady flow of deals, with clear ownership of the relationship from first outreach through the early customer relationship. Your results are visible, you’ll help shape a newly tiered sales organisation, and you’ll grow within a clearer individual contributor progression path.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Own a defined territory, prioritise accounts, and win new clients.

  • Prospect and create opportunities across the buying groups within each target account, and build a reliable, repeatable pipeline.

  • Qualify quickly and run well-managed pilot processes from start to close.

  • Communicate 9fin’s value proposition to clients through tailored demos.

  • Negotiate and close new business, including multi-year agreements where it makes sense.

  • Build account plans that map the organisation and identify teams and desks to expand into.

  • Keep clear CRM records and forecast accurately.

  • Partner with Customer Success, Enablement, and Rev Ops so deals move cleanly from pilot to onboarding.

  • Share ideas with senior management to shape Commercial team processes and best practices.

  • Bring client feedback to Product so the platform keeps improving for our users.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 2+ years of relevant Account Executive experience ideally in capital markets and/or Fintech SaaS.

  • Have a hunter mindset and a track record of generating your own pipeline and exceeding targets, ideally in a high-volume sales environment.

  • Have a good knowledge of financial markets and the ability to build strong relationships within the 9fin community.

  • Can plan and prioritise across many opportunities at once, with accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly in writing and in conversation.

  • Build trust across a matrixed commercial organization and partner effectively with Customer Success, Content and Product.

  • Have an existing network in the leveraged finance community (helpful but not required).

  • Thrive in ambitious, fast-moving environments where expectations are high, opportunities are abundant, and no two days look the same.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

 

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das ganze deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten.

title: Account Executive - Strategic
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We’re building a founding team of Strategic Account Executives in London.

Strategic accounts at Baseten are the largest and fastest-growing AI companies in the world. These are the teams defining the future of what AI products and services look like. These accounts can scale rapidly from one token to billions of tokens in a matter of weeks. This role owns these relationships, working directly with founders and engineering leaders on mission-critical and large-scale-AI problems in production—and shaping what we build next.

This is a highly technical sale. You’ll trade opinions on the latest open-source model releases, run fast and nuanced evaluations alongside customer engineering teams, and often pulling in SMEs from applied research to infrastructure engineers to win. You’ll bring tight sales fundamentals and process discipline, while maintaining flexibility and creativity in how you run each cycle.

This role is pioneering what sales looks like at the bleeding-edge of technology sales. This is a front row seat to the most consequential decisions made at the forefront of Artificial Intelligence. There is no faster place to learn and make an immediate impact.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own a focused portfolio of high-growth, strategic AI-native accounts end to end — from technical evaluation and initial workload landing through expansion as inference usage scales.

  • Lead technical evaluations and complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation through close. Bring strong sales fundamentals and process discipline, while staying flexible and creative in how you run each sales cycle.

  • Build trusted relationships with founders and technical leaders, becoming a credible partner on model, infrastructure, and inference decisions.

  • Orchestrate stakeholders across applied research, engineering, and leadership to win technical evaluations and solve customer problems.

  • Bring customer signal back to product, shaping roadmap priorities through the needs and patterns you see in the field.

  • Stay close after close: help customers expand from an initial workload into additional use cases across the organization.

 

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of sales experience in infrastructure, developer tools, data, or another consumption business, with a record of closing complex technical deals.

  • Proven net-new experience selling complex technical products in fast-moving environments.

  • Strong sales fundamentals across discovery, multi-threading, champion-building, and deal momentum.

  • Genuine curiosity for open-source models and the AI infrastructure landscape. You follow model releases and can hold your own with engineers.

  • Highly dynamic: comfortable when a deal goes off-script, able to meet customers where they are, and willing to change your approach without losing rigor.

  • Strong technical project management: you can run a thorough evaluation across multiple workstreams and create clarity and direction for Baseten to win..

  • Proven ability to sell internally, earning engineering time, aligning leadership, and getting cross-functional teams to move

  • Scrappy, low-ego, collaborative operator. You run toward ambiguous problems, create structure where none exists, and earn internal support without relying on rigid swim lanes.

title: AIT Systems Integration Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role

The AIT Systems Integration Engineer owns functional and system-level testing of our spacecraft and the verification tracking for each satellite campaign. Working within the Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) team, you will take the satellite from integrated subsystems to a flight-ready, fully verified vehicle.

You will bridge systems engineering, subsystem teams and the AIT Engineering Functions. You will turn requirements into test procedures, run and lead test campaigns, and make sure every requirement is closed out with traceable evidence before launch.

The role suits someone who knows SmallSat development approaches, is hands-on with Hardware and Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and understands how satellite subsystems behave together.

Responsibilities

Functional and system testing

  • Own the functional and system test programme for the spacecraft, from unit-level acceptance, integration, thought to whole System End-to-End Testing.

  • Write, review and run test specifications and procedures, including basic functional testing, FDIR, end-to-end tests and mission/day-in-the-life simulations.

  • Lead test readiness reviews and test review boards, and sign off test reports.

  • Run tests before, during and after environmental campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMC) to confirm spacecraft health.

  • Diagnose anomalies, raise and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and drive root-cause investigations with subsystem engineers.

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts and telemetry/telecommand (TM/TC) databases used for testing.

Verification tracking

  • Own the verification matrix (VCRM) for the satellite campaign, mapping each requirement to its method: test, analysis, inspection or review of design.

  • Plan the verification approach with Systems Engineering and keep it current through the campaign.

  • Collect and link verification evidence, and report close-out status against milestones.

  • Prepare verification data packages for key reviews (e.g. CDR, TRR, QR, PSR/FAR) and customer acceptance.

GSE and test infrastructure

  • Specify, integrate and validate Electrical GSE, including power supplies, battery simulators, RF test sets, umbilicals and break-out boxes.

  • Maintain the spacecraft checkout software and ground segment interfaces used on the AIT floor.

  • Make sure GSE is calibrated, configuration-controlled and safe for use with flight hardware.

Integration and campaign support

  • Support subsystem and payload integration, including electrical interface checks, harness verification and safe-to-mate procedures.

  • Plan and schedule system test activities within the wider AIT campaign.

  • Support launch campaign activities, including transport, launch site checkout and launch vehicle interface testing.

  • Work to cleanroom, ESD and flight hardware handling standards, and contribute to lessons learned for future missions.

Requirements

  • Degree in Aerospace, Electronic, Electrical or Systems Engineering, Physics, or equivalent experience.

  • Typically 3+ years in spacecraft AIT, systems integration or test engineering.

  • Hands-on experience with functional and system-level testing of satellites or space subsystems.

  • Familiarity with SmallSat development approaches: agile, rapid iteration, protoflight models, and pragmatic use of COTS components.

  • Working knowledge of satellite subsystems: EPS, OBC/C&DH, ADCS, communications (TT&C and payload RF), propulsion, thermal, structures and payloads.

  • Experience using and setting up GSE, including EGSE, checkout systems and RF test equipment.

  • Experience with requirements verification and maintaining a verification matrix through to close-out.

  • Comfortable with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, spectrum analysers, logic analysers.

  • Familiarity with common spacecraft interfaces and protocols (e.g. CAN, I2C, SPI, RS-422, SpaceWire, CCSDS).

  • Clear technical writing for procedures, test reports and NCRs.

Desirables

  • End-to-end involvement in at least one satellite mission that reached launch.

  • Test automation and scripting in Python or similar, and experience with spacecraft control or checkout software (e.g. OpenC3/COSMOS, Yamcs, SCOS-2000).

  • Experience planning or supporting environmental test campaigns (vibration, TVAC, EMC).

  • Knowledge of ECSS standards (e.g. ECSS-E-ST-10-02 Verification, ECSS-E-ST-10-03 Testing) or NASA equivalents.

  • Requirements management tools (e.g. DOORS, Jama, Polarion, Valispace).

  • Launch campaign experience at a launch site.

  • Cleanroom and ESD-certified flight hardware handling.

  • Eligibility for UK security clearance, or the ability to obtain it, if required by the programme.

Personal attributes

  • Takes ownership: drives tests and verification to close-out without waiting to be asked.

  • Methodical and detail-focused, with a strong sense of safety and quality around flight hardware.

  • Calm, structured problem-solver when anomalies appear under schedule pressure.

  • Communicates clearly across disciplines, from subsystem engineers to programme managers and customers.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced SmallSat environment, balancing rigour with pace.

  • Willing to work flexibly during test and launch campaigns, including occasional travel.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
What is Anori Tech doing?

The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work.

As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development.

We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry.

We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years.

Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market.

Our Motivation

At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. We need batteries for this transition and almost all batteries need a BMS. We strive for Shenzhen speed and German engineering quality. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg.

About the Role

A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. Later on, the role grows into the cloud, where data pipelines and fleet analytics will build on the models you create today. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers.

Start date: from January 1, 2027

What You'll Do

  • Develop the algorithms that estimate SoC and SoH for different cell chemistries and applications

  • Design balancing strategies that fit the hardware and use case

  • Build battery models (e.g. equivalent circuit models) and parameterize them from measurement data with statistical rigor

  • Implement your algorithms directly in the embedded Rust firmware, efficient enough for constrained hardware

  • Design experiments and evaluation methodologies: analyze failure modes, quantify trade-offs between accuracy, robustness and compute cost

  • Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud

What You Bring

Must have

  • Hands-on experience with state of charge and state of health estimation, shown in a product, publication or substantial project. For example Kalman-type filters, H∞ filters, observers, or coulomb counting with model-based correction

  • Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models

  • Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed)

  • Strong Python skills for modeling, simulation and data analysis

  • Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with cell balancing algorithms and their effects

  • Working with real cell data from test benches or cyclers

  • Signal processing fundamentals: FIR/IIR filter design, sampling and aliasing, noise characterization of sensor data

Nice to have

  • Data pipelines, fleet analytics or cloud experience

  • Machine learning methods for battery data, for example data-driven state of health estimation or anomaly detection

  • Model-based systems engineering and requirements engineering (the skills, not the paper)

You don't tick every box? Apply anyway. No one matches a job description 100%. If this role excites you and you are motivated to grow yourself into it, we want to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Work on a product with purpose that redefines the state of art: our product is a key part to enable competitive battery energy storage.

  • Work directly with the founding team on decisions that shape the company. The team is small, so your ideas will matter. A lot.

  • Challenging engineering in an industrial, but research-near environment. We bring research into the industry.

  • A modern stack and methods: Rust, MBSE, everything as code, and the best tools and techniques for the job, chosen on merit.

  • To be both supported and challenged: room to grow, and the expectation that you will.

You might be a fit if

  • You hold yourself to a high standard and don’t settle for "good enough."

  • You want to have a big say in what the Anori BMS looks like and how it works

  • You are eager to try out new tools and enjoy incorporating AI into your work to make your life easier and more productive

  • You are excited about startups and all the opportunities and uncertainties that come with it

  • You want to be an active part in accelerating the energy transition in Europe

  • You are comfortable with English as a working language

  • You are happy to be in the office most of the time because for fast decisions we need to be in the same room. We expect you to be in the office at least 3 days / week

You also want to become an Anori? We cannot wait to meet you. Go and click the apply button. Don’t be shy, we are nice.

P.S. Extra bonus if you tell us what your favorite type of tea is.

title: Associate Director, Biostatistics Consultant – Oncology - (Remote in UK- Outside IR35)
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in working directly for a single sponsor while having the security and additional career opportunities that working for a global CRO can bring? Our team says it’s the best of both worlds….

ClinChoice is searching for a Associate Director, Biostatistics Consultant  – Oncology to join one of our clients. 

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Associate Director, Biostatistics with strong expertise in oncology drug development and clinical trial strategy. The individual will provide strategic statistical leadership across development programs and work closely with Clinical Development, Regulatory, Medical, Commercial, and Portfolio teams.

The ideal candidate should have experience in:

  • Selecting Trial Types: decide if a trial should be superiority, non-inferiority, or equivalence-based depending on what regulators and payers need to prove the drug beats a placebo or standard of care.
  • Endpoint Selection: define and validate primary and secondary endpoints (e.g., overall survival, biomarker response rates, quality-of-life scores) to ensure they are measurable, clinically meaningful, and statistically robust.
  • Innovative Designs: statisticians frequently design adaptive trials (e.g., seamless Phase II/III designs, group sequential designs, or biomarker-driven basket/umbrella trials) to save time and patients.
  • Sample Size & Power Calculations
  • Balancing Risk and Resources:  use power calculations to ensure a trial has a high probability of detecting a true clinical effect without enrolling excess patients, which drives up costs and exposes unnecessary individuals to experimental risks.
  • Subgroup Powering: They determine if the study is large enough to analyze specific patient subsets (e.g., biomarker-positive patients or specific age groups).
  • Establishing Go/No-Go Decision Gates
  • Proof-of-Concept Criteria: establish quantitative thresholds for Phase II trials (e.g., "If the hazard ratio is below 0.70 with a p-value , we proceed to Phase III").
  • Futility Stopping Rules: Experience in build rules into trial protocols to stop a failing trial early, preventing sunk costs on a drug that is unlikely to succeed.
  • Regulatory Strategy and Health Authority Negotiations : experience in preparing and reviewing data packages and attending meetings with regulatory bodies (like the FDA or EMA) to defend trial designs, proposed endpoints, and statistical analysis plans (SAPs).
  • Mitigating Regulatory Risk: Experience in anticipating and addressing statistical objections from health authorities regarding missing data handling, multiplicity adjustments (controlling for false positives when looking at multiple endpoints), and bias.

At the macro–Strategic Drug Development level, statisticians should have experience working with commercial and portfolio management teams.

  • Quantifying Uncertainty: Experience in using historical benchmark data and simulation models to estimate the Probability of Technical Success (PoS) for an asset at each development phase.
  • Pipeline Prioritization: Using risk models to help executive leadership in deciding whether to advance, partner, or kill an asset based on its statistical likelihood of clearing regulatory and market hurdles.

Qualifications

  • Master's or Ph.D. in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative discipline.

  • Significant experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO environments with strong oncology experience.

  • Demonstrated experience in strategic drug development and clinical trial design, beyond traditional study-level responsibilities.

  • Strong knowledge of oncology endpoints, adaptive designs, sample size/power, simulations, and statistical methodology.

  • Experience supporting regulatory submissions and health authority interactions.

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence senior cross-functional stakeholders.

The Application Process

Once you have submitted your CV, you will receive an acknowledgement that we received it. If you have the requirements we need, you will be invited for phone interview as the first step.  Unfortunately, due to the number of applications we receive, we cannot reply to everyone individually if you are not successful.

Who will you be working for?

About ClinChoice

ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO specializing in clinical development and functional solutions for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and consumer health companies. We have over 28 years of proven high-quality delivery and results across all our services, with over 4,000 professionals in more than 20 countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.           

Our Company Ethos

Our mission drives our culture: to contribute to a healthier and safer world by accelerating the development and commercialization of innovative drugs and devices. Our employees are the most valuable company asset and they are the fulcrum around which all ClinChoice activities are built and close management and training is the core instrument to develop and maintain highly-qualified personnel. The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology.   The success of these core values is evidenced by our below industry average turnover rates.

ClinChoice is an equal opportunity employer. We have based our success on attracting, developing, and promoting talent guided by diversity and inclusivity. Our employees come from very diverse backgrounds: gender, race, beliefs, and ethnicities. We recognize this is our strength and celebrate it.

descriptionHtml:
The role

As an Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development, you will be a senior member of a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO.

This role balances corporate development / M&A with corporate strategy. You lead projects across both areas as the day-to-day owner and guide a small number of more junior colleagues and internal functional experts. You operate with minimal direction and take projects from a vague problem statement to a CEO-ready recommendation. You also stay hands-on, personally building the models and analysis and preparing the executive-level outputs that drive investment and strategy decisions.

What you’ll do

  • M&A Strategy: Lead M&A projects end to end (owning small and mid-sized transactions independently and partnering with the Director on the largest, transformational deals), from target screening and valuation through due diligence, negotiation preparation, and post-deal integration. Run deal teams day to day, coordinate external advisors and act as the lead with target management teams or their advisors. You are not just a process manager but can form and defend a point of view on whether and why a deal makes strategic sense and present it directly to senior leadership.
  • Portfolio Optimization: Lead the strategic analysis and recommendations for key portfolio decisions, including potential geo-expansions, new vertical or brand launches or divestments.
  • Corporate Strategy: Contribute to the development of the Group's mid-term strategy by driving the process, owning the underlying analysis, strategic synthesis, and preparation of strategic documents.
  • Capital Allocation: Own and develop analytical frameworks and models to support strategic budget allocation and ROI analysis.
  • Business Unit Strategy: Act as a senior internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience: 6+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team. This includes leading projects or deal teams with minimal supervision.

  • DTC economics: You are comfortable working with typical DTC KPIs like CAC, AOR, AOV, CLV, retention and understand how cohort economics build a P&L over time. DTC marketing analytics experience is a plus but not required.
  • Communication: Proactive 360° communication and excellent ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, concise storylines, presentationsand memos for an executive audience. 
  • How you work: You take ownership of outcomes and pressure-test your own conclusions before presenting them. You go deep into the analysis to get to the right answer, and know when it is good enough to decide.

title: Bilanzbuchhalter / Referent Rechnungswesen (m/w/d) in Vollzeit
descriptionHtml:
Wir stellen uns vor!

Die Dr. Bernhard Burger AG ist ein wachsendes Familienunternehmen in zweiter Generation und einer der führenden Partner für Goldschmiede, Juweliere und Edelmetallhändler. Gemeinsam mit unserem Joint Venture Burger & Gyr Edelmetalle Recycling AG am selben Standort in Keltern, zwischen Pforzheim und Karlsruhe, verbinden wir Edelmetallrecycling, Analyse, Abrechnung, Metallkonten, Handel und eigene Fertigung.

Unser Rechnungswesen bildet die Werteflüsse beider Gesellschaften ab: von der Scheidgutabrechnung über Metallkonten bis zu Monats- und Jahresabschluss. In den nächsten zwei Jahren führen wir ein neues, voll integriertes ERP-System auf Odoo-Basis ein. Damit wachsen die Themen, die wir kaufmännisch sauber durchdenken, abstimmen und zu Ende bringen müssen.

Deshalb suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Persönlichkeit mit betriebswirtschaftlichem Überblick, die der kaufmännischen Leitung in Abschlüssen, Steuern, Finanzierung und Projekten spürbar Arbeit abnimmt, in der Buchhaltung selbst mit anpackt und tatkräftig im ERP-Projekt mitarbeitet. Einen Jahresabschluss müssen Sie nicht allein erstellen, aber wesentliche Abschlussarbeiten sicher übernehmen und mit Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern intensiv zusammenarbeiten.

Wir messen Erfolg daran, dass Abschlüsse und Meldungen für beide Gesellschaften termingerecht und nachvollziehbar vorliegen, dass die kaufmännische Leitung bei Koordination und Zuarbeit entlastet wird und dass unsere Prozesse nach der ERP-Einführung einfacher und sicherer laufen als heute.

Die Stelle in Kürze

Sie übernehmen wesentliche Abschlussarbeiten für zwei Gesellschaften, entlasten unsere kaufmännische Leitung bei Steuern, Finanzierung und Analysen und begleiten als Key User die Einführung unseres neuen ERP-Systems auf Odoo-Basis.

Welche Aufgabenfelder erwarten Sie?

Ihr Schwerpunkt ist die Bilanzbuchhaltung. Im ERP-Projekt sind Sie Key User Rechnungswesen/Finanzen: Sie begleiten den Fortschritt, testen, ob alles wie vorgesehen funktioniert, denken und handeln mit und übernehmen bei Bedarf eigene Aufgaben oder Teilprojekte. Die Projektverantwortung bleibt bei unserer kaufmännischen Leitung.

  • Mitwirkung an Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB für zwei Gesellschaften: Abschlussbuchungen, Kontenabstimmungen, Rückstellungen, Anlagenbuchhaltung, Datenaustausch mit Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern
  • Operative Unterstützung der Finanzbuchhaltung, Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen und steuerliche Fragestellungen des Tagesgeschäfts
  • Unterstützung der kaufmännischen Leitung in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Themen: Analysen, Auswertungen, Unterlagen für Vorstand und Banken, Vertrags- und Finanzierungsfragen
  • ERP-Einführung: Anforderungen der Finanzen mitformulieren, Prozesse dokumentieren, Stammdaten abgleichen, Tests durchführen, Key User Finanzen
  • Besonderheiten der Edelmetallbranche kennenlernen und mitgestalten: Metallkonten, Reverse Charge, Metallbilanz, Bestandsbewertung
  • Prozesse im Rechnungswesen weiterentwickeln und automatisieren, dabei selbst anpacken: vom Beleg bis zur Abschlussbuchung, perspektivisch eigene Verantwortungsbereiche und fachliche Koordination im Team

Was zeichnet Sie aus?

  • Betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen oder Abschluss als Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK), Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Rechnungswesen eines mittelständischen Unternehmens oder einer Steuerkanzlei, mit Mitwirkung an Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB
  • Überblick über kaufmännische Zusammenhänge: Sie denken über die einzelne Buchung hinaus und können Themen für Entscheidungen aufbereiten
  • Pragmatische Hands-on-Mentalität: Sie packen operativ mit an, finden praktikable Lösungen statt perfekter Konzepte und bringen Themen zu Ende
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise, klare Priorisierung und offene Kommunikation im Team
  • Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit einem Systemwechsel oder einer ERP-Einführung ist ein Plus, Odoo-Kenntnisse ebenfalls, beides keine Voraussetzung
  • Sensibilität im Umgang mit vertraulichen Informationen

Worauf Sie sich freuen können:

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der kaufmännischen Leitung und ein breites Themenspektrum statt Routine
  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem ERP-Projekt, das das ganze Unternehmen verändert
  • Zwei Gesellschaften, ein Team: kurze Wege zu Vorstand, Technik und Vertrieb
  • Eigene Verantwortungsbereiche im Tagesgeschäft und schrittweise Übernahme von mehr Verantwortung
  • Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK), unterstützen wir fachlich und finanziell
  • Mitarbeiterevents und ein kollegiales Umfeld

title: Brand Management Stage (vanaf januari 2027)
descriptionHtml:
Misschien wel het leukste bedrijf van Nederland is op zoek naar versterking! Dit prachtige familiebedrijf groeit als kool en daarom zijn wij hard op zoek naar marketing talent. Word jij enthousiast van grote brands? Ben je benieuwd hoe deze internationaal worden gepositioneerd en houd jij van design? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Op de Global Marketingafdeling houden we ons o.a. bezig met Brand Management, Product Management, Social Media en Influencer Marketing.

Binnen het brand management team zijn wij op zoek naar een Brand Management stagiair(e). Als Brand Management stagiair(e) draai je gewoon mee met het team. Dit betekent dat je een lekker veelzijdige baan hebt met veel verantwoordelijkheden. Je helpt ons met het ontwikkelen van diverse brand campagnes, van idee tot shoot en van lancering tot evaluatie. Daarnaast bewaak en versterk je de merk identiteit (in meer dan 85 landen!), dit doe je door veel te schakelen met andere afdelingen binnen KEUNE.

Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen.

We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt.

  • Spreekt en schrijft flawless Nederlands en Engels;

  • Stagevergoeding van €650,- per maand;

KEUNE

We zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap centraal staat in alles wat we doen. Ons verhaal begint in 1922, in Amsterdam. Vandaag, 104 jaar later en een koninklijk predicaat rijker, hoort KEUNE bij één van de hardst groeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden KEUNE-producten ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en wereldwijd gedistribueerd naar meer dan 85 landen. En we zijn niet van plan om gas terug te nemen! Ieder jaar openen we een nieuwe eigen vestiging. We produceren op een duurzame en diervriendelijke manier en zijn B Corp-gecertificeerd. Maar bij KEUNE gaat het niet alleen om het creëren van mooie producten - het gaat om ons verhaal en onze visie. KEUNE staat onder leiding van Philip Berlijn, die zich richt op het bouwen van een sterk merk en het creëren van een bedrijfscultuur die draait om samenwerken, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter.

title: Build Your Own Role – m/f/d
descriptionHtml:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

 

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe’s largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

 

About the Role

This is not a regular open application. We don’t want your CV first. We want to see what you have built.

You may build with AI because you can’t stop, whether that’s with Langdock, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or whatever gets the job done. You may also know you’d add real value at Langdock without seeing the right opening on our careers page. If both are true, this is your door.

Show us a project. If it convinces us, we build the role around you.

 

What We Want to See

Record a Loom of something you built with AI. It should be no longer than 5 minutes. Two kinds of projects get our attention:

  • Something that would help Langdock. Look at our product roadmap and at our product, and build something that solves a real problem for us or our customers. That could be a feature prototype, an internal tool, a GTM engine, a support automation, an eval setup, or something we haven’t thought of yet.

  • A genuine passion project. Something you built because you couldn’t stop thinking about it, and that shows how you think.

What we don’t want: basic chatbots, simple prompt wrappers, “summarize my inbox” agents, or linear three-step workflows. Our customers build those every day. Show us something that made you think hard, and that makes us think too.

 

What Your Loom Should Cover

  • The problem: what you solved and why it matters.

  • The demo: show it working live, not on slides.

  • How it’s built: the models, tools, architecture, and key decisions behind it.

  • What broke: where it failed and what you learned from that.

  • What’s next: what you would build at Langdock if you joined.

 

How to Apply

Paste your Loom link into the field “Your Build” in the application form. Your LinkedIn profile is enough; a CV is optional.

 

What Happens Next

We watch every Loom. If your build stands out, we invite you to go deep on your project with us. Together we then define where you would have the most impact. That could be Product, Engineering, GTM, Customer Success, Operations, or a role that doesn’t exist yet.

 

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You build, not just talk about AI. You have shipped things that work, even if they’re rough.

  • You think in impact. You care about whether something solves a real problem for real users, not just whether it is technically clever.

  • You show high agency and full ownership. Nobody needs to tell you what to do next.

  • You experiment constantly. You try new models, tools, and approaches as soon as they come out.

  • You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus.

  • You are kind and care about the people around you.

 

What We Need

  • Availability to work full-time and 100% on-site at our Berlin office.

  • A work permit for Germany.

 

The Environment

You will work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution, and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense.

 

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. We define the level together once the role is clear.

 

Next Steps

We move fast. If you have built something you’re proud of, show us.

 

Compensation: €75K – €140K • Offers Equity
