title: Commercial Manager / Senior Commercial Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge, sovereign generative AI solutions powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centers and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Positioned at the heart of this transformation, Nscale is delivering the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation.

Working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, Nscale integrates next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters across both partner and self-delivered facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a pivotal role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond.

The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Commercial Manager with a strong Quantity Surveying / Construction Cost Management background to manage commercial and contractual aspects of Nscale’s Hyperscale Data Centre projects in the UK & Europe.

Reporting to the Commercial Director, you will be responsible for the commercial management of projects — overseeing procurement, cost control, forecasting, contract administration, and financial reporting from pre-contract through to final account.

This role requires a commercially astute professional with excellent attention to detail and a hands-on approach to project delivery. You will work collaboratively with Development, Design, and Construction teams to ensure that each project is delivered on budget, on time, and in full compliance with contractual and governance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the commercial management of major hyperscale data centre construction projects, ensuring delivery within approved budgets, timelines, and Nscale standards.
  • Drive cost efficiency and value creation, optimising expenditure while maintaining financial discipline, commercial control, and alignment with business and project objectives.
  • Own and manage detailed project budgets and CAPEX models, providing accurate financial data and scenario analysis to support decision-making.
  • Prepare and deliver detailed cost reports, forecasts, and cash flow analyses, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely insight into project financial performance.
  • Conduct budget preparation and benchmarking exercises, including detailed cost modelling and comparative analysis, and review outcomes with senior management.
  • Analyse and present cost reports to senior management, providing commentary, trend analysis, and recommendations to inform executive decision-making.
  • Manage project costs throughout the lifecycle, including cost validation, variations analysis, value engineering, and cost-saving initiatives to enhance overall project value.
  • Oversee financial close-out processes, including reconciliation of budgets, settlement of vendor accounts, and completion of all final commercial documentation.
  • Manage and provide guidance on commercial change management, including change evaluation, negotiation, and approval in line with contractual and governance requirements.
  • Lead commercial risk management activities, identifying and mitigating risks proactively, maintaining live risk registers, and implementing strategies to minimise exposure.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Development, Construction, Finance, and Operations teams, ensuring that commercial objectives are aligned with design, schedule, and operational goals.
  • Stay informed on regional market trends, cost indices, and regulatory developments, applying insights to continuously refine Nscale’s commercial approach and maintain best-in-class delivery standards.

Who You Are

  • 7+ years’ experience in forecasting, cash flow management, cost control, and profitability across complex Construction projects / portfolios, with experience within Data Centres
  • Degree-qualified in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, or a related discipline; MRICS or equivalent professional accreditation advantageous.
  • Proven track record of delivering profitable projects and optimizing commercial performance
  • Able to engage effectively across regions, time zones, and disciplines.
  • Adaptable, proactive, and energised by working in a high-growth, fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Fluency in English required; other European languages a plus.

Why Join Nscale?

  • Be part of a fast-moving, high-growth Necoloud company driving and delivering sustainable, next-generation AI infrastructure.
  • High-performing scale-up culture built on autonomy, accountability, and execution excellence.
  • 25 days holiday + bank holidays (33 days total)
  • Highly competitive compensation including ESOP (equity options)
  • Progression opportunities – we grow, you grow.
  • Hybrid / remote working options with ~ 25% travel to project sites across UK & Europe

For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice: Here.

Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.

title: Compliance Director
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Compliance Officer / MLRO Switzerland & Liechtenstein
descriptionHtml:
Compliance Officer / MLRO - Switzerland & Liechtenstein

 

About Keyrock

 

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 180+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris, New York and Chicago.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

 

Mission statement

We are looking for an experienced and driven Compliance Officer and MLRO for our Switzerland and Liechtenstein based entities. You will join a dynamic and dedicated Group Compliance team, operating as a key member while focusing primarily on our Switzerland and Liechtenstein operational entities. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a wider impact across the organization by working on broader, group-level projects, allowing you to contribute to the global compliance framework and help grow the group as a whole.

 

Job description

 

  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant laws and regulations applicable to Switzerland and Liechtenstein by developing and implementing the policies and procedures ;

  • Conducting compliance risk assessments and elaborating an annual compliance plan;

  • Developing and implementing a plan of second-line controls and conducting the tests;

  • Assessing future business activities to identify potential compliance risks;

  • Ensuring the firm’s policies and procedures are being communicated effectively to all relevant employees;

  • Ensuring the compliance trainings are effective and up to date;

  • Keeping abreast with regulatory changes and maintaining the policies and procedures up to date;

  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Trading Operations, Finance, Risk management, IT & Security, etc… to integrate compliance requirements into business processes.

  • Being responsible for oversight of Keyrock CH and LI compliance with its AML obligations and acting as a focal point for the firm’s AML activity (MLRO).

  • Carrying out the duties of a MLRO as per the AML/CTF Framework

  • Representing Keyrock CH and LI in all matters of money laundering prevention internally and externally;

title: Conversion Manager - Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a Conversion Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • Contentsquare

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

title: Corporate Paralegal
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

Mistral AI's corporate legal team is looking for a Corporate Paralegal to join our growing legal function in Paris. This is a newly created role designed to centralize and streamline the administrative backbone of our corporate legal operations as we scale internationally.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible.

What you'll do

1. Cap Table & Share Register

Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential.

2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation

Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record.

3. Insurance & Document Management

Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity.

4. Procurement Contracts

First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups).

  • Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40).

  • Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates.

  • Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally.

  • Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration.

  • Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH).

  • Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms.

  • Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding.

  • Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

title: Customer Service Team Leader
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Customer Service Team Leader to lead our support team: six people across two desks, handling around 1,500 tickets a week. One desk helps the landowners and asset managers we work with; the other helps the drivers who park at their sites. Many tickets mean investigating across our systems, escalating to TechOps and following up until the problem is fixed.

This is a people-leadership role first. You’ll set the standard, coach the team to hit it, and use the numbers to see what’s working and what isn’t. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, the backing of our COO, and Client Success, TechOps and Product teams to work with on them. And you’ll lead from the front, getting stuck into tickets with the team when it’s busy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of six, with regular one-to-ones and clear standards for quality and output.

  • Set targets for the team, hold people accountable to them, and help everyone get there.

  • Keep response times, resolution and the backlog on track across both desks.

  • Get stuck in on tickets when the queue is busy, and handle the trickier escalations yourself.

  • Use the team’s numbers to spot what drivers and clients keep contacting us about, and work with other teams to fix the cause.

  • Plan the rota, including Saturday cover, around leave and busy periods.

Who we’re looking for

You’ll need:

  • Experience leading a customer service or support team (phone, email, chat or ticket-based) against KPIs.

  • A track record of improving how a team performs.

  • Experience setting clear targets, holding people to them and coaching them to get there.

  • Comfort with numbers: reading a report or dashboard, asking the right questions of it, and turning the answers into improvements.

  • Happy getting into the detail of a problem, across systems and teams, to find out what actually went wrong.

  • Curiosity about how tools, automation and AI could make the team’s work easier.

  • Clear, calm writing, even when a customer isn’t, and confidence on the phone with an unhappy client.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Zendesk or a similar helpdesk tool.

  • Experience in parking, mobility, utilities or another high-volume consumer service.

  • Experience setting up weekend cover.

Don’t be put off if you haven’t built helpdesk reports yourself. What matters is that you’ve set targets, held a team to them, and used the numbers to make things better. We’ll help you with the tools.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home.

  • Room to grow with the business, with training and development support.

  • 20 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Company pension scheme.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office right next to East Croydon Station, with a fully stocked kitchen offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks (and two office dogs!).

  • Laptop and tech provided.

  • Employee Assistance Programme, BrightHR Exchange discounts and regular company events.

The details

Location: Croydon, next to East Croydon Station. Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 from home.

Team: 6 support agents across two desks (Client Service and Driver Support).

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Klue, We’re Building the Future of Competitive Intelligence

The Customer Success team is hiring 👋

You're the person who walks into an account and immediately sees what matters: the risk no one's named yet, the expansion hiding in plain sight, the champion waiting to be developed. You earn trust fast, ask the right questions, and turn a customer's goals into a plan that actually sticks.

If that sounds like you, keep reading. We'd love to meet you.

As a Customer Success Manager at Klue, you own the full customer relationship, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You're the connective tissue: keeping every account team aligned, every customer growing, and every risk on the radar before it becomes a problem. Klue's product moves fast. New AI agents, integrations, and capabilities ship continuously. The CSMs who thrive here stay ahead of it, act on signals early, and show up as both a trusted advisor and a confident commercial partner.

Your Mission? To make sure every customer in your book gets real, measurable value from Klue, and grows because of it. You build the relationships, drive the adoption, and close the commercial outcomes. When your customers win, you win.

What's In It for You?

This role puts you at the center of how B2B companies use competitive intelligence to win deals, grow revenue, and own their markets. You'll work across industries and stakeholder levels, build deep customer intuition, and gain hard-won experience running complex change management inside leading organizations. In an AI-first company shipping continuously, your expertise compounds fast. No two years here look the same.

What You'll Do

  • Own Renewals and Expansions. Your book, your number. You forecast it, manage it, and hit it. That means spotting churn signals before anyone else names them, building the business case for expansion, and running cross-sell motions with Sales, including Klue's win-loss interview program. The commercial outcomes are yours.

  • Drive Adoption and Platform Completeness. Klue ships fast. Your job is to make sure every customer keeps up: AI agents running, integrations live, Curators and Consumers actually using the platform. You stay current on what's new and make it land, translating product velocity into conversations your customers care about.

  • Map Outcomes and Demonstrate ROI. You connect Klue to what your customers actually care about: win rate, rep confidence, PMM efficiency. You quantify it, document it, and make it impossible to argue with at renewal time. ROI isn't a slide you build at the end, it's a story you're telling all year.

  • Multi-Thread and Lead Change. Single-threaded accounts are at-risk accounts. You build across levels by default: economic buyers, Champions, Consumers, exec sponsors. You help customers navigate their own organizations and drive adoption through real friction, not around it.

  • Lead the Account Team. You own the account, which means owning the strategy and everyone working inside it. Win-Loss Researchers, PMAs, Sales, AI Solutions. You set the direction. They execute alongside you.

What Success Looks Like

We want you to love the role you're in and believe these are the things that matter most. You'll know you're nailing it when:

  • GRR and expansion targets are met or exceeded for your book every quarter.

  • All eligible customers have their AI agents running: right competitors tracked, right integrations live, platform usage above benchmarks.

  • Upsell and cross-sell opportunities are identified, qualified, and closed at or above target. Win-loss cross-sell pipeline exists and is actively moving for eligible accounts.

  • Every account has at least one documented ROI moment per quarter, tied to a specific Klue outcome.

  • Every account has at least two active contacts at different levels. No single-threaded accounts in your book.

  • Customers are activated on new product capabilities within one quarter of release.

  • Risk is flagged and acted on early, not discovered at renewal.

What You Bring

Must Haves:

  • The experience. track record in a CSM or commercial role with direct revenue accountability. You've owned renewals and expansion targets and hit them.

  • Ownership. ability to lead and coordinate a cross-functional account team without direct authority.

  • Customer facing. Proven success building trust and credibility across a customer organization, from day-to-day champions to executive buyers.

  • Commercial fluency. comfortable with upsell conversations, business-case development, and navigating contract dynamics with confidence.

  • Strong discovery skills. can diagnose a customer's business goals, connect them to Klue's platform outcomes, and make the link explicit and repeatable.

  • Change management instinct. knows how to build internal Champions, navigate complex stakeholder dynamics, and drive adoption against organizational friction.

  • Multi-threading instinct. you build relationships across levels by default, not as a recovery strategy.

  • Signal awareness and speed. proactively identifies risk and opportunity in customer behavior, usage data, and relationship health, and acts fast.

  • Technical curiosity. comfortable learning integrations and AI capabilities, and explaining them clearly to non-technical audiences.

  • AI-fluency. actively uses AI tools in day-to-day work and can model that behavior with customers.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience in competitive intelligence, product marketing, sales enablement, or B2B SaaS.

  • Familiarity with technical integrations (MCP, CRM, Slack, or similar) and comfort guiding customers through deployment.

  • Knowledge of competitive enablement best practices and how revenue teams operationalize competitive programs.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools beyond basic usage: prompt design, workflow automation, or AI-assisted customer work.

Benefits:

  • Competitive base compensation plus variable

  • Monthly Pension Contribution

  • Extended health & dental benefits that kick in within your first month in seat

  • Opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Option Plan

  • Time off. Take what you need. We want the team to prioritize wellness and avoid burnout. Vacation usually falls into 3 categories: recharging, life-event, & keeping a work-life balance. Just ensure the required work gets done and clear it with your team in advance. You need to take at least 28 days off every year.

  • Direct access to our leadership team, including our CEO

  • Be part of a high performing team who know how to celebrate their success!

⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️

Not ticking every box? That’s okay. We take potential into consideration. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted in lieu of the specifics listed above. If you know you have what it takes, even if that’s different from what we’ve described, be sure to explain why in your application.

At Klue, we're committed to building a high-performing team where people feel a strong sense of belonging, can be their authentic selves, and are able to reach their full potential. If there’s anything we can do to make our hiring process more accessible or to better support you, please let us know, we’re happy to accommodate.

Why Klue Might Be the Perfect Fit For You

At Klue, you’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible. For yourself, your team, and our customers. The environment here feels more startup than corporate. You’ll roll up your sleeves, build, iterate, and level up. This is a place where your ideas matter, you can shape what comes next, and leave your mark.

If you’re looking to join a category-defining company… where you own big outcomes, influence real customers, and work with smart, gritty people… you’ll thrive here.

Unlock Your Potential. Take Risks. Take Action. Innovate

How We Work at Klue

We love the balance of connection and flexibility. We work Office-First, with ahybrid touch, and work together in our vibrant offices on Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together.

Our main hiring hubs are in:

  • 🇨🇦 Vancouver (HQ)

  • 🇨🇦 Toronto

  • 🇬🇧 London

Our Commitment to You

  • High Performance Culture. We reward high performance and growth through career development, coaching, and annual performance reviews.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Extended health & dental coverage that starts on Day 1. Fun perks like discounts at Goodlife and Perkopolis are gravy.

  • Ownership: All full-time employees have the opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Option Plan.

  • Our Vacation Policy is Take The Time You Need. We just ask that you give notice and don’t leave your team hanging.

  • Top-tier tools. All employees will receive a Mac (or PC, if that’s your jam) and access to A+ tooling.

  • AI First. All employees are encouraged to lean into AI to work smarter and faster. Built something cool lately? Show us at our Friday Show, Don’t Tell Meetings.

  • Growth / Leadership. Direct access to our leadership team, including our CEO, and opportunities to connect with incredible people across the company.

  • Social connection. There’s no shortage of ways to stay connected and have fun. We get together once a year in Vancouver for a company- wide kickoff. Throughout the year our Hubs hold regular social events.

  • Dog-friendly spaces. Bring your four-legged friend along in Vancouver or Toronto, as our offices are pup-approved.

About Klue

We’re on a mission to help organizations stop losing winnable deals. Klue’s AI agents generate market, competitor, and buyer insights in a unified platform. We ensure it’s trustworthy, automated, and activated across every department, so they have the answers they need to own their market.

✨ Here’s what makes us tick:

  • Klue is AI-first at its core. It’s wired deep into our internal processes and tooling, powering our small but mighty team. It drives Klue’s autonomous agents that handle the heavy lifting for customers: collecting intel, generating insights, and ensuring content is updated and available across departments. Our agents help them scale their impact, stay ahead of the market, and reclaim the time that used to be consumed by manual, repetitive busywork.

  • Competitor Insights. Klue helps revenue teams win more competitive deals by turning market, competitor, and buyer signals into insights teams can actually use. Our AI analyzes calls, CRM data, and real buyer feedback to give product marketers and sellers a clear picture of what’s happening in their market and why deals are won or lost. We’re a curious, collaborative team building a platform that helps companies compete with confidence, and we’re looking for people who want to do meaningful work alongside others who care about craft and impact.

  • A culture of curiosity, ownership and winning together. We’re a fast-growing, globally-distributed team based in Vancouver (with hubs like Toronto), scaling quicker than ever. We value people who own their domain, act boldly, stay curious and thrive in a collaborative, high-performance environment.

title: Cybersecurity & AI Engineer Automation (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Security team within the Platform, Data & AI Security pillar, led by Maxime Lahaye, Senior Security Officer, based in Paris.

AI is fundamentally transforming how we work, and you'll join a team at the forefront of this evolution. This is your opportunity to build the GRC infrastructure of tomorrow, where automation, scripting, and security converge to enable Mirakl's next phase of growth.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Your Impact

1 · Compliance & Certifications — Automation-first

  • Contribute to maintaining Mirakl's ISO 27001, ISO 27018 and SOC 2 certifications, leveraging automated GRC platforms to enable continuous compliance monitoring
  • Automate evidence collection, control monitoring and documentation workflows using modern GRC tooling, AI-powered agents and scripting (Python, N8N)
  • Help manage and evolve the ISMS (Information Security Management System), ensuring it reflects both regulatory requirements and Mirakl's evolving AI-driven operations

2 · AI Governance

  • Co-design and evolve Mirakl's AI usage governance framework: acceptable use policies, data classification for AI inputs, shadow AI detection and AI vendor risk assessment
  • Maintain a live inventory of AI tools used across the company and contribute to the risk-based process for evaluating and onboarding new tools
  • Monitor the AI governance regulatory landscape and help adapt Mirakl's framework proactively

3 · Security by design across all company projects

  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams early in project lifecycles to embed security and compliance requirements from the start
  • Participate in risk reviews across product and platform initiatives, with specific attention to AI-related threat vectors (prompt injection, data leakage in LLMs, access control for models)

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • Master's degree (Bac+5)
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in cybersecurity
  • You participated in ISO 27001 audit as a security contributor at least
  • Proven experience in scripting and automation (Python, N8N or equivalent)
  • Experience in a consulting firm or technology company is a plus
  • Strong understanding of compliance frameworks and security standards

Skills:

  • Strong technical profile with hands-on experience developing scripts and automating processes
  • Proactive and autonomous, with strong organizational and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent communication skills to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Integrity and ethics as core values
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Experience with web application and cloud (SaaS) security is a plus

Tools Used

  • Python
  • N8N
  • Drata
  • AWS, GCP
  • Office Suite / Google Workspace

Languages

  • Fluent in French and conversational English

Our Hiring Process

  1. 30-40 minute call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist
  2. 1-hour technical interview with the hiring manager
  3. Two 45-minute values interviews using the STAR methodology

The STAR method and structured interviews will hold no secrets for you.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights
descriptionHtml:
Worum gehts?

Bei Event Inc wollen wir Entscheidungen konsequent auf Basis von Daten treffen. Das gilt von der Go-to-Market-Strategie bis zur Conversion-Optimierung, in Marketing, Sales und Product. Mit Dir bündeln wir die Analysekompetenz an einer Stelle und schaffen eine gemeinsame Datenbasis, auf die sich alle verlassen können.

Deine Rolle

Als Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights bist Du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Datenanalysen entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Du bist Teil unseres Product Teams und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Data Engineers. Du begleitest Maßnahmen von der ersten Exploration über die Empfehlung bis zur Wirkungsmessung.

  • Performance im Blick: Du überwachst laufend unsere GTM-Performance über Marketing, Sales und Product hinweg, von Funnel-Analysen über Kanal-Performance bis zu Conversion-Raten.
  • Zahlen, die etwas bewegen: Du lieferst Ad-hoc-Analysen für unsere Teams, immer mit konkreten Handlungsempfehlungen statt reinen Reports.
  • Von der Idee bis zur Wirkung: Gemeinsam mit den Teams entwickelst Du Hypothesen und übersetzt sie in Experimente und A/B-Tests. Mit Vorher-/Nachher-Vergleichen misst Du, ob Maßnahmen wirklich wirken.
  • Muster erkennen: Du machst Cohort- und Funnel-Analysen über Kundensegmente und Marketplace-Bereiche hinweg (z. B. Pharma vs. Automotive). Mit Win/Loss-Analysen bei Enterprise-Deals lieferst Du wertvollen Input für unser Sales Enablement.
  • Traffic-Kanäle optimieren: In enger Abstimmung mit Marketing, Sales und Product optimierst Du unsere Traffic-Kanäle, z. B. mit Blick auf SEO/GEO-Performance und Content-Wirkung.
  • Reporting smart automatisieren: Zusammen mit einem Data Engineer baust Du eine KI- und automatisierungsgestützte Reporting-Infrastruktur auf. So fließt Deine Zeit in Analyse und Empfehlung statt in manuelle Datenaufbereitung.
  • Schnittstelle mit Gewicht: Du bist die zentrale Datenquelle für GTM-Entscheidungen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CPO zusammen.

Was uns gefällt

  • Fundierte Basis: Du hast ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung in Data Science, Statistik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, BWL oder einem ähnlichen Bereich erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Erfahrung, die zählt: Du bringst 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Data, Business oder Product Analytics mit. Mit Marketing-, Sales- oder Marketplace-Funnel-Metriken und Tracking kennst Du Dich aus.
  • Analytisches Handwerkszeug: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse und Statistik und weißt, wie man aussagekräftige KPIs entwickelt.
  • Daten in Klartext: Du leitest aus Zahlen konkrete, verständliche Empfehlungen ab und vermittelst sie so, dass jedes Team etwas damit anfangen kann.
  • Struktur, auch wenn's voll wird: Du arbeitest eigenständig und behältst den Überblick, auch wenn mehrere Teams gleichzeitig etwas von Dir brauchen.
  • Tech-Neugier: Du verstehst Code und schreibst ihn auch selbst (z. B. Python). Idealerweise hast Du schon mit Coding Agents Analysen erstellt oder automatisierte, KI-gestützte Reportings aufgebaut. Das ist kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch

Was Dir gefällt

  • Teamspirit, der Spaß macht: Freu Dich auf ein motiviertes, hochqualifiziertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echtem Zusammenhalt. Dazu gibt's regelmäßige Teamevents wie Afterwork-Drinks auf der Dachterrasse, Culture Nights oder Spieleabende.
  • Sei ein Sparfuchs: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf Top-Marken und Reisen über PepXpress und Corporate Benefits.
  • Gut versorgt: Natürlich stehen Dir der obligatorische Obstkorb, eine Müslibar sowie kalte und warme Getränke jederzeit zur Verfügung.
  • Individuelle Hardware-Wahl: Du entscheidest, ob Du mit einem Mac oder einem Windows-Gerät arbeitest.
  • Arbeitszeiten: Jedes Team tickt ein bisschen anders – aber generell gilt: Unsere Kernarbeitszeit ist von 10 bis 17 Uhr und wir treffen uns 4x die Woche im Office. Den Rest gestaltest du nach deinem Rhythmus.
  • Büro mit Wow-Faktor: Du arbeitest mit Blick auf die Elbe und einige der schönsten Sehenswürdigkeiten Hamburgs.
  • Pick your Perk: Du wählst 20 € Benefitsy, 20 € Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket oder 20 € Zuschuss für Urban Sports.
  • Wachstum: Wir fördern Deine Weiterentwicklung mit einem Learning Budget von 300 € pro Jahr.
  • Für später schon heute gesorgt: Du bekommst bis zu 100 € monatlich für Deine Altersvorsorge und Vermögensziele (bAV & VWL).

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Hellen, unsere Talent Acquisition Managerin

title: Data Analyst - Research Participants - United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
Data Analyst - Research Participants - United Kingdom

 

 

Location: Remote (UK)
Type of contract: Freelance
Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time)

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The RoleDo you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting data analysts based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a data analyst. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.

What you’ll be doing

  • Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant
  • Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences
  • Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective
  • Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part

What you’ll bring

  • Residence in the UK
  • Fluent English
  • A device with a working microphone
  • No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.

Why join this project?This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Data Architect
descriptionHtml:
🍊Our mission

Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients.

Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. We’re a new initiative, but we’re building on a proven foundation - the same infrastructure that has delivered 82% of Lindus Health’s sponsor trials on or ahead of timeline, across 40+ completed trials across the US and Europe.

We’re in-licensing 5-7 clinical-stage, typically Phase-2-ready assets, funded directly from Lindus Health’s balance sheet. We’re targeting deal close on our first assets through 2026, with first trials launching in H1 2027.

🍊About the role

The Data Architect owns assigned studies end-to-end, taking full responsibility for both the design of the database on Citrus and the quality of the data it produces, from study planning through database lock. The role designs with the final analysis in mind, writes code where manual review would slow delivery, and designs the edit checks and validation that prevent issues before they make their way downstream. The Data Architect is the technical and data lead for assigned studies and works with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Programme Directors, and Product to ensure each study captures the data its scientific objectives require.

One person owns the database from study planning through lock, so the design and the data it produces never drift apart. The role also shapes how data delivery on Citrus develops, identifying where manual work can be automated.

🍊About you

  • You have around 5+ years of experience across clinical data management and/or trial platform design, with hands-on involvement in study setup, data review, and database lock

  • You can design a study's data capture on an EDC platform and define its specification: you understand edit checks and validation, and you can see how a design decision today could become a data quality problem later

  • You work with data programmatically, or are ready to build that skill quickly: Python, R, or SQL are used daily in this role, and you are expected to learn them on the job if you do not already have them

  • You have working knowledge of CDISC standards, particularly CDASH, with SDTM familiarity a plus, and you design with analysis-ready data in mind

  • You have experience with external data transfers and reconciliation

  • You understand GCP, ICH E6 and 21 CFR Part 11 and apply them in day-to-day decisions

  • You apply AI and automation responsibly to improve the quality and speed of data work in a regulated setting

  • You have a track record of working well across functions, especially Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Programme Directors, and Product

  • You thrive in a startup environment that challenges the norms of typical biotechs, with high agency and a bias for action

  • You are passionate about our mission: changing how the healthcare industry operates and how new health treatments are developed

🍊What you’ll focus on

  • Own your assigned studies end-to-end, from defining critical data items and the data management plan through to database lock

  • Own the design of your studies on Citrus, utilizing AI combined with your expert review to translate protocol requirements into a specification and edit check logic that capture clean, analysis-ready data, and sign off that the design meets the protocol before go-live

  • Assess feasibility and flag complexity and risk early, where a design choice could affect data integrity, participant safety or study endpoints

  • Manage the full query lifecycle from generation through resolution, working directly with sites

  • Lead proactive, risk-based data review, automated where possible, to keep key study milestones on track, building repeatable checks rather than one-off reports

  • Use scripting and AI tooling day-to-day to automate data review, flag anomalies, and surface issues earlier, applied responsibly within validation, GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 expectations

  • Own fixes and change requests on your own studies during conduct, assessing their impact and the level of testing and sign-off required

  • Perform ongoing safety data review and facilitate medical coding (MedDRA, WHODrug) with the medical team

  • Build reports using programmatic data access (Python, R, SQL), delivered accurately and on schedule

  • Conduct all activities in line with relevant regulations and Lindus SOPs, keep study documentation to a standard that holds up under audit or inspection, and support auditors and inspectors on your studies where needed

  • Report bugs and usability issues, and feed operational insight back to Product to improve how Citrus supports data delivery

🍊 What we offer (US)

Make an impact across all areas of our business and fix one of the world's most broken industries.

  • Competitive salary, plus meaningful stock options

  • 27 days annual leave in addition to 11 National Holidays

  • Health insurance coverage through our PEO Trinet

  • $40 monthly wellness allowance, which you can spend on a wellhub membership, or wellness activities and expenses of your choice!

  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks full pay for primary caregiver and 6 weeks full pay for secondary caregiver

  • $2,000 Learning and Development allowance each year to put towards courses, certifications, and development

  • Regular whole company and team events, both in person and virtually

  • Access to gym and retail discounts through our benefits platform Happl

  • Monthly lunch voucher for our remote teams

  • Charity events and fundraising opportunities through our charity partnership with the Forward Trust

🍊 What we offer (UK)

Make an impact across all areas of our business and fix one of the world's most broken industries.

  • Competitive salary, plus meaningful stock options

  • Flexible working: We have an incredible office near London Bridge and encourage people to work 3 days per week from the office

  • 30 days annual leave in addition to Bank Holidays, resulting in 39 paid days off per year

  • £60 monthly wellness allowance, which you can spend on our company health insurance scheme through AXA, a wellhub membership, or wellness activities and expenses of your choice!

  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks full pay for primary caregiver and 4 weeks full pay for secondary caregiver

  • £1,000 Learning and Development allowance each year to put towards courses, certifications, and development

  • Cycle-to-work scheme and other salary sacrifice options available

  • Charity events and fundraising opportunities through our charity partnership with the Forward Trust

 

🍊 Our Hiring Process

We believe hiring should be transparent, respectful of your time, and give you a real feel for what Lindus Health is like. Here's what to expect:

 

Online Critical thinking test via TestGorilla (20 mins)
Once your invited to meet with us you'll be send a booking like as well as a link to TestGorilla's platform. This is a 2 part first stage.

Get to know each other, discuss the role, and answer any questions you have

Talk through the role in more detail and your experience.

Deep dive into your experience and how you'd approach key challenges

Values interview with our CEO, Meri and Veronica, VP Data (30 mins)
A chance to get to know each other and explore how our values align

 

[We'll arrange at least one interview in-person at our office if you are UK based so you can meet more of the team and get a feel for our environment - usually the final values stage.]

title: Data Center Capacity Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral Cloud builds and operates the infrastructure that powers Mistral's AI. The Data Centers team signs long-term leases for data center capacity developed by third-party operators, sources the GPUs that fill those halls, and runs the workloads that train and serve Mistral's models. Today the team is around 40 people, mainly based in Paris with some remote members, and operates roughly 200 MW of existing capacity across France. Key partners include Éclairion in France and EcoDC in Sweden, which is currently delivering Mistral's first Swedish data center.

The team sits at the center of an ambitious roadmap: Mistral has publicly committed to securing one gigawatt of data center capacity globally by 2030. With 200 MW already online, roughly 800 MW remain to be secured over the next five years.

The Role

This hire acquires the data center capacity that Mistral's next generation of models will run on. Across Europe, you will negotiate co-location agreements and built-to-suit contracts with data center developers, structure master services agreements and order forms, and make sourcing decisions grounded in a deep understanding of what the capacity will actually be used for: training frontier LLMs, serving inference at scale, or both.

The role sits at the intersection of commercial negotiation and technical infrastructure. You will need to translate workload requirements into contract terms, assess whether a given site can deliver the power, cooling, and connectivity Mistral needs, and close deals that lock in capacity years before the GPUs arrive.

What You Will Do

  • Negotiate master services agreements, order forms, and co-location or built-to-suit contracts with data center developers across Europe

  • Structure capacity sourcing decisions based on workload requirements: training, inference, or hybrid

  • Assess data center sites for power delivery, cooling, connectivity, and commissioning timelines

  • Work with Mistral's science and infrastructure teams to align capacity plans with model roadmaps

  • Manage relationships with existing data center partners including Éclairion and EcoDC

What We're Looking For

  • You have negotiated data center contracts. You have closed master services agreements, order forms, or co-location / built-to-suit deals in the data center or infrastructure sector.

  • You understand capacity delivery. You know what it takes to commission a data hall: power, cooling, connectivity, timelines, and the failure modes that delay go-live.

  • You can translate technical requirements into commercial terms. You have structured sourcing decisions based on workload needs, whether for training clusters or inference serving.

  • You operate across borders. You have worked with counterparties across multiple European jurisdictions and are comfortable with cross-border negotiation.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world's leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is at our core and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is looking for a Data Engineer to build the trusted data foundation behind machine learning across the company.

You’ll partner with data scientists to understand their modeling needs and what the available data can (and can’t) support. You’ll transform large-scale raw data into production-ready datasets and build the scalable pipelines that make them dependable and reusable. Working across Data Science, Data Engineering, and Data Platform, you’ll help address data gaps and bring new machine-learning use cases into production.

If you’re excited to shape how teams across KAYAK use data to build and scale machine learning, we’d love to hear from you.

This role will be required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with the Data Science teams and help translate modeling needs into dataset requirements, then collaborate with Data Engineering and Data Platform to extend foundational pipelines into ML-ready datasets.

  • Design scalable and efficient dataset workflows and ensure pipeline reliability through validation, monitoring, and alerting; diagnose and resolve issues.

  • Ship production-ready data solutions that enable ML applications and deliver real-world impact on user experience and key business metrics.

  • Identify gaps and opportunities, contributing to technical decisions and roadmap priorities that strengthen the data foundation for current and future ML use cases.

  • Collaborate across Data Science, Engineering, and Data Platform, communicating technical decisions, findings, and trade-offs clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences.

Please apply if you have:

  • Strong technical foundations in data engineering, software engineering, and systems design, backed by a track record of building and operating reliable, large-scale data pipelines. Demonstrated capability matters more than academic credentials.

  • Hands-on experience developing production data pipelines, with the ability to clearly explain the problems addressed, your specific contributions, and the resulting impact.

title: Data Engineer- UK
descriptionHtml:
About CoreView   

CoreView is the global leader in Microsoft 365 (M365) tenant resilience, serving over 23 million users worldwide. We empower the world’s leading organizations to master the complexity of Microsoft M365.  Through robust security and precise governance, we help ensure that our client’s environments stay cyber-resilient and productive, no matter how complex they are.  
 
Our unified, cloud-native platform delivers powerful automation, rapid value, and end-to-end visibility across the entire M365 ecosystem. Backed by world-class support and a collaborative, innovative culture, CoreView is a place where your ideas matter, and your work truly impacts global enterprises.  

Job Summary

This role sits in Operations. You'll report to the Data Analyst Manager helping establish our data practice, including documented pipelines, governed metric definitions, and an established way for other departments to ask for data without it becoming ad hoc, bespoke work every time. In addition, CoreView is improving how we understand product telemetry, platform product usage, licence utilisation and adoption trends.  You will work across business functions and take ownership of CoreView's customer usage and adoption analytics and turn them into a production-grade, reliable system, then help scope and build the next set of metrics and signals on top of them. You'll work primarily in Databricks (Unity Catalog, Spark Declarative Pipelines), using SQL and Python day to day, and you'll be expected to use AI-assisted development (Cursor, Claude, or equivalent) as a normal part of how you work.

Job Responsibilities

  • Take operational ownership of the usage and adoption pipelines and their alerting
  • Reconcile figures derived from our product-usage tool
  • Separate development and production environments and mature CI/CD so deployment is repeatable and rollback is reliable.
  • Build and maintain Bronze-to-Gold pipelines in Databricks, Unity Catalog metric views, and the permissions/row-level-security model behind them.
  • Extend automated data quality checks across the underlying gold-layer tables and validate outputs against existing Power BI reports.
  • Co-own the scoping of the next set of usage and adoption signals with Product and Post-Sales: prioritising upsell signals and the ROI narrative and confirming what needs new instrumentation.
  • Handle the realities of business system data: schema drift, inconsistent field naming, soft deletes, incremental loads 
  • Lead and be responsible for the consolidation of additional data sources — including support tickets, audit logs, CRM, and other customer-facing systems — while defining the feasibility, effort, cost, and implementation approach required to support a future unified data platform.
  • Establish documented pipelines, an access model for raw and transformed data, and a working intake process for cross-department data requests.
  • Act as a credible point of contact for CoreView's Databricks estate
  • Bring automation and AI-assisted tooling into the day-to-day work — for example automated monitoring and anomaly detection on metric movements — as the platform matures.

Job Requirements

  • 3 to 5 years' professional experience building and operating production data pipelines (ETL/ELT) in a commercial setting.
  • Hands-on Databricks proficiency: Unity Catalog, Spark Declarative Pipelines and metric views, including the permissions / row-level-security model behind them.
  • Strong SQL and Python applied to data engineering work — building, testing and supporting pipeline code through to production.
  • Experience with data transformation/orchestration tooling such as Spark Declarative Pipelines, dbt, or an equivalent.
  • Solid grounding in data modelling (dimensional/star-schema approaches) for analytics consumption.
  • Git-based version control and CI/CD practices applied to data pipelines, not just application code.
  • Experience ingesting data from a range of source systems — CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), product usage and telemetry (CoreView's own platform, UserPilot, or equivalents such as Pendo, Amplitude or Mixpanel), and other business systems.
  • Comfortable operating with limited hand-holding: implementing, documenting and running to an agreed direction rather than waiting for detailed instruction.
  • Clear written and verbal communication: you'll be the named contact for commercial teams asking questions about the numbers.

Preferred skills:

  • Power BI or an equivalent BI tool, including validating a migrated report against a legacy one.
  • Prior experience implementing data governance, a metric catalogue, or an access model from a low base of maturity.
  • Background in B2B SaaS.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude) as part of a production engineering workflow.

Coreview Values

Ownership Mindset:Take ownership. Drive outcomes. 

One Team: One team, one goal, embracing diversity - to achieve more together. 

Velocity: Decide fast. Deliver fast. Repeat.

Continuous Improvement: Curiosity drives us. We challenge the status quo.

Customer First: Listen deeply. Solve boldly.  

Resilience: Steady under pressure.

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Our Opportunity:

Runtime Foundation owns the shared cloud foundations that every Snyk service runs on: production Kubernetes clusters, ingress and service mesh, infrastructure provisioning and access, cluster upgrades, reliability and disaster recovery, and our AWS and GCP core services. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction for this platform, lead our most ambiguous and consequential infrastructure work, and act as a trusted technical authority for teams across Snyk that depend on us.

You’ll spend your time:

  • Setting technical strategy for the platform, shaping the roadmap with engineering and product leadership, and making the case for investment in reliability, resilience and cost.

  • Leading cross-team, org-level infrastructure initiatives end-to-end, from problem framing and alignment through to production rollout and adoption.

  • Acting as a technical authority for engineering teams across Snyk, setting infrastructure design standards, reviewing significant proposals, and influencing how teams build securely and reliably on our platform.

  • Driving architectural direction for Kubernetes at scale, including cluster and node upgrade strategy, and leading diagnosis of deep networking, scheduling and resource-pressure issues in high-severity incidents.

  • Defining the architecture for in-cluster platform services (ingress controllers, cert-manager, autoscaling components) and the Helm chart standards the wider organisation builds on.

  • Shaping Terraform module architecture at organisational scale, including how state, drift and change safety are managed across a large multi-cloud estate.

  • Making multi-cloud (AWS/GCP) architecture decisions with long-term consequences, including IAM, networking and managed-service resilience.

  • Owning ingress, networking and service mesh architecture, including TLS, rate limiting and multi-tenant traffic design.

  • Raising the engineering bar across the department: improving observability and operational practices, eliminating classes of toil systemically, and growing senior engineers through mentoring, sponsorship and example.

You should apply if you:

  • Have extensive professional experience (typically 5+ years) operating and architecting production infrastructure at scale, with a track record of leading work at organisation level rather than team level.

  • Have deep, hands-on expertise across Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm and multi-cloud (AWS/GCP) environments, and have led large, multi-team migrations or platform redesigns that shipped and stuck.

  • Can take an ambiguous, cross-organisational problem, define what success looks like, build alignment across teams without formal authority, and communicate trade-offs clearly to engineers, directors and executive stakeholders.

  • Have a history of making durable architectural decisions, and of knowing when to say no, when to defer and when to change course.

  • Have mentored and sponsored senior engineers, and have measurably raised the technical bar of a team or department.

  • Are comfortable being the go-to technical authority for other teams, and for leadership during significant incidents and risk discussions.

  • Treat clear documentation (design docs, ADRs, runbooks) and automated testing as core to sustainable engineering, and set the example for others.

We’d especially love to hear from you if you:

  • Have designed or operated Teleport, RBAC, or JIT/least-privilege access systems at scale.

  • Have driven cloud cost optimisation outcomes, including tools like PerfectScale, and tied them to business impact.

  • Have built reusable CI/CD platform abstractions (CircleCI orbs, GHA reusable workflows, or similar) and driven org-wide adoption.

  • Have led disaster-recovery strategy, backup validation and recovery automation across Kubernetes and cloud services, including DR exercises with cross-team participation.
