title: IT System Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey. We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further. Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other. Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

You will join the IT System Engineering team within the IT Department, alongside the IT Support and IT Project Management teams. Based in Paris, you will report to the IT System Engineering Manager and contribute to the design, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Contentsquare’s core IT platforms. This is a full-time, permanent position with no direct reports.

You will work across identity and access management, endpoint and mobile device management, SaaS applications, automation, and AI-enabled IT initiatives. The role is primarily on-site in Paris, with some remote work permitted according to company policy.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve the core IT platform across identity and access management, endpoint management, enterprise mobility, and cross-functional SaaS applications.

  • Manage and improve Okta, Jamf, Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Intune, macOS, and Windows environments, ensuring secure, reliable, and effective services for employees.

  • Build and maintain automated workflows using Okta Workflows, Zapier, Workato, or similar platforms to simplify IT processes and improve the employee experience.

  • Develop, maintain, and improve Bash scripts and other scripts used to automate IT operations, system administration tasks, monitoring, configuration, and user or device lifecycle processes.

  • Collaborate with the IT Support team on escalated cases and cross-team projects, providing technical expertise across identity, endpoints, access, SaaS applications, and device management.

  • Lead assigned initiatives autonomously, contribute to project management, provide clear progress updates, and use tools such as Jira to track projects and deliverables.

  • Use AI tools and set up MCP servers to support automation, IT operations, and the AI at Work initiative.

Outcomes you will work toward

  • Maintain secure, reliable, and well-managed identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments for Contentsquare employees.

  • Improve the efficiency, scalability, and consistency of IT operations through automation and scripting.

  • Resolve escalated cases effectively in collaboration with the IT Support team.

  • Deliver owned projects and initiatives with clear planning, documentation, stakeholder communication, and follow-through.

  • Identify and implement practical opportunities to improve security, performance, reliability, and employee experience across the IT platform.

Operational responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of identity, endpoint, MDM, SaaS, and automation platforms.

  • Develop and maintain Bash scripts and other scripts that reduce manual work and improve consistency across IT operations.

  • Monitor configurations, deployments, software updates, access, and security controls across managed environments.

  • Investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable solutions.

  • Document systems, workflows, processes, and technical decisions clearly.

  • Collaborate with IT Support, IT Project Management, and other teams on escalated cases and cross-team projects.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint management, identity and access management, or a closely related field.

  • Proficiency in Okta and a solid understanding of identity and access management concepts.

  • Hands-on experience with Jamf, Google Workspace, and Slack.

  • Experience building and maintaining automated workflows with tools such as Okta Workflows, Zapier, Workato, or similar platforms.

  • Practical knowledge of macOS and Windows environments.

  • Proficiency in Bash and scripting, with the ability to automate repetitive administration tasks, integrate systems, troubleshoot issues, and maintain clear and reusable scripts.

  • Proficiency in AI tools for IT operations, automation, or productivity.

  • Experience setting up MCP servers.

  • The ability to contribute to project management and take ownership of initiatives.

  • The ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with others.

  • The ability to provide clear and regular progress updates on owned projects and initiatives.

  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

  • The ability to understand and follow clear guidelines and directions.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Nice-to-have

  • Some knowledge of Jira.

  • Experience with Microsoft Intune.

  • French language skills.

  • Experience contributing to internal AI, automation, or digital workplace initiatives.

If you are interested in this role, please send your CV in English.Why you should join Contentsquare We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs. Here are a few we want to highlight: - Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year - Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies - Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different) - Lifestyle allowance - A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work - Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success - We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts - And more benefits tailored to each country Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. title: Junior Google Performance & Analytics Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
In dieser Position bist du für die operative Umsetzung unseres Google-Marketings zuständig. Während die Strategie und das technische Setup vorgegeben werden, verantwortest du das fehlerfreie Einbuchen, die tägliche Pflege und das exakte Monitoring unserer Google-Ads-Kampagnen. Du hältst dem Team im Tagesgeschäft den Rücken frei, überwachst die Budgets nach klaren Vorgaben und bereitest die Performance-Daten in übersichtlichen Reportings auf. Durch deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Kampagnen verlässlich laufen und optimiert werden.

Aufgaben

  • Kampagnen-Setup & Pflege: Du buchst Google-Ads-Kampagnen (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) nach klaren Vorgaben ein und pflegst Anzeigen, Texte sowie Budgets im System.
  • Tägliches Monitoring: Du überwachst laufend die Performance und die Tagesbudgets unserer Accounts, um einen reibungslosen und fehlerfreien Ablauf der Kampagnen sicherzustellen.
  • Datenpflege & Reporting: Du exportierst regelmäßig die Leistungsdaten der Werbekampagnen und bereitest diese in übersichtlichen Excel-Listen oder Dashboards für das Management auf.
  • Operatives Tagesgeschäft: Du unterstützt bei der täglichen Organisation der Marketing-Aktivitäten, übernimmst die Abstimmung von Werbemitteln (wie Bildern und Texten) und erledigst anfallende Routineaufgaben im Account.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung oder Studium: Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften) oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung mit.
  • Erste Marketing-Einblicke: Du hast erste praktische Erfahrungen im digitalen Marketing gesammelt (z. B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder erste Berufsschritte).
  • Google-Kenntnisse als Plus: Idealerweise hast du schon mal mit Google Ads oder Analyse-Tools gearbeitet – das ist ein großer Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du Lust hast, dich schnell in diese Systeme einzuarbeiten.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du bist absolut zuverlässig, arbeitest extrem gewissenhaft und prüfst deine Aufgaben lieber doppelt, bevor etwas online geht.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen: Du hast eine gute Affinität zu Daten und kannst sicher mit Excel oder Google Sheets umgehen, um Listen und Tabellen zu pflegen.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.
  • Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben.
  • Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur.
  • Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben

title: Junior or Medior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
HelloPrint is rebuilding the entire platform: new frontend, new pricing engine, new content engine, new product engine, everything ready for an agentic future. No one on the team writes code manually for what these systems handle. You'll work inside this rebuild, under the direction of our founding team (Hans, CEO, and Michael, CIO/Chief AI Officer), executing on high-leverage AI problems with real commercial impact, visible immediately in revenue or cost. There's no management layer between you and the outcome. You build, you ship, you measure, you move to the next problem.

What you will build:

The opportunity surface is large: 14 markets, 600,000 customers, a platform being rebuilt in parallel across four core engines. You'll work on problems from areas like:

  • Dynamic pricing and margin optimization across markets.

  • Agentic procurement: supplier selection, ordering, quality management.

  • Customer journey automation from configuration to post-delivery.

  • Intelligent content and SEO infrastructure at platform scale.

  • Predictive demand and inventory across the supplier network.

  • Internal tooling that multiplies the output of every team.

Before you read further

HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world's leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We're at EUR 100M revenue and aiming to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry. Every hire we make needs to help get us there.

  • Commercial instinct first, engineering second. You think about what something is worth before you think about how to build it.

  • Full-time in Rotterdam. Five days a week, in the building where the transformation is happening.

  • You have been building since before it was a career. Side projects, tools, systems nobody asked for. The obsession came first.

  • You ship continuously. You ship fast and you ship real systems. Not prototypes, not demos.

  • You are more than just an engineer. You understand product decisions, user impact, and design tradeoffs. You do not need a PM to translate the business problem for you.


Who you are:

You've built and shipped real production systems, not just contributed to someone else's. You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't need a fully specified brief to start. You care about what your work is worth, not just whether it works. You want to build inside a company that's already proven, not another 0-to-1 bet. You do not think of yourself as an AI engineer. You think of yourself as someone who solves hard problems and builds the systems to prove it. The engineering is the method. The obsession is the identity.

Three signals that tell us you are that person:

  • You've spotted an opportunity for an AI solution before anyone assigned it to you, and built it, even if it started as a side project or a shortcut nobody asked for. Ask you to name one and it won't take you long.

  • What you've shipped has been in production and actually used, not a prototype sitting in a repo or a demo that impressed someone once.

  • You can point to at least one thing you built where you had a rough idea of what it was worth before building it, and checked afterward whether it delivered.

Must-haves:

  • Hands-on production experience, not purely architectural or supervisory.

  • Commercial instinct that precedes technical execution: you know the business case before you write the first line.

  • Track record of shipping production AI/software systems that are live and used by real users.

  • Solid fluency in LLMs, agentic workflows, and modern AI infrastructure.

  • Ability to reason about commercial impact, not just technical correctness.

  • Comfortable working with high autonomy and limited process.

  • Office-first: on-site in Rotterdam, five days a week.

This role is not for you if you:

This role is not for people who got into AI because it became important. It is for people who have been building since before anyone called it a career. The kind of person who coded as a teenager, shipped their first thing before anyone asked, and has never really stopped. Who finds it genuinely difficult to explain why they build: it is just what they do. Who would rather spend a Sunday solving a hard systems problem than almost anything else. If you have to think about whether that description fits you, it probably does not.

  • Got into AI because it became an important skill, not because you could not imagine doing anything else.

  • Need a brief, a PM, or a defined scope before taking action.

  • Measure your output in technical quality or feature count rather than business impact.

  • Would answer 'what would you build first?' with an infrastructure question.

  • If you think a workweek of 40h is a lot.

  • Prefer hybrid or remote working.

What we offer

  • 🎯 Room to grow: opportunities develop fast, within your role and across HelloPrint

  • 🌍 The team: 100+ people from 20+ nationalities who build at a pace most companies cannot match. Rotterdam is not a compromise. It is where the work happens.

  • 🚀 Real impact: shape the future of a high-growth, AI-driven company where your ideas land in production the same week.

  • 💡 Full autonomy from day one: no roadmap to follow, no brief to wait for. You see the problem, you build the solution, you own the outcome.

  • 🏃🏻‍♂️‍➡️ Hello-Benefits: including 24/7 HelloFit gym access, UrbanSportsClub discount, the best events and company-sponsored healthy meals every day

  • 💶 Base salary: €50,000 to €75,000 gross per year, depending on skills, level and experience.

Ready to build something? We need bold thinkers, fast executors, and AI-first problem solvers. If that sounds like you, apply now. Let's redefine an industry together.

At HelloPrint, we believe diversity makes us better. We're building a workplace where everyone can be themselves, grow, and do their best work regardless of background, identity, or perspective. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Key Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Hozah

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

And we're only getting started. We currently hold a small share of a large market, which means the opportunity ahead, for the business and for the people who join it now, is huge.

The Role

We're hiring a Key Account Manager to win new logos and then grow them. You'll find and open the door at landowners, managing agents, hotel groups and multi-site operators that have never worked with us, win their first site, and then earn the rest of their estate by delivering and building the relationship from the inside.

This is a target-carrying sales role for someone who loves the hunt. Rather than inheriting a book of accounts to farm, you'll build your own: the accounts you develop will be the ones you win, and the commission you earn on them is uncapped. Cold calling and outbound prospecting are a core part of the job, so it suits someone who enjoys both landing the first deal and then multiplying it.

You won't be running site go-lives, resolving driver appeals or chasing operational issues. Our Client Success Managers own the day-to-day running of each account, so your time goes on the commercial relationship, the next site and the next logo.

Key responsibilities

  • Own a named list of target organisations and be accountable for converting them into Hozah clients — from first cold call to signed contract.

  • Own the growth of every account you win: map the estate, build relationships beyond the original buyer, and secure the next sites and additional services.

  • Hit your sales targets. You will carry a new-logo target and an account-expansion target, with commission on both.

  • Run a disciplined outbound engine: daily cold calling, email and LinkedIn sequences, event follow-up and referral asks, with the activity, pipeline and forecast recorded accurately in the CRM.

  • Run the full sales cycle yourself: discovery, site visits, proposals, commercial negotiation and close, with support from the wider team where a deal needs it.

  • Hand each new site to the Client Success Manager cleanly, with the commitments made in the sale written down, and stay the commercial owner of the relationship after go-live.

  • Hold regular commercial reviews with the accounts you own — performance, value delivered, and what else we can do for them.

  • Feed what you learn from prospects and clients back to the CEO, product and operations, so the proposition keeps improving.

Who we're looking for

We'll explore each of these during the interview process, so come ready with specific examples.

title: Kodierfachkraft / Medizincontroller:in Psychiatrie (PEPP) – Remote (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Valova

Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser, die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient.

Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern.

Warum diese Rolle zählt

Dein PEPP-Wissen: nicht für eine Klinik, sondern für viele. Du kennst die DKR-Psych im Detail, weißt, wo im Klinikalltag Erlöse verloren gehen, und hast schon mit dem MD über Fälle diskutiert? Bei Valova sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere KI so gut kodiert wie Du, und bringst sie in psychiatrische und psychosomatische Kliniken in ganz Deutschland.

Die Kodierung in Psychiatrie und Psychosomatik folgt eigenen Regeln. Therapieeinheiten, ergänzende Tagesentgelte, Fallzusammenführungen und Personalvorgaben machen PEPP zu einem der anspruchsvollsten Systeme im Krankenhaus, und jede Lücke in Dokumentation oder Kodierung kostet Erlöse und führt zu MD-Prüfungen. Valova ist gebaut, um das zu ändern, aber nur, wenn unsere Software PEPP so gut versteht wie die besten Kodierfachkräfte. Genau dafür brauchen wir Dich.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in Fällen, die vollständig kodiert sind und in der Prüfung bestehen, in weniger Streit mit dem MD und in Stunden, die Kodierteams und Therapeut:innen zurückgewinnen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Valova PEPP beibringen: Du übersetzt ICD-10-GM, OPS Kapitel 9, DKR-Psych, PEPP-Katalog und PsychPV/PPP-RL in klare Kodierregeln, Plausibilitätsprüfungen und Testfälle, inklusive Therapieeinheiten, ergänzender Tagesentgelte und Fallzusammenführungen.

  • KI-Vorschläge prüfen: Du bewertest die Kodiervorschläge von Valova und markierst, was stimmt und was nicht. So wird die Qualität messbar besser.

  • Auf dem Laufenden halten: Du arbeitest Katalogänderungen zum Jahreswechsel und neue Rechtsprechung ein.

  • Kliniken begleiten: Du betreust Pilot- und Rolloutprojekte vor Ort und remote, schulst Kodierfachkräfte, Medizincontrolling sowie ärztliches und therapeutisches Personal und bist nach dem Go-live die erste fachliche Ansprechperson. Dafür bist Du rund 20–30 % Deiner Zeit unterwegs.

  • Brücke bauen: Du gibst Feedback aus dem Klinikalltag strukturiert an unsere Produktentwicklung weiter.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der PEPP-Kodierung, z. B. als Kodierfachkraft, im Medizincontrolling einer psychiatrischen oder psychosomatischen Einrichtung, beim Medizinischen Dienst oder ärztlich in der Psychiatrie

  • Sichere Kenntnisse in ICD-10-GM, OPS, DKR-Psych und dem PEPP-Entgeltsystem

  • Freude daran, Wissen verständlich weiterzugeben, und fließendes Deutsch

Schön, aber kein Muss:

  • Erfahrung mit MD-Prüfungen

  • Kenntnisse in PsychPV/PPP-RL, stationsäquivalenter Behandlung (StäB) oder PIA-Abrechnung

  • Erfahrung mit KIS- oder Kodiersoftware (z. B. ID DIACOS, Solventum, Orbis, iMedOne) oder mit Software-Einführungen

  • Englisch-Lesekenntnisse

  • Interesse an Daten (z. B. Excel) oder KI

Du erfüllst nicht alles? Bewirb Dich trotzdem. Dein PEPP-Praxiswissen zählt für uns mehr als jedes Zertifikat.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Flexible Arbeitszeit. 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche, Du entscheidest. Unbefristeter Vertrag.

  • 100 % remote in ganz Deutschland, optional mit dem Team in München oder Berlin.

  • Faires Gehalt, orientiert an Deiner Erfahrung und mindestens auf Klinik-Niveau. Die konkrete Spanne nennen wir Dir schon im ersten Gespräch.

  • Sinn mit Hebel. Statt Rückstände in einer Klinik abzuarbeiten, entlastest Du Kodierteams in vielen Kliniken gleichzeitig.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern. Du arbeitest täglich mit Sophia, Ärztin und ehemalige McKinsey-Beraterin, und Christian, der zwei Health-Tech-Startups gegründet und ein Jahrzehnt lang klinische Systeme gebaut hat. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

  • Reisen ohne Kosten für Dich. Reisekosten übernehmen wir.

Der Bewerbungsprozess

Nach Deiner Bewerbung lernen wir uns in einem ersten Gespräch kennen. Anschließend tauschen wir uns vertiefend über Deine Erfahrung und Deinen Vertriebsansatz aus.

Zum Abschluss lernst Du unser Team persönlich in Berlin oder München kennen. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, freuen wir uns auf die Zusammenarbeit!

title: Lead Analytics Engineer - Finance Data (FinOps)
descriptionHtml:
About Finom
Finom is growing fast, and Finance needs data that grows with it. As our Lead Analytics Engineer for Finance, you'll be the data partner for treasury, reconciliation and accounting. You'll also support our corporate finance and investor reporting work together with the team's existing data partner. You'll build and scale the data model behind these areas, set standards, integrate the systems Finance relies on and bring in automation, including agents, where it saves real work

This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. You'll learn how Finance works and why, understand where the value is, and work with the team on how their processes run, proposing improvements and the data and tools to support them. You'll report to the Head of Central Data

What You Will Be Doing
- Partner with the Treasury, Reconciliation and Accounting teams on their processes, priorities and how data supports them.
- Build out treasury data: positions, cash flows and liquidity, as trusted data products the team can rely on day to day.
- Build and scale reconciliation, so that matching, breaks and exceptions are handled systematically rather than by hand.
- Support Accounting with the data, checks and integrations behind their close and day-to-day work.
- Support our corporate finance data partner on corporate finance and investor reporting, working from one shared model and set of definitions.
- Design and evolve the Finance data model, entities and metrics, with tests, lineage and documentation, so the team can reuse and extend them.
- Set data standards and quality checks for Finance data, and build integrations with the systems Finance uses.
- Bring automation and agents into Finance workflows where they remove recurring manual work.
- Look at how Finance processes run today, identify what can work better and connect each piece of data work to its business cost and value.


How We Work
You'll have high autonomy. You choose the tools and the approach, including trialling new vendors and open-source solutions. Sign-off is needed in two cases. The first is architecture: whether a solution scales, holds across use cases and growing volumes, and runs without constant support. The second is anything that feeds high-stakes decisions. Priorities are set by final business impact.


Who You Are
- You've worked in or closely with Finance: in a finance team, as a finance data partner, or in data work centred on treasury, reconciliation, accounting or FP&A.
- You understand how a finance function works: the close, cash and liquidity, reconciliations and the reports that come out of them.
- You write expert SQL and have strong dimensional or semantic data modelling skills.
- You've built metrics and data products that other teams depend on.
- You have ETL and data warehouse or lakehouse experience, including onboarding sources end to end.
- You choose precision over speed when the two conflict.
- You work like a consultant to the business: you understand how a process works, propose solutions and frame them in terms of business value.


Nice to Have
- Databricks and Unity Catalog
- Experience integrating ERP, accounting, banking or treasury systems
- Experience with workflow automation or agents in finance processes
- CI/CD, orchestration and infrastructure-as-code
- Background in fintech, banking or payments


How You'll Grow
In your first months you get to know Finance, the model, the stack and your stakeholders. By six months you're self-sufficient and make judgement calls on scope and design without escalating. From there, you set long-term goals together with your Finance stakeholders, own the data roadmap for treasury, reconciliation and accounting, and mentor others on analytics-engineering practice.

The Team
We're a small central team that works with every function, and Finance is our primary partner. We use a modern stack, you're free to try new tools, and there are incentives for driving change. AI assistants take on routine work so people can focus on harder problems. We work in English, think long term, and build data that functions keep developing after we deliver it

title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.

Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

title: Lead Engineer - Front End & Design System
descriptionHtml:
Tech Specialist (Front-end & Design System) TL1

  • Location: London, UK - Hybrid

  • Team: Global Engineering - Commerce & Customer Care

  • Visa: This role is based in the UK and requires existing right to work in the UK.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You will be fully embedded in the Customer Care org, specifically working on KAE (Kaluza Agent Experience) which is integral to building and enabling an energy specific agent product for servicing customers across multiple channels and the enterprise design system (Nebula) that will enable the next phase of scale for Kaluza. You will be the design system technical expert for the team and the hands-on bridge between design and engineering, turning design intent into accessible, production-quality React components and patterns, bolstering the existing team members with specific technical depth in building and scaling design systems across internal teams. You will work with designers as equal partners.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Working in a product development team with internal users to understand emerging and existing needs to steer the development of the enterprise design system, and supporting the teams who build with it

  • Working closely with designers as equal partners, and with product and engineering, to help shape the future of the global Agent Experience product and the design system

  • Designing, building and shipping React components and patterns that conform to WCAG 2.2 AA to help the team meet their delivery goals

  • Reviewing code from your colleagues, including contributions from outside the team, and setting the quality bar for design fidelity and accessibility

  • Making the design-to-code workflow work in practice, including design tokens, handoff and component documentation

  • Running the contribution process so that teams beyond our own can propose, build and ship into the design system, and leading changes that affect several apps from first proposal to final migration

  • Creating and delivering against the technical strategy for your team in partnership with the engineering manager

  • Promoting engineering, design and delivery best practices within the team, and coaching the engineers and designers who use the design system

  • Shaping how we use AI-assisted development in design system work

  • Championing progressive architecture and reviewing design solutions with other engineering leaders

  • Representing the design system to engineering and wider stakeholders, and helping set its direction

  • Working within a team of other senior leaders responsible for designing and evolving the architecture of the enterprise design system at Kaluza

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Deep experience building Frontend components with React and TypeScript

  • Deep experience designing, building and running design systems, including tokens, component APIs, documentation and versioning

  • Knowledge of implementing and maintaining WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, with practical empathy for users with accessibility needs

  • Good design and UX judgement, starting from the user, and comfortable challenging and being challenged by designers

  • Experience running changes across multiple apps

  • Strong communication skills, comfortable working with stakeholders across engineering, design, product and the wider business, holding opinions loosely and raising what matters even when it is inconvenient

  • A bias to action and a ‘Can do’ approach to problem solving in the face of uncertainty

  • Experience of mentoring, training and developing other engineers

  • An ability to deliver against a technical strategy iteratively, working through ambiguity to deliver change over longer periods

  • Experience of building and nurturing highly collaborative and engaged teams

  • Comfort with AI-enabled development, ideally leading others in using it well

  • An ability to collaborate with people managers, product managers and agile practitioners to contribute to a high-performing culture

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

  • You have good judgement, and have a track record of making good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”.

  • You’re a fast learner, humble and curious, and enjoy learning every day and sharing your knowledge and experience.
  • You’ve mentored other PMs, have the ability to coach others, and can provide clear and constructive feedback to your team and other disciplines.

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £115,000 - £140,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

Our interview process usually involves 4 main stages:

title: Lead Technical Product Manager, Protocol (Vision Chain)
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are building the premier ecosystem for European financial institutions to issue and distribute euro-denominated tokenized assets. We're hiring a Lead Technical Product Manager to own Vision Chain as a product: the foundation that Bitpanda's onchain products run on.

You'll own how the chain works and evolves, covering topics spanning proof systems, core protocol modifications, selecting the infrastructure providers, and more. You'll design and implement compliance, identity and privacy solutions into and on the chain, to satisfy the requirements of both financial institutions and developers. You'll work on this in collaboration with both internal and external product and engineering teams, as well as Bitpanda's Compliance, Legal and Data Protection teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product within a small, senior team.

What you’ll do 

  • Own Vision Chain at the infrastructure level, managing configuration choices (fee mechanism, block building logic, etc.), and modifications to the OP Stack, in collaboration with the OP Labs team.
  • Manage infrastructure partnerships, owning the technical relationship with providers (RPC nodes, indexing, oracles, etc.). 
  • Collaborate with Compliance and Legal to implement regulatorily-compliant onchain transaction screening, identity, and privacy solutions.
  • Run reliability, incidents and cost, and own developer documentation and partner technical onboarding until a developer relations lead joins.
  • Coordinate with the other Vision Web3 product leads to ensure the chain’s technical roadmap supports the product roadmap being built on top of it.

Who you are 

  • 6+ years of product or engineering experience, with 3+ years focused on blockchain infrastructure (e.g., L1/L2, rollup-as-a-service, node infrastructure provider, account abstraction, or an exchange protocol team).
  • Deep understanding of EVM rollup mechanics, including sequencing, fees, proofs, withdrawals, bridges, upgrade keys, and account abstraction.
  • Proven ability to translate complex business and regulatory needs into precise technical requirements and drive them to delivery through engineering teams and external partners without direct management.
  • Experience partnering with Compliance, Legal, and Data Protection teams, possessing working knowledge of the EU crypto regulatory landscape (MiCA, DORA, AML/CFT, sanctions screening).
  • Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills for internal teams, leadership, and external partners.

** This position is available in all of our Hubs.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

title: Legal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role

Legal Engineers turn the product into real outcomes for customers.

You’ll work with customers after purchase to design, configure, and implement legal workflows inside Wordsmith. This role sits close to the customer, helping them embed the platform into how their legal function actually operates.

It’s part implementation, part problem solving, and part advisory. You’ll combine legal understanding with product knowledge to help customers get meaningful value from the platform.

This is a technical, hands-on role. You don’t need to be a lawyer, and we’re not necessarily looking for one. We’re looking for analytical thinkers who are comfortable with technology and ideally have deployed legal tech before — people who can understand how a legal team works, then build the system that supports it. Where the work turns on legal judgement, we already have lawyers as part of the team who can bring the legal expertise.

What you’ll do

1. Customer Implementation

  • Lead implementation projects for new customers

  • Design workflows and automation tailored to each organisation

  • Configure the platform to support real legal use cases

  • Scope implementations for complex enterprise customers — use cases, sequencing, and where value will land first

2. Solution Design

  • Work directly with legal teams and Legal Ops leaders to understand how they operate

  • Translate legal processes into structured workflows and AI-enabled automation

  • Advise on best practices for implementing legal technology

  • Build and adapt playbooks with the customer, bringing in Legal Intelligence where clause language or negotiation positions need a lawyer’s judgement

3. Technical Build

  • Build integrations and connect Wordsmith to customers’ systems, knowing when to bring in Engineering

  • Build agents, skills, automations and workflows, from standard templates to complex multi-step processes

  • Take on complex reports and playbooks, leaving standard ones, such as a basic NDA blueprint, to the wider customer team

4. Escalation & Fixes

  • Reconfigure playbooks and workflows when a customer’s risk appetite or process changes

  • Act as the escalation point for technical issues and complex training questions from Support and Enablement

  • Run deeper health checks where a setup needs technical or process review

5. Customer Success & Expansion

  • Support onboarding and early adoption

  • Help customers expand into additional workflows and use cases

  • Create the template flows Enablement uses to demo and train on standard product workflows

  • Provide on-site embedded support where a customer needs hands-on technical help

6. Product Feedback

  • Surface patterns, insights, and recurring requests to Product and Engineering

  • Help shape how the product evolves based on real usage

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in legal tech, legal operations, or process transformation

  • Strong understanding of how in-house legal teams work

  • Ability to manage customer projects and guide stakeholders through change

  • Comfortable working across legal and technical domains

  • Technical enough to build integrations, agents and automations yourself, and to judge when a problem needs Engineering

  • A fixer’s instinct — comfortable diagnosing a live setup and reworking it when a customer’s needs change

  • Structured thinker — you can turn messy processes into clear systems

  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with customers

Typical backgrounds include

  • Prior Legal Engineering experience

  • Implementation or solutions consultants in SaaS (CLM / Legal Tech is a plus)

  • Legal Operations Professionals

How we work

We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh or London. You should expect to work from the office or visit customers as your default.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. There will not always be an established playbook, so you’ll need to bring curiosity, structure and persistence to unfamiliar situations.

You’ll sit in the Transformation team, reporting to the VP of Transformation, and work alongside Legal Intelligence, Enablement, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product.

Our customer teams have clear but closely connected responsibilities: Transformation leads implementation, Support Engineering resolves technical issues, Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth, Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation, and Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability.

Why Wordsmith

Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding within larger organisations. How legal work gets rebuilt around AI is still being written, and Legal Engineers are the people writing it with our customers.

You’ll work directly with ambitious in-house legal teams, see how dozens of legal functions really operate, and take that back into a product you help shape. It is a rare place to combine legal judgement with building things.

title: Legal Operations Intern
descriptionHtml:
About H:

H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.

H is hiring the world’s best AI talent, seeking those who are dedicated as much to building safely and responsibly as to advancing disruptive agentic capabilities. We promote a mindset of openness, learning, and collaboration, where everyone has something to contribute.

About the Role:

Our Legal team, based in Paris, supports every deal, hire and partnership at H. As requests grow, we want legal work to run on clear processes and good tools rather than on inboxes. You will be the front door for legal requests, run the contract lifecycle day to day, and above all build the tooling and automations that let the team move faster. You will report to our General Counsel.

This is a 6 month internship, open to EFB (Barreau de Paris) students completing their PPI, or to recent graduates of an M2 in business law.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Tooling and automation (the core of the role):

    • Map our existing legal processes and identify bottlenecks.

    • Benchmark tools (contract lifecycle management, e-signature, request management) and deliver a costed recommendation.

    • Build simple automations: intake forms, approval workflows, and Claude projects for first-pass contract reviews.

    • Create a dashboard showing request volumes, turnaround times and active contracts.

  • Front door for legal requests:

    • Receive, triage and route internal requests (NDAs, customer contracts, vendors, HR).

    • Set up and maintain a request tracker (Notion, Linear or similar) with status, priority and deadline.

    • Follow up with internal and external stakeholders to keep matters moving.

  • Contract lifecycle:

    • Prepare first drafts from templates (NDAs, POCs, standard order forms), always reviewed by the General Counsel.

    • Coordinate internal approvals with Sales, Finance and Engineering, and own our e-signature workflows from start to finish.

    • Maintain a register of signed contracts: parties, dates, term, auto-renewal, notice periods and liability caps.

    • Flag key deadlines such as renewals, terminations and POC end dates.

title: Leitung Vertriebsinnendienst und Prozesssteuerung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worms · Vollzeit · unbefristet · Eintritt nach Vereinbarung
Berichtet direkt an: Head of Sales
Führt: Vertriebsinnendienst und Stabsstelle Vertriebscontrolling

Bei NICO entstehen gute Ergebnisse, wenn Menschen, Prozesse und Informationen zuverlässig zusammenspielen: Kalkulationen müssen stimmen, Angebote sorgfältig vorbereitet, Aufgaben klar verteilt und Entscheidungen durch belastbare Zahlen unterstützt werden.

Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die den Überblick behält, Zusammenhänge schnell erfasst und gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Menschen gute Lösungen entwickelt. Sie schaffen so viel Struktur wie nötig und halten Abläufe so einfach wie möglich.

Aufgaben

Ihre Rolle: Sie führen den Vertriebsinnendienst sowie die Stabsstelle Vertriebscontrolling fachlich und disziplinarisch. Dabei verantworten Sie die Organisation und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Vertriebsprozesse. Klassische Kundenbetreuung steht nicht im Mittelpunkt dieser Position.

Sie koordinieren den Gesamtprozess – von Kalkulation und Angebot über Auftrag, Beschaffung und Lieferung bis zu Rechnung, Auswertung und Nachbereitung. Sie sorgen dafür, dass Zuständigkeiten geklärt sind, Informationen fließen und Entscheidungen auf verlässlichen Daten beruhen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Sie führen Ihr Team klar, wertschätzend und nah am Arbeitsalltag.

  • Sie steuern und verbessern die internen Vertriebsprozesse über alle Prozessschritte hinweg.

  • Sie koordinieren insbesondere die Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Buchhaltung und Logistik und beziehen IT sowie weitere beteiligte Bereiche rechtzeitig ein.

  • Sie klären Zuständigkeiten, Übergaben, Freigaben und Vertretungen und verfolgen Vereinbarungen verbindlich nach.

  • Sie erkennen Informationslücken, unnötige Arbeitsschritte und wiederkehrende Fehlerquellen und entwickeln mit den Beteiligten praktikable Lösungen.

  • Sie erstellen und pflegen verständliche Prozessbeschreibungen, Arbeitsanweisungen, Handbücher, Checklisten und Vorlagen.

  • Gemeinsam mit der IT verbessern Sie digitale Ablagen, Ordnerstrukturen, Berechtigungen und die Nutzung vorhandener Systeme.

  • Sie setzen digitale Werkzeuge zur Arbeits- und Projektorganisation ein, um Aufgaben, Termine, Ziele und Verantwortlichkeiten transparent zu machen.

  • Zusammen mit dem Vertriebscontrolling sorgen Sie für aussagekräftige Kennzahlen, nachvollziehbare Auswertungen und eine verlässliche Datengrundlage.

  • Sie prüfen Zahlen auf Plausibilität, erkennen Abweichungen und Zusammenhänge und leiten daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Sie bereiten Informationen für den Head of Sales verständlich auf und geben einen realistischen Überblick über laufende Themen, Entwicklungen und mögliche Engpässe.

  • Auch wenn viel gleichzeitig zusammenkommt, setzen Sie klare Prioritäten und geben Ihrem Team Orientierung.

Qualifikation

Was Sie mitbringen:

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir keine reine Verwaltungskraft, sondern eine Führungspersönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Prozess-, Zahlen- und Datenverständnis.

  • Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertriebsinnendienst, in der Vertriebsorganisation, im Vertriebscontrolling oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion

  • Erfahrung in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Mitarbeitenden

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für kaufmännische Gesamtprozesse – von Kalkulation und Angebot bis zu Lieferung, Rechnung und Auswertung

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der bereichsübergreifenden Prozesskoordination

  • Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, Auswertungen kritisch zu prüfen und verständlich einzuordnen

  • Erfahrung in der Dokumentation, Vereinheitlichung und Verbesserung von Abläufen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP- beziehungsweise Warenwirtschaftssystemen und den gängigen Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel

  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Datenqualität sowie nachvollziehbare Ablage- und Informationsstrukturen

  • Offenheit für digitale und KI-gestützte Werkzeuge und ein gutes Gespür dafür, wo diese Abläufe vereinfachen und die Qualität der Arbeit verbessern können

  • Eine verbindliche Kommunikation, ein respektvoller Führungsstil und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind hilfreich

Wie wir zusammenarbeiten möchten

Wir wünschen uns eine Führungskraft, die zuhört, nachfragt und die Erfahrung ihres Teams einbezieht. Gleichzeitig erwarten wir, dass Sie Entscheidungen treffen, Prioritäten setzen und vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent umsetzen.

Agile Zusammenarbeit bedeutet für uns ganz praktisch: Aufgaben sichtbar machen, Verantwortlichkeiten klären, sich regelmäßig abstimmen und Verbesserungen Schritt für Schritt umsetzen.

Zahlen verstehen wir dabei nicht als Selbstzweck. Sie sollen Entwicklungen sichtbar machen, Ursachen erkennen lassen und bessere Entscheidungen ermöglichen.

Was Sie bei der NICO erwartet

Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit direkter Anbindung an den Head of Sales und spürbarem Einfluss auf die Zusammenarbeit im Unternehmen.

Sie treffen auf erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen, bestehende Strukturen und den gemeinsamen Wunsch, Abläufe transparenter, einfacher und verlässlicher zu gestalten. Dabei sollen Sie nicht vom ersten Tag an fertige Antworten liefern. Uns ist wichtig, dass Sie zunächst verstehen, dann bewerten und anschließend gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten die richtigen Veränderungen umsetzen.

Wir bieten Ihnen eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle an unserem Standort in Worms, eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung, kurze Abstimmungswege und eine der Verantwortung angemessene Vergütung.

Benefits

Warum Sie bei uns gut aufgehoben sind

  • Ein motiviertes, kollegiales Team mit 10 Personen am Standort Worms, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt

  • Ein Familienunternehmen, das Stabilität, Bodenständigkeit und kurze Entscheidungswege vereint

  • Gestaltungsspielraum und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – besonders im Bereich Prozesse

  • Ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag in einer spannenden und dynamischen Branche

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten, modernes Zeiterfassungs-/ Abwesenheitssystem, regelmäßige Teammeetings und Firmenevents

  • monatliche Sachbezüge als Gutschein, die Ihnen nach der Probezeit zusätzliche Vorteile im Alltag bieten

Wir möchten Sie kennenlernen

Uns interessiert nicht nur Ihr Lebenslauf. Erzählen Sie uns auch, wie Sie führen, welche Prozesse Sie bereits verbessert haben und wie Sie Zahlen und Daten für gute Entscheidungen nutzen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

title: MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer to help us in our mission by supporting the electrical design, development, maintenance and documentation of test equipment and automated functional tests required to verify our spacecraft, engineering models and test beds, to ensure that our mission will succeed and our system will work in space!

Key Responsibilities

In your role as a MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, your role will include the following responsibilities:

  • Define and assess electrical test equipment and functional test needs for flight hardware as well as engineering models and test beds

  • Translate system and subsystem requirements into traceable functional test procedures, sequences and objective pass/fail criteria

  • Design, build, troubleshoot and maintain electrical test equipment and its software, with a focus on electrical engineering and test interfaces

  • Develop and integrate electrical test equipment, instrumentation, cabling and interfaces for power, communication and measurement activities

  • Develop and maintain automated functional test software, scripts and data acquisition for electrical test equipment

  • Prepare and maintain test documentation, including schematics, interface definitions, procedures, test results and verification evidence

  • Support and perform unit-, subsystem- and system-level electrical and functional tests on engineering and flight hardware

  • Analyze test results, troubleshoot anomalies, document non-conformances and support their resolution and retest

  • Manufacture and assemble test-equipment components

  • Participate in environmental tests and launch campaigns.


What we would love to see from you

In the role of MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, ideally you will bring the following skillset, mentality and experience:

  • Degree in aerospace engineering, electrical engineering or comparable qualification

  • Practical experience with electrical/electronic components and systems, ideally in spacecraft AIT or functional verification

  • Experience developing functional tests from requirements, including test procedures, acceptance criteria, traceability and test-data review

  • Theoretical understanding as well as practical experience with electrical test equipment and test interfaces:

    • Electrical design and integration of test equipment, including instrumentation, cabling, connectors, and power and signal interfaces

    • Physical assembly of test equipment (building racks, routing cables, etc.)

    • Familiarity with network configuration and network protocols (TCP/IP) used by test systems

  • Ability to develop software for test equipment and automated functional tests in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand; experience with Python or similar is an asset

  • Experience with data acquisition, test automation and troubleshooting on electrical test equipment

  • Exposure to Mission Control Software platforms like CCS5, COSMOS or similar; experience with COSMOS is a plus

  • Experience with communication and power test equipment is an asset

  • Ability to read, understand and apply technical manuals, data reports, electrical schematics and design specifications

  • Willingness to work hands-on with flight hardware

  • Joy in embracing technical problems and the process of solving them

  • Sense of responsibility and a clean and organized way of working

  • Fluent in written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel worldwide for test and launch campaigns.

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. title: Marketing Intern
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Most people have no idea what benefits they actually have. And most of the teams running those benefits spend their week managing them in spreadsheets. Both of those are problems AI can help solve.

Ben is the agentic benefits platform for global enterprise. One system across every market, with AI doing the checking and the chasing so the people can do the deciding. We're seven years in, we built it from scratch, and there's a lot left to solve.

Your Mission

As Ben's Marketing Intern, you'll turn marketing strategy into the things people actually see. The direction is set — the positioning, the argument, who we're talking to. Your job is to make the work that carries it: the posts, the pages, the campaign assets, the video clips.

You'll sit with the marketing team for twelve months and learn from how great marketing actually gets made. You’ll get to experience the whole process: from the argument to the thing that ships: the report, the posts, the pages, the ad variants, the clips, the event stand. At a bigger company you'd get one of those. Here you get all of it, and quick, direct feedback from experts who care how it's done.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Content production and reuse: taking a report, a podcast episode or an article and building the posts, emails, pages and sales assets that carry it

  • Social: owning the company page calendar, and making it easier for our execs and the wider team to post

  • Website and SEO housekeeping: on-page fixes, metadata, internal linking, blog uploads, and the audit items that never reach the top of anyone's list

  • Event and campaign creative build: turning a concept into the invites, stand copy, follow-ups and post-event content.

  • Video and podcast support: clips, captions, show notes, distribution

  • Paid and campaign build alongside our demand gen lead: social ad variants and audiences, HubSpot landing pages, forms, emails and lists, and tracking.

You'll Love This Role If You...

  • Have built something of your own. A social account with a following, a YouTube series, a newsletter, a side project. Growing an audience from nothing teaches you how content moves people, and that's most of what we do

  • Can take a brief and improve it. Not follow it to the letter, not rewrite it from scratch. Interpret, then make something

  • Are comfortable with new tools, including AI. You'd rather work out how something functions than wait to be shown

  • Care who's reading. You want to know who's on the other end of the thing you're making. Everything else is teachable

No marketing degree and no marketing experience required. What you've made matters more than where you learned to make it.

Why Join Us?

Most internships hand you a spreadsheet and a coffee order. This one hands you the LinkedIn account.

Benefits

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu einer Marketingkampagne oder einem Projekt, das du eigenständig umgesetzt hast. Was war das Ziel, was hast du getan und was kam dabei heraus? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Wir bauen Roboter für alle, deshalb wollen wir ein Team, das das abbildet. Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten ein und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Marketing und Tech unterrepräsentiert sind. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, aber denkst, das ist dein Job: bewirb dich.

title: Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

You design the mechanics of our robotic hands — from the kinematics of a single finger to a complete hand ready for series production.

Multiple drives, gear trains, tendons, tactile sensors and electronics have to fit into a human-sized envelope while surviving hundreds of thousands of cycles. Every millimetre matters, and almost every design decision affects another discipline.

You work hands-on between CAD, test rig and workshop, and report to the CTO.

What you will do:

  • CAD design. Design components, mechanisms and assemblies within tightly constrained envelopes, owning the design from concept through production release.

  • Mechanism & kinematics. Design finger and thumb kinematics, tendon and spindle drives, joints and bearings. Calculate motion envelopes, trajectories, gripping forces and transmission ratios.

  • Calculation & validation. Validate designs through structural and fatigue calculations, FEA, tolerance stack-ups and GD&T before parts are manufactured.

  • Material selection. Select and qualify materials for lightweight structures, wear surfaces, tendons and elastomeric gripping surfaces, and characterise their behaviour under real loads and contact conditions.

  • Assembly design. Design assemblies for efficient assembly, adjustment-free interfaces, serviceability and repair. Specify the required fixtures and tooling.

  • Design for manufacturing. Design for the intended manufacturing process from the outset — machining, injection moulding, sheet metal, additive manufacturing — balancing cost, tolerances and production volumes.

  • Prototyping & testing. Build prototypes, design test rigs and endurance setups, run cycle and load tests, and drive failures to root cause.

  • Documentation & release. Create drawings and BOMs, manage design changes and configuration, and support product development reviews.

  • Suppliers & production. Work with machine shops, material suppliers and manufacturing partners from first prototype through pilot series and production ramp-up.

  • Cross-functional integration. Work closely with Electronics, Sensors and Software to align packaging, interfaces and load paths across the complete system.

What you bring:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, precision engineering, or a comparable qualification.

  • 5–10 years of experience in mechanical design of precision mechatronic products, including at least one product taken through to series production.

  • Advanced 3D CAD skills in CATIA, NX, SolidWorks, Creo or comparable systems, with confident 2D drawing creation and GD&T.

  • Strong understanding of mechanism design: linkages, gear trains, bearings, shafts, power transmission, backlash and stiffness.

  • Experience with FEA, structural and fatigue analysis, and tolerance calculations as part of everyday design work.

  • Strong knowledge of material selection for lightweight, high-load and wear-critical components.

  • Practical DFM/DFA experience across multiple manufacturing processes.

  • Hands-on mentality — you build the prototype, run the test and analyse the broken part yourself.

  • Fluent in English and German.

Bonus:

  • Experience with robotic hands, grippers, prosthetics or similarly highly integrated mechanisms.

  • Experience with compact drive trains, including planetary, harmonic or cycloidal gearing, spindle drives and actuator integration.

  • Experience with elastomers, soft goods, injection moulding of complex geometries or compliant structures.

  • Experience integrating tactile or force sensors into mechanical structures.

  • Experience with multi-body simulation or topology optimisation.

  • Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066 and mechanical design for collaborative applications.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Member of Technical Staff
descriptionHtml:
About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Product Engineer owns the surfaces people actually work in. A coordinator planning a month of inspections across a fleet of auditors. A reviewer signing off on a technical file. These are dense, stateful workflows where the interface carries real consequences, and where the person using it has done the job for twenty years and will know immediately if the software doesn't understand it.

You own product surface end to end: the interface, the backend that supports it, and the data model underneath. Every customer runs the work differently, so there's no template to fall back on. You decide what the right thing to build is, build it, and are the one who hears about it when it's wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about raw engineering strength than about matching a list of technologies. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, C++ or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, speed and standards are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've built something hard and put it in front of real users. Not a prototype, not a course project. Something that ran, broke, and got fixed.

  • You build genuinely good interfaces, and you can go as deep on the backend as the feature requires.

  • You can hold a complicated workflow in your head and find the version of it that's simple enough to ship.

  • Speed with taste. You ship fast, and you're opinionated about what not to build.

  • You go to the source. You'll read the customer's actual documents, join the actual call, and look at hundreds of real outputs.

Signals we like, none of them required:

founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, early engineer at a startup with a serious engineering culture, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup, design sense you can defend, open source you genuinely maintain.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.
