title: Product Manager - CDI Paris - Theodo Healthcare
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo HealthTech, l'entité experte en santé, nous accompagnons tous les acteurs de la santé dans le développement des dispositifs médicaux digitaux sur-mesure. Grâce à notre expérience du Lean et de la tech, combinées à notre connaissance de la santé, nous concevons et développons des dispositifs médicaux numériques qui s'intègrent dans le parcours de soins des patients (thérapies digitales - DTx, essais cliniques virtualisés, parcours de soins digitalisés). Notre but est de réaliser des produits qui changent la vie de leurs utilisateurs, qu'ils soient soignants ou patients.
Tes futures missions : En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - Hub Santé : lancé par l’Agence du Numérique en Santé en 2024, vise à connecter en temps réel les 83 SAMU, SMUR, SDIS et autres acteurs de l’urgence, dans un écosystème historiquement fragmenté. Accompagnée par une équipe de 3 experts Theodo, l’ANS a déployé une plateforme nationale d’interopérabilité permettant une coordination critique plus fluide et sécurisée. Résultats : +10 SAMU connectés dès la phase pilote, interopérabilité effective sur plusieurs périmètres et conformité HDS maintenue. - Vidal : référence centenaire de l’information médicale, a développé avec Theodo un assistant médical basé sur l’IA générative pour fournir aux professionnels de santé des réponses fiables en un temps record et sécuriser la prescription. En 8 semaines, une équipe de 4 experts Theodo a conçu un POC de chatbot RAG connecté à la base Vidal, capable de réduire le temps de recherche tout en garantissant traçabilité et fiabilité des sources. Objectif : renforcer la confiance des praticiens et faire entrer Vidal dans l’ère du service médical “fonctionnel”. Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client. - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. - Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance. - Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins. - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo HealthTech ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

descriptionHtml:

Nous sommes particulièrement intéressés par les parcours suivants :

Une expérience préalable avec le titre de Product Manager n'est pas indispensable si tu as déjà démontré une capacité à cadrer des besoins, prioriser des développements et piloter des projets Data.

  • Tests de qualité et documentation des données.

  • Python pour l'analyse ou l'automatisation.

📊 Tes compétences Product

✨ Ce qui fera la différence

Nous recherchons particulièrement des profils ayant déjà :

descriptionHtml:

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside 5,000+ customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR with 20%+ monthly growth, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over $116M in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.

The Role

We're hiring our founding London-based Product Specialist to sit at the heart of customer support and product quality. You’ll respond to live support requests, investigate bugs in real time, and work closely with engineering and product to ensure issues are resolved quickly and clearly. You’ll play a key role in keeping our customers unblocked, and helping our team stay fast, focused, and close to user pain.

You'll define what great support looks like in an AI-first world at a hypergrowth company becoming a category leader. The foundation is already in place: customers love the product, relationships are strong, and commercial results speak for themselves. Your opportunity is to scale that into a world-class CS organization alongside a low-ego, collaborative team, working directly with a VP of Customer Success who previously built leading CS organizations at Gong, Slack, and Zendesk.


You Will

  • Respond to incoming support tickets and product questions (Pylon, Slack, email)

  • Investigate live issues, replicate bugs, and gather technical details

  • Create well-scoped bug reports with context, repro steps, and priority guidance

  • Partner with engineering and product to coordinate resolution and track progress

  • Follow up with users once fixes or workarounds are in place

  • Maintain clean documentation, internal tools, and support workflows (Linear, Notion, etc.)

  • Spot recurring themes in feedback and flag insights to product leadership

You Have

  • Have 2–4+ years of experience in support engineering, product ops, customer success, customer experience or customer support at a SaaS company

title: Programmeur MMT / Controleur Qualité - Usine de Wissous
descriptionHtml:
Lieu : Wissous, Essonne (Usine)
Type de contrat : CDI, temps plein
Salaire : Compétitif
Equity : Aligné sur le marché

Présentation du poste :

Vous êtes responsable de l'ensemble du contrôle dimensionnel chez Isembard France - de la programmation MMT (CMM) et du contrôle premier article jusqu'à l'analyse des causes racines des non-conformités et la préparation aux audits.

Vous construisez la fonction métrologie plutôt que d'en hériter. Cela signifie écrire les programmes de contrôle, définir les stratégies de palpage et de références, mettre en place l'étalonnage des moyens de mesure et décider comment les données qualité remontent vers l'usinage et vers MasonOS.

C'est un poste opérationnel, à forte autonomie, au sein d'une équipe fondatrice de quelques personnes. Il n'y a ni services cloisonnés ni passages de relais. Vous programmez, vous mesurez, vous validez.

Responsabilités principales :

  • Développer, programmer et optimiser les gammes de contrôle MMT (PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso ou équivalent) pour des géométries complexes et des tolérances serrées

  • Interpréter les plans, les cotations GD&T et ISO GPS, ainsi que les exigences de contrôle et de documentation spécifiques aux clients

  • Réaliser les contrôles premier article (FAI / EN 9102), les contrôles en cours de production et la validation finale des pièces pour l'aéronautique, la défense, l'énergie et le médical

  • Définir la stratégie de palpage, le bridage et les systèmes de références ; concevoir des montages de contrôle si nécessaire

  • Analyser les données de mesure pour identifier les tendances, les causes racines des non-conformités et les problèmes de capabilité, et ramener les actions correctives jusqu'à la machine

  • Piloter l'étalonnage et le suivi de l'ensemble des moyens de mesure (MMT, calibres, micromètres, pieds à coulisse, colonnes de mesure)

  • Tenir à jour les programmes MMT, les enregistrements de contrôle et la documentation qualité selon les normes EN 9100 / ISO 9001

  • Travailler directement avec nos usineurs et programmeurs FAO pour résoudre les problèmes d'ajustement, de forme et de fonction avant et pendant la production

  • Accompagner les audits clients et de certification, et contribuer à la certification EN 9100 de l'usine

  • Collaborer avec l'équipe logicielle MasonOS pour que les données de contrôle soient capturées et exploitées, pas simplement archivées

Compétences requises :

  • Plusieurs années d'expérience pratique en programmation MMT dans la fabrication de précision, l'aéronautique ou un atelier d'usinage

  • Solide maîtrise pratique de PC-DMIS et/ou Zeiss Calypso

  • Connaissance approfondie du GD&T (ASME Y14.5) et de l'ISO GPS, et aisance dans la lecture des modèles CAO 3D clients

  • Expérience de la documentation de contrôle aéronautique (FAI, AS9102 / EN 9102, inspection à la source)

  • À l'aise sur l'ensemble des moyens de mesure : MMT à portique, outils manuels, calibres, et équipements optiques ou de scanning

  • Capacité à tenir et vérifier des tolérances serrées (±0,01 mm et en deçà si nécessaire)

  • Fort instinct analytique - vous trouvez la cause, pas seulement l'écart

  • À l'aise dans un environnement rapide, à forte autonomie et sans structure établie

Atouts supplémentaires :

  • Expérience de la construction d'une fonction qualité à partir de zéro, ou de l'accompagnement d'un site vers la certification EN 9100 / AS9100

  • Certification GD&T ou qualification en management de la qualité

  • Expérience du palpage en cours d'usinage sur machines 5 axes et de la correction en boucle fermée

  • SPC et analyse statistique de capabilité des procédés

  • Expérience en atelier à forte diversité de pièces et petites à moyennes séries

  • Maîtrise de l'anglais

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Travailler sur des composants critiques pour l'aéronautique et la défense

  • Prendre en main la fonction qualité d'une nouvelle usine dès le premier jour, plutôt qu'un recoin d'une usine existante

  • Accès à des machines-outils de pointe, des équipements de métrologie et une automatisation en constante évolution

  • Participation au capital (equity) d'un réseau d'usines en pleine croissance

  • Opportunité de définir les standards de contrôle à l'échelle du réseau au fur et à mesure de notre développement

  • Culture de haute performance axée sur l'amélioration continue

À propos d'Isembard :

Isembard a pour mission de forger l'accélération industrielle. Nous permettons de fabriquer des produits plus rapidement et à moindre coût pour les industries critiques, en combinant des machines-outils de pointe, la robotique et notre logiciel propriétaire, MasonOS. Les composants que nous fabriquons sont utilisés dans l'aéronautique, la défense, l'énergie et d'autres secteurs stratégiques. Nous construisons un réseau distribué d'usines haute performance au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Allemagne et désormais en France. Notre site français est une nouvelle usine à Wissous, en Essonne, au sud de Paris.

Nos valeurs :

  • Si ce n'est pas maintenant, quand ?

  • Suivre les cinq maximes

  • Humour et humilité

title: Projectmanager Datacenters
descriptionHtml:
Krijg jij energie van het leiden van grote en complexe projecten waarin techniek, samenwerking en commercie samenkomen? Weet jij multidisciplinaire teams mee te nemen en houd je tegelijkertijd grip op kwaliteit, planning, budget en klantbelang? Als Projectmanager Datacenters bij Deerns neem jij de regie over uitdagende advies- en ontwerpprojecten binnen een sector die continu in ontwikkeling is.

De uitdaging

Als Projectmanager Datacenters ben je verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van grote en complexe projecten binnen de datacentersector. Je stuurt multidisciplinaire projectteams aan en zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen de afgesproken kwaliteit, planning en financiële kaders worden gerealiseerd.

Daarbij combineer je projectmanagement met technische inhoud. Je begrijpt wat er binnen de verschillende technische disciplines speelt en weet de juiste specialisten met elkaar te verbinden. Je hoeft niet zelf ieder technisch detail uit te werken, maar bent inhoudelijk sterk genoeg om keuzes te beoordelen, risico's te herkennen en richting te geven aan het project.

De datacenterwereld stelt hoge eisen aan onder andere betrouwbaarheid, energie-efficiëntie en veiligheid. Binnen Deerns werken we aan uiteenlopende projecten, van de ontwikkeling van nieuwe datacenters tot uitbreiding, verduurzaming en renovatie van bestaande locaties.

Je bent daarbij niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor het project zelf. Ook de samenwerking met de opdrachtgever, het financiële resultaat en het herkennen van nieuwe kansen behoren tot jouw rol.

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:

  • Het leiden en aansturen van multidisciplinaire projectteams;

  • Het bewaken van kwaliteit, planning, budget, scope en projectresultaat;

  • Het opstellen en bewaken van projectplannen, planningen, begrotingen en voorstellen;

  • Het organiseren en leiden van kick-offs, project- en coördinatieoverleggen;

  • Het tijdig signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen en hierop gericht bijsturen;

  • Het afstemmen met opdrachtgevers, architecten, aannemers, installateurs en andere projectpartners;

  • Het onderhouden en verder uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties;

  • Het signaleren van commerciële kansen en het bespreken van meerwerk en aanvullende opdrachten;

  • Het bewaken van de financiële voortgang en bijdragen aan een gezonde projectmarge;

  • Het bijdragen aan het verbeteren van projectprocessen en onze manier van samenwerken.

Het team en de projecten

Je wordt onderdeel van een hecht en multidisciplinair team met een gedeelde passie voor datacentertechnologie en duurzame techniek. Binnen het team komen verschillende expertises samen, waaronder werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek, brandveiligheid en duurzaamheid. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en werkplezier staan centraal.

Je werkt aan nationale en internationale projecten voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers binnen de datacenterbranche. Daarbij krijg je te maken met complexe technische vraagstukken en verschillende stakeholders. Geen project is hetzelfde en juist die combinatie van techniek, organisatie en samenwerking maakt deze functie uitdagend.

Door jouw ervaring speel je daarnaast een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s en helpt ons om onze projecten steeds slimmer en efficiënter te organiseren.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een ervaren projectmanager die techniek, mensen en commercie met elkaar weet te verbinden. Ook wanneer projecten complex worden, behoud je het overzicht en weet je de juiste prioriteiten te stellen. Je durft beslissingen te nemen, communiceert gemakkelijk op verschillende niveaus en creëert duidelijkheid voor zowel de opdrachtgever als jouw projectteam.

Je geeft mensen de ruimte om vanuit hun eigen expertise bij te dragen, maar bent duidelijk wanneer richting of besluitvorming nodig is. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het project van vandaag: je begrijpt het belang van duurzame klantrelaties en herkent kansen om onze samenwerking met opdrachtgevers verder uit te bouwen.

Verder beschik je over:

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een technische achtergrond;

  • Ruime ervaring binnen complexe technische ontwerp- en/of adviesprojecten;

  • Bij voorkeur circa 15 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan een belangrijk deel in projectleiding of projectmanagement;

  • Brede multidisciplinaire technische kennis;

  • Ervaring met het aansturen, motiveren en coachen van projectteams;

  • Kennis van projectmanagementmethodieken, planning en financiële projectbeheersing;

  • Kennis van relevante contractuele en bouwrechtelijke aspecten;

  • Commercieel inzicht en ervaring met klant- en stakeholdermanagement;

  • Een resultaatgerichte en oplossingsgerichte manier van werken.

Dit bieden wij

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.623 en € 8.033 (op basis van 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en expertise.

  • Een functie van 32-40 uur per week.

  • Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal.

  • Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht.

  • Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen.

  • Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken.

  • Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan.

Vos principales missions seront :

1- Gestion quotidienne de la tenue de la comptabilité et le bon suivi des obligations :

  • Echanges continus et réguliers avec la comptabilité fournisseur

  • Assurer le bon suivi de l’établissement des déclarations fiscales et des comptes annuels

  • Assurer le bon suivi du juridique annuel

  • Assurer la gestion des déclarations fiscales de l'entreprise (TVA, IS et autres obligations fiscales).

2- Etablissement des clôtures périodiques (dont la semestrielle et l’annuelle sont publiées) :

  • Pour les sociétés dont la tenue comptable est internalisée : établissement de clôture complète en collaboration avec les équipes comptables internes

  • Pour les sociétés françaises dont la tenue est externalisée et les sociétés étrangères : assurer le suivi, la communication et la revue des remontées des informations avec la comptable générale en charge

  • Etablissement et suivi des calendriers de clôtures en collaboration avec le contrôle de gestion

  • Veiller au respect des exigences réglementaires et fiscales

3- Audit et Comptes consolidés :

  • Vous serez le.a garant.e de la bonne réciprocité des comptes inter-compagnies

  • Vous serez l’interlocuteur.trice principal.e auprès de la société qui effectue les comptes consolidés du Groupe.

  • Point de contact pour les auditeurs autant sur les comptes sociaux que sur les comptes consolidés

  • Vous aurez un rôle essentiel dans l’établissement des rapports financiers semestriels et annuels qui sont publiés

  • Vous participerez à la montée en compétence des collaborateurs et à la définition de leur plan de formation

  • Vous serez un soutien de l’équipe pour les tâches quotidiennes

5- Projets Transverses

  • Mise en place de process généralisés et homogénéisés des filiales dont la tenue est internalisée en collaboration avec la Direction financière

  • Déploiement et optimisation des process d'automatisation comptable

  • Participer aux projets d'amélioration des processus et des systèmes financiers

  • Véritable référent(e) comptable, vous êtes capable de garantir la fiabilité des comptes tout en accompagnant les évolutions d'une organisation en croissance.

title: Quantum Algorithms Researcher (Senior/Staff)
descriptionHtml:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real. 

Job Summary:

PsiQuantum is seeking a Senior Quantum Algorithms Researcher to join the Quantum Algorithms team within our Applications Development department. This role offers the opportunity to help define how large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers will be applied to consequential real-world problems in chemistry, pharmaceuticals, and materials science.  

At PsiQuantum, we believe in the transformative potential of quantum computing to solve problems beyond the reach of classical computation. For the first quantum computers to be useful, we believe they must be fault tolerant. 

This conviction shapes our approach to applications research. Rather than developing algorithms for near-term or intermediate-scale devices, we focus on quantum algorithms designed for the fault-tolerant regime, where, specifically, the cost of a quantum algorithm is determined by its runtime on a fusion-based, fault-tolerant quantum computer built on silicon photonic hardware. 

In the Quantum Algorithms team, we adapt and develop quantum algorithms, scope and identify promising use cases, and analyze resource requirements. In your role, you will translate computational tasks into abstract specifications for quantum algorithms, analyze their asymptotic performance, and help define meaningful problem instances that lie beyond the practical reach of classical computation. You will also work closely with PsiQuantum’s Compilation team to develop explicit instantiations of these algorithms and understand their resource requirements on our architecture. 

We are particularly interested in candidates with deep expertise in quantum simulation. Relevant areas may include simulated time-evolution algorithms, quantum algorithms for estimating the energies of molecular or periodic systems, and methods for preparing candidate ground states of model Hamiltonians. More broadly, the successful candidate will bring substantial expertise in a specific subfield of quantum algorithms, together with the ability to connect fundamental algorithmic research to computationally and industrially relevant problems. 

In this position, you will be expected not only to conduct outstanding individual research but also to formulate and lead broader research programs that encompass the work of other researchers and collaborators. You will contribute to cross-team initiatives across PsiQuantum’s applications, architecture, and compilation efforts, helping to connect algorithm design with the practical requirements of fault-tolerant quantum computation. 

The role may also include external engagements. You will have the opportunity to lead projects with industrial and research partners, working with domain experts to identify important computational challenges, extract well-defined problem formulations, and map those problems to appropriate quantum algorithms. This requires the ability to communicate across disciplinary boundaries and to move fluently between real-world applications, mathematical abstractions, algorithmic complexity, and implementation-level resource analysis. 

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with scientific leadership, intellectual independence, and a strong collaborative mindset. They will be comfortable shaping open-ended research directions, evaluating the practical significance of algorithmic advances, and guiding projects from the initial identification of an application through to a concrete fault-tolerant quantum algorithm and resource estimate. 

Responsibilities:

  • Propose initiatives into research and development of quantum algorithms tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computers; act as primary contributor to research programs beyond the current state of the art in quantum algorithms design.
  • Work closely with external partners to instantiate, validate and optimize quantum algorithms for use cases across a variety of domains, such as life sciences, industry and sustainability.
  • Establish families of benchmarks and problem instances to validate post-classicality of quantum algorithms.
  • Guide both the simulation and analysis of resource requirements for fault tolerant implementation of quantum algorithms in photonic quantum computing.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of research experience (academia or industry) in the field of quantum computing, with focus on algorithms and applications.  
  • A degree in Physics, Math or Computer Science or equivalent is required. PhD in Physics, Math or Computer Science, with a focus on quantum information theory or quantum computation will be preferred. 
  • Experience with quantum algorithms and compiling in the regime of fault tolerant gates preferred .
  • Experience working with partners in academia or industry to analyze real-world quantum applications of interest preferred.
  • Proven team player with an ability to work effectively across departments, sites and time zones.
  • Ability to work independently and contribute to fast-moving start-up environment. 
  • Experience programming in Python, C++ or similar languages.

title: Infrastructure / Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Remote (Australia or New Zealand)

Type: Full-time, remote

About Neuphonic

Neuphonic is building the next generation of voice AI, making natural, real-time speech accessible across devices, languages, and applications.

Our technology enables ultra-low-latency text-to-speech, voice cloning, and multilingual speech generation. We're pushing the boundaries of what's possible with speech models, from high-performance cloud inference to running AI directly on everyday devices without expensive GPUs or an internet connection.

We're a small, ambitious team of researchers and engineers building technology used by developers and businesses around the world. Our open-source releases have reached millions of downloads, and we're growing quickly.

Why we're hiring

As our customer base grows, we need to scale our production infrastructure while maintaining the performance, reliability, and low latency that our products depend on.

We're looking for an Infrastructure / Platform Engineer to take ownership of our cloud infrastructure and inference systems. You'll work closely with our engineering and ML teams to build scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient systems.

A key part of this role is extending our production support coverage beyond UK working hours. We're hiring in Australia or New Zealand to help us work towards 24/7 support for our production customers, so we're looking for someone comfortable taking ownership of live systems, responding to incidents, and making independent technical decisions.

Importantly, this isn't just about keeping our systems running. We want someone who will actively look for ways to improve how we build, deploy, and serve our models, continually experimenting, optimising, and evolving our infrastructure as we scale.

What you'll own

  • Cloud infrastructure: Build, manage, and scale our production infrastructure across GCP and GPU cloud providers using Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform.

  • Inference optimisation: Continuously improve inference performance, latency, throughput, GPU utilisation, and infrastructure costs through profiling, experimentation, and iteration, rather than simply maintaining the status quo.

  • Platform evolution: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in how we build, deploy, and serve models, and take ownership of implementing improvements.

  • Production reliability: Monitor critical systems, respond to incidents, and help ensure reliable service for our customers outside UK working hours.

  • Infrastructure architecture: Make autonomous technical decisions that balance scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.

  • CI/CD and automation: Improve deployment pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and observability.

  • Security and enterprise readiness: Support secure infrastructure practices and enterprise deployment requirements.

What we're looking for

  • Strong experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure at scale, ideally supporting applications with significant user traffic.

  • Hands-on experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Python.

  • Experience with CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and production incident response.

  • A strong understanding of infrastructure performance, scalability, and cost optimisation.

  • Experience participating in on-call rotations or taking responsibility for production incidents.

  • A proactive approach to engineering, with experience identifying bottlenecks, experimenting with improvements, and optimising production systems.

  • Comfortable working autonomously, making architectural decisions, and taking ownership of critical systems.

  • Based in Australia or New Zealand and comfortable providing production support during agreed hours that complement our UK and India engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI/ML inference, GPU infrastructure, or vLLM.

  • Experience hosting audio, speech, or real-time AI applications.

  • Experience with C++.

  • Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other security compliance frameworks.

  • Experience with private cloud or on-premise enterprise deployments.

Who you'll work with

You'll work directly with our engineering and ML teams, helping shape the infrastructure behind Neuphonic's production models and services.

We're a small team, so you'll have real ownership and the freedom to make meaningful technical decisions. We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and enjoy building systems that work reliably in the real world.

You'll collaborate closely with our UK and India teams, with clear handovers between time zones to help ensure our production customers are supported around the clock.

Pennylane wächst international: Nach Frankreich bauen wir unsere Websites und Conversion-Funnels für Spanien, Deutschland und die USA aus. Deutschland ist dabei ein strategischer Fokusmarkt. Dafür suchen wir dich: Du entwickelst die deutsche Website als eigenständiges Produkt weiter – mit einem klaren Blick auf den Markt, unsere Zielgruppen und ihre Bedürfnisse.

Du wirst Teil unseres Website-Teams im Bereich Growth und berichtest direkt an den Head of Growth. Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineers und Designern arbeitest du in einer festen Squad. Dabei bist du täglich mittendrin, packst selbst mit an und bringst Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit deinem Team live.

Deine Mission

Du verantwortest und optimierst die Conversion-Rate unserer Websites für den deutschen Markt: pennylane.com/de und start.pennylane.com. Für jede Zielgruppe schaffst du ein passendes Nutzererlebnis: Selbstständige, kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, größere Mittelständler und Steuerkanzleien.

Von der ersten Analyse bis zur umgesetzten Verbesserung liegt der gesamte Prozess bei dir. Du erkennst Hürden, entwickelst die Strategie, testest neue Ansätze und machst ihren Erfolg messbar.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Conversion optimieren und kontinuierlich experimentieren

  • Du entwickelst die Conversion-Strategie für den deutschen Funnel – von der Startseite über Preis- und Produktseiten bis zur Demo-Buchung und eigenständigen Registrierung.

  • Du treibst einen kontinuierlichen A/B-Testprozess voran: Ideen entwickeln, Tests planen, live bringen, auswerten und weiterentwickeln. Laufende Experimente gehören für dich zum Alltag.

  • Mit Analytics, Heatmaps und Verhaltensanalysen identifizierst du Hürden und Potenziale entlang der Nutzerreise, unter anderem mit Amplitude und Tracking-Daten.

  • Du führst ein umfassendes CRO-Audit der deutschen Website durch und vergleichst Funnel, Preisseite und Startseite mit führenden B2B-Websites.

2. Die deutsche Website als Produkt weiterentwickeln

  • Du verantwortest die Roadmap der deutschen Website und priorisierst nach Wirkung und Umsetzbarkeit.

  • Du entwickelst das Portal für Steuerkanzleien, die Marketplace-Integration und den Demo-Buchungsprozess für den deutschen Markt weiter.

  • Du verantwortest unser CMS Contentful: von einer klaren Struktur über wiederverwendbare Komponenten bis zum Aufbau neuer Seiten.

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering verantwortest du den gesamten Self-Service-Registrierungsprozess für Deutschland: das deutsche Formular, die automatische Ergänzung von Unternehmensdaten und eindeutige Unternehmenszuordnung über Northdata, die Datenübertragung an Salesforce und die Kontoerstellung über die Produkt-API.

3. Die Umsetzung im Team vorantreiben

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit von UX, Engineering und Data – mit einem priorisierten Backlog, klaren Spezifikationen, konsequenter Nachverfolgung und Qualitätssicherung.

  • Du moderierst Weeklys, Dailys und Retros und sorgst dafür, dass Tickets zügig von der Planung bis zur Veröffentlichung vorankommen.

  • Du koordinierst Content, Product Marketing und Lokalisierung: von der KI-gestützten Übersetzung über die Prüfung durch Muttersprachler bis zur Integration ins CMS.

  • Du nutzt KI, um Prozesse und Reporting zu automatisieren.

4. Teams und Stakeholder zusammenbringen

  • Du arbeitest eng mit SEO, SEA, Content, Product Marketing, Product, Legal und dem deutschen Marktteam zusammen – unter anderem an Landingpages zu RFE, Compte Pro und E-Rechnung.

  • Du bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Kurs und gewinnst ihre Unterstützung, auch ohne disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung.

  • Du kommunizierst Prioritäten, Zeitpläne und wichtige Neuerungen klar und teamübergreifend.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung mit messbarer Wirkung: Du hast 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management oder in der Conversion-Rate-Optimierung, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS- oder B2C-Umfeld. Du hast Features von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet und kannst anhand konkreter Kennzahlen zeigen, was sich dadurch verbessert hat.

  • Eigenständiger Umgang mit Daten und CRO-Tools: Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie Amplitude, GA4, Contentsquare oder Hotjar. Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, erkennst Muster und leitest Hypothesen ab, ohne auf eine Analyse durch andere angewiesen zu sein.

  • Fundierte A/B-Testing-Kenntnisse: Du weißt, wie du die nötige Stichprobengröße bestimmst, eine klare Erfolgskennzahl definierst und typische Fehler vermeidest – etwa Tests aufgrund vorläufiger Ergebnisse zu früh zu beenden oder mit zu kleinen Stichproben zu arbeiten.

  • Klare Kommunikation: Du schreibst präzise Briefings für Designer, erklärst Priorisierungsentscheidungen auch gegenüber skeptischen Stakeholdern und präsentierst Ergebnisse verständlich für ein nichttechnisches Publikum.

  • Sprachkenntnisse und Marktverständnis: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder vergleichbarem Niveau und kennst den deutschen Markt. Für die internationale Zusammenarbeit bringst du verhandlungssicheres Englisch mit. Französisch ist ein Plus.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

title: Regional Field CTO
locations: EMEA, Remote (Black Duck has entities in UK, Germany, Netherlands, Italy, Ireland, Finland, Sweden)
descriptionHtml:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Regional Field Chief Technology Officer

Location: EMEA, Remote (Black Duck has entities in UK, Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy, Ireland, Finland, Sweden)

Black Duck® meets the board-level risks of modern software with True Scale Application Security, ensuring uncompromised trust in software for the regulated, AI-powered world. Only Black Duck solutions free organizations from tradeoffs between speed, accuracy, and compliance at scale while eliminating security, regulatory, and licensing risks. Whether in the cloud or on premises, Black Duck is the only choice for securing mission-critical software everywhere code happens. With Black Duck, security leaders can make smarter decisions and unleash business innovation with confidence.

We are looking for a Regional Field Chief Technology Officer to serve as a senior technical executive, trusted advisor, and public voice of our technology strategy in the market. In this role, the Regional Field CTO will operate at the intersection of technology, sales, and the customer — engaging directly with C-level and technical leaders at our most strategic customer accounts, translating our AI-driven platform capabilities into credible technical narratives, and representing the company as a thought leader across the industry. This is a customer-facing, pre-sales technical leadership role reporting to the VP of Sales Engineering, with a dotted line to Product & Technology.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as trusted technical advisor and recurring executive sponsor for C-level and senior technical stakeholders at strategic, enterprise, federal and other key accounts — pivoting fluidly between business strategy conversations, risk, compliance, and deep technical architecture reviews.
  • Lead highly visible, multidisciplinary technical engagements of strategic importance across the region, including executive briefings, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, customer advisory feedback loops, and partner or analyst-facing discussions.
  • Represent Black Duck as a technical evangelist for the platform and roadmap within a region, delivering keynotes, webinars, whitepapers, and thought leadership content at industry events, and representing the company externally with press, analysts, and partners.
  • Translate Black Duck platform AI/ML, detection engine, and platform architecture capabilities into clear, credible narratives for both technical and executive audiences, speaking candidly to responsible AI practices such as data privacy, model governance, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Partner with Sales and Presales leadership on the region’s most strategic and enterprise opportunities, leading technical deep-dives, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, and executive briefings, and advising on the technical implications of new product launches, roadmap changes, and competitive positioning.
  • Support RFPs and security questionnaires with authoritative technical input, and articulate competitive and technical differentiation, including nuanced comparisons of AI/ML capabilities against alternatives in the market.
  • Proactively engage strategic accounts to strengthen technical trust, identify expansion opportunities, mitigate renewal risk, and guide customers toward secure software development and application security maturity.
  • Identify and solve problems of strategic or industry scope, using innovative approaches to remove technical barriers, strengthen customer confidence, and improve business outcomes.
  • Provide field-informed guidance on emerging AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, application security trends, and competitive market dynamics that may influence Black Duck strategy or customer adoption.
  • Capture, synthesize, and escalate regional customer, partner, and market feedback into actionable input for Product, Engineering, and Sales systematically capturing technical objections and influencing the roadmap, packaging, launch readiness, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Coach, enable, and review technical storytelling by sales engineers and account executives, including how to explain AI features accurately without overclaiming.

Qualifications and Experience Required:

  • 15+ years in a senior technical leadership role (CTO, Sales Engineering leader, Principal Architect, or equivalent), including several years in a customer-facing or field/pre-sales capacity.
  • Proven track record engaging and influencing C-level and senior technical audiences at enterprise organizations, with demonstrated success across complex enterprise sales cycles.
  • Domain expertise in application security (SAST, SCA, DAST), enterprise architecture, cloud/SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and security best practices.
  • Deep, practical understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, large language models, behavioral analytics, AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows), along with a candid grasp of their limitations and the practical limitations and controls needed for responsible adoption.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating with and influencing executive leadership, significant customers, partners, analysts, or vendors to shape technical decisions and business outcomes.
  • Ability to exercise wide latitude in determining objectives and approaches for complex, critical assignments with material regional, functional, or market impact.
  • Experience shaping standards, methods, practices, or market-facing technical narratives within an industry or discipline.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear stories for both executive and highly technical audiences, including customers, partners, press, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated industry presence — conference speaking, published thought leadership, active contribution to industry/analyst communities, customer advisory leadership, or comparable external technical influence.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to customer sites and industry events.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA or other advanced degree.

title: Senior Financial Analyst

title: Senior Mobile Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

What you'll be doing

Own the mobile test strategy:

  • Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

  • Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

  • Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.

Build reliable E2E automation:

  • Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

  • Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe.

  • Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green.

Bring AI into the SDLC:

  • Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes.

  • Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on.

  • Help shape how the mobile team uses AI-assisted workflows more broadly - prompts, guardrails, review patterns.

Prevent defects, not just catch them:

  • Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written.

  • Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact.

  • Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call.

What we're looking for

Essential:

  • Hands-on experience with Maestro or Detox.

  • 6+ years in quality engineering or test automation, with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests.

  • Experience introducing AI-assisted testing practices (test generation, failure clustering, coverage analytics) with sensible controls around review and trust.

  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript - not just writing test scripts, but building helpers, tooling, and debugging into the app when needed.

  • Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control.

  • Comfortable with mobile E2E automation, or strong E2E experience on another platform plus a credible plan for getting productive on mobile quickly.

  • Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting).

Desirable:

  • Hands-on experience testing React Native apps.

  • Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness).

  • API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy.

Our tech stack

Mobile: TypeScript, React Native, Expo, EAS, GraphQL, Relay, Jest, React Testing Library, Maestro.

Backend: Kotlin, PHP 8 (Symfony), AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  1. Quick call with a Recruiter

  2. 15 minute cognitive test

  3. Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  4. Technical interview (90 minutes)

  5. Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

descriptionHtml:

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

  

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

  

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. title: Research Engineer - Web Crawlers
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on large-scale web crawling for our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the crawling systems that source world-class data from the open web. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

  • Building and operating large-scale, distributed web crawlers that discover, fetch, and extract data across billions of pages reliably and efficiently.

  • Solving hard crawling problems such as content extraction from messy HTML, deduplication at web scale, freshness and recrawl strategies, and politeness and rate-limit handling.

  • Designing targeted crawling pipelines that find high-value data sources, including audio, video, and multilingual content, and turn them into clean training-ready datasets.

  • Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers request, monitor, and explore newly crawled web data quickly and reliably.

 

Requirements

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

  • Hands-on experience building and scaling web crawlers or scraping systems, ideally in support of machine learning training data.

  • Strong engineering skills in distributed systems at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, queue-based architectures, or custom pipelines processing billions of documents).

  • The capacity to autonomously evaluate the quality, coverage, and compliance of crawled data, and to build the tooling to measure it.

 

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

title: Revenue Enablement Manager (m/f/d), Just-in-Time Enablement
descriptionHtml:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!

About the role

Every month, something new reaches our field teams from Product, Product Marketing and Marketing: a new use case, a fresh sales narrative, a campaign, a product update. Too often it arrives as a Slack post or a long deck, and sellers never really pick it up.

As Revenue Enablement Manager, Just-in-Time Enablement, you own that last mile. You are the front door between the teams who create news and the teams who use it, and you make sure every launch reaches Sales, Customer Success and Partnerships across Europe at the right time, in a format they can use in their next conversation.

What you'll do:

  • Run the launch intake. Be the single entry point for PMM, Product, Marketing and others who want something to reach the field. Prioritize with clear criteria so sellers aren't overloaded.

  • Own the field release calendar. Keep one view of what's coming, when, and for whom, shared with creators and sales managers.

  • Turn launches into what sellers need. Shape each release into: what's new, who it's for, why customers care, how to talk about it, and how to handle the likely questions.

  • Coach the creators. Brief PMM, Product and Marketing on what the field needs and review their materials before they go out. When the input is raw (specs, messaging docs, long decks), write the enablement content yourself: short, clear and practical.

  • Deliver just in time. Pick the right format and moment: a 20-minute live session, a short recording, a one-pager, a talk track. Not so early it's forgotten, not so late it's useless.

  • Make it stick. Run practice sessions, give managers simple talking points, and check that sellers can explain the new thing in their own words.

  • Check it landed. Track attendance, usage in calls and deals, and rep feedback. Share what you learn with the creators so the next launch is better.

  • Keep one home for launch material. Everything findable in one place with an owner and a review date; retire what's outdated.

  • Hand over to curriculum. Work closely with your colleagues in the revenue enablement team, who fold a launch into the regular training once it is no longer new. Agree what moves over, when, and in what form, so nothing is built twice.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years in revenue enablement, product marketing, sales training or a similar role in B2B SaaS, ideally at a scaleup.

  • Experience rolling out launches, messaging or campaigns to sales teams, with examples you can share.

  • Ability to explain a product use case or sales narrative simply, and to spot what a seller really needs from it.

  • Strong stakeholder skills: you can say "not this month", ask for a 3-slide version of a 40-slide deck, and keep the relationship strong.

  • Well organized: you juggle several launches at once and hit dates.

  • Clear writing and confident live facilitation.

  • Hands-on with LMS, AI, video editing tools, a CRM and call recording tools, and a habit of using data to check adoption.

  • Fluent English and German.

Nice to have:

  • Background in product marketing or product management.

  • Experience with security, compliance or HR-related products.

  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as SPICED or MEDDICC.

How success looks like:

First 30 days: learn

  • Meet the leads in PMM, Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Learn how launches reach the field today and where they get lost.

  • Review the last 3-5 launches: what reached the field and what stuck.

  • Agree which upcoming launches come first and who owns what, intake process and readiness gates.

Days 31-60: set up and pilot

  • Start the launch intake and a first field release calendar.

  • Take 1-2 launches through the process, writing the enablement content from the raw input.

  • Agree with the Curriculum team how a launch moves into regular training once it's no longer new.

Days 61-90: prove and adjust

  • Run 2-3 launches end to end; sellers can explain each one in their own words within two weeks of release.

  • Collect feedback from reps, managers and creators, and fix what slowed things down.

  • Share first results with leadership (reach, use in real calls) and a plan for the next quarter.

Who you'll work with:

  • Reports to the Head of Revenue Enablement.

  • Product Marketing and Product, who own the narratives and use cases.

  • Marketing, who run campaigns that sellers need to follow up on.

  • Sales, Customer Success and Partnerships leaders and frontline managers, who receive and reinforce the message.

  • The Curriculum team in Revenue Enablement, who take over launch content for the long-term training programs.

  • Revenue Operations for tools and data.

What we offer*:

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

title: Sales Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build the top of our sales funnel. You will be the first point of contact for many of our future customers: fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions looking to modernise their compliance operations.

Your mission will be to identify, engage and qualify high-potential prospects, and to book meetings for our Account Executives. You will work hand in hand with Sales and the Growth team to test new outreach strategies, sharpen our messaging and turn what works into a repeatable pipeline engine.

The position is based in London, with a hybrid remote policy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect & qualify leads: identify and engage potential customers through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn and other channels

  • Educate & build interest: communicate our value proposition and show how Dotfile helps fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions streamline onboarding, strengthen compliance and scale efficiently

  • Fuel the sales funnel: book qualified meetings with high-potential prospects for our Account Executives

  • Collaborate with Sales & Growth: work closely with AEs and the Growth team to refine targeting, messaging and sequences, and to improve conversion rates

  • Track & optimise performance: keep accurate records in our CRM (HubSpot) and keep improving your outreach based on data and feedback

About you

  • You have at least 1 year of experience in a similar role, ideally in fintech, regtech or a fast-growing tech company selling to fintechs, crypto companies or financial institutions

  • Knowledge of the AML, KYC/KYB or risk management space is a strong plus

  • You are familiar with structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message…)

  • You have strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to your work

  • You are fluent in English and in a second language (French preferably), with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

What we offer

  • A front row seat at a fast-growing startup with global ambitions

  • Hybrid remote policy with an office in Paris

The interview process

Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

Round 2: Deep dive into your past experiences and the choices that shaped your career.

Round 3: Case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - Mainland Europe
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara’s platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar

  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
