  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills 
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, Germany or Remote, France 
  • Language requirement: Fluent German or Fluent French 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Greenfield covers two distinct motions: Early Stage, focused on activation and meaningful expansion, and Pursuits, focused on high-stakes conversion of the startups with highest potential and new customers with complex buying decisions.

You will translate regional strategy into clear account priorities, hire and develop Account Directors, and coach the customer and commercial work appropriate to the team you lead. You will work closely with technical partners and VC Partnerships to turn founder access and technical engagement into customer value, qualified pipeline and consumption revenue.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week.

  • Build and execute the Greenfield GTM strategy and sales plan for your team. Prioritise companies using customer need, workload, decision timing, founder and funding signals, commercial potential and available technical capacity.

  • Coach the motion your sellers own. For Early Stage, strengthen discovery, activation, first production use and initial growth. For Pursuits, strengthen competitive strategy, executive access, evaluation, migration planning and negotiation.

  • Create a disciplined pipeline and consumption forecasting rhythm. Connect opportunity stages and revenue expectations to customer evidence, production milestones and specific next decisions.

  • Coordinate account transitions with Core and strategic coverage. Preserve customer context, relationships and the next growth plan, and keep ownership clear until a handoff is accepted.

You need to be comfortable with ambiguity and creating clarity and direction in an ever-changing landscape and priorities. You are curious about AI, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to learn quickly. You enjoy developing sellers and building systems that make a growing team more effective.

Your team reaches the right startups early, advances customers into meaningful production use and builds a healthy path to customer value and growth. Qualified pursuits progress through clear technical and commercial decisions. Sellers become more capable, forecasts become more reliable, and the team scales its reach through repeatable programmes and effective handoffs.

Die Investitionsbank Schleswig-Holstein (IB.SH) ist das zentrale Förderinstitut des Landes. Rund 900 Menschen sorgen in Kiel dafür, dass Wohnungsbau, Unternehmen, Kommunen, Bildung sowie Umwelt- und Energieprojekte in Schleswig-Holstein vorankommen.

Gerade läuft eine der größten Transformationen in der Geschichte der Bank. Die gesamte SAP-Landschaft zieht auf S/4HANA um, die Private-Cloud-Umgebung steht bereits, und bis Ende 2027 soll das neue System produktiv sein.

Für diese Phase sucht die IB.SH Verstärkung im SAP-Team: eine:n SAP-Entwickler:in (w/m/d) mit Schwerpunkt ABAP, Batch-Verarbeitung und Schnittstellen. Du arbeitest in einem vierköpfigen Team, das eng mit drei weiteren SAP-Teams zusammenarbeitet. Bei der IB.SH gibt es keine Trennung zwischen Beratung und Entwicklung, du begleitest deine Themen also vom ersten Gespräch mit dem Fachbereich bis zum laufenden Betrieb.

Deine Aufgaben

Du baust das, was nachts läuft, und sorgst dafür, dass die Bank am nächsten Morgen damit arbeiten kann.

  • Du entwickelst SAP-Lösungen in ABAP und ABAP-OO, von der ersten Idee über Prototypen bis zur produktiven Anwendung.

  • Du steuerst und optimierst die Batch-Verarbeitung, planst Jobabläufe und überführst Anwendungen in die Hintergrundverarbeitung.

  • Du betreust Schnittstellen rund um Zahlungsverkehr, Korrespondenz, FICO und die Schufa-Anbindung sowie zu den bankfachlichen SAP-Modulen.

  • Du bearbeitest IT-Changes und Störungen eigenverantwortlich, von der Analyse über Tests bis zur Freigabe.

  • Du berätst die Fachbereiche der Bank, nimmst Anforderungen auf und übersetzt sie in technische Lösungen.

  • Du gestaltest die Umstellung auf S/4HANA aktiv mit und bringst deine Erfahrung in Projekte ein.

Was du mitbringst

Du bist ein IT-Mensch durch und durch, arbeitest aber nicht still im Hintergrund, sondern gern im Austausch mit den Menschen, für die du entwickelst.

Must-haves

  • Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im IT-Umfeld, oder einen vergleichbaren Weg in die IT

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der SAP-Entwicklung mit ABAP und ABAP-OO

  • Praxis in der Batch-Verarbeitung, egal mit welchem Tool

  • Erfahrung mit SAP-Schnittstellen und der Bearbeitung von IT-Changes und Tickets

  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und eine klare Kommunikation

  • Analytisches Denken, eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung im Banken- oder Finanzumfeld

  • Kenntnisse in bankfachlichen SAP-Modulen wie CML, CMS oder ABAKUS

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit S/4HANA

Du kennst nicht jedes Modul? Kein Problem. Das Wissen rund um die bankspezifischen Systeme und Schnittstellen gibt das Team im Alltag weiter.

Was dich erwartet

  • Sinnvolle Arbeit: Deine Systeme stehen hinter der Förderung von Wohnungsbau, Energieprojekten und Unternehmen in ganz Schleswig-Holstein.

  • Sicherheit: ein öffentlicher Arbeitgeber mit langfristiger Perspektive und einem SAP-Bereich, der weiter wächst.

  • Vergütung: nach Tarifvertrag für die öffentlichen Banken bis TG 9, mit 13 Gehältern und einer zusätzlichen variablen Vergütung.

  • Zeit für dich: eine 38-Stunden-Woche und 30 Urlaubstage, dazu sind Weihnachten und Silvester frei.

  • Flexibilität: bis zu 50 % mobiles Arbeiten.

  • Entwicklung: hohe Weiterbildungsbudgets, Coaching und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten im Haus.

  • Extras: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Mitarbeitendenrestaurant, JobRad, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und Angebote rund um Sport und Gesundheit.

  • Team: ein wertschätzendes Miteinander, eine offene Feedbackkultur und gemeinsame Team-Events. Die IB.SH ist außerdem als familienfreundliches Unternehmen zertifiziert.

Bei der IB.SH sind alle Menschen gleichermaßen willkommen, unabhängig von Alter, Herkunft, Identität, sexueller Orientierung, Religion, Behinderung oder Nationalität.

Ihre Aufgaben im Projekt

• Sie steuern den Implementierungspartner fachlich: Sie prüfen Konzepte, Schätzungen und Ergebnisse und setzen durch, was das Unternehmen tatsächlich braucht.

• Sie übersetzen Anforderungen der Vertriebsbereiche in Lösungen nah am SAP-Standard.

• Sie bereiten Pilot und Rollouts aus Vertriebssicht vor und sind bei wichtigen Meilensteinen vor Ort.

Das erwartet Sie

title: Security and Compliance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

The Craft function has seven small, cross-functional engineering teams - each with engineers, an engineering manager, and a product manager, working closely with designers.

You will work across the whole Craft function, with the remit of improving our controls and cyber security governance. You will initially work with and report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure as you establish yourself and take on your day to day responsibilities, additionally you will work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineer 1.5 to become the engineering voice of security, compliance and assurance at Griffin. Sitting across engineering, security, risk and operational resilience, you'll turn standards and regulatory expectations into practical controls that engineers actually want to use and you’ll build those controls yourself, shipping code to production alongside the engineering team. You’ll also give our second and third lines real confidence in what we’ve built. It’s a rare hybrid role with broad ownership and a direct hand in strengthening Griffin’s security.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6 months, you'll have taken ownership of our certification, attestation and audit work including ISO 27001 and SWIFT, with evidence organised and findings driven through to closure. Our engineering risks and controls will be well maintained, and our release, change and post-incident processes will be stronger. You’ll have shipped code that automates control checks and evidence collection, and you’ll be a regular contributor to our codebase.

By month 12 our resilience plans, including Important Business Service technical mapping, B& Continuity Planning and disaster recovery, will be current, and security and compliance will be easier to run and easier to demonstrate to customers, thanks to clearer ownership and smart automation.

To Do This You’ll Own

  • Control design and cyber security governance: translating standards into practical engineering controls and building and shipping the code that puts them in place, working with Engineering teams to get them live

  • Certifications and attestations, from SWIFT and FPS today to schemes like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in the future, including the documentation behind them

  • Internal and external audits and customer due diligence requests, owning findings and driving them to closure

  • Engineering Risk and Controls Self Assessments, controls and actions, plus recurring control activity such as chaos testing and backup/restore

  • Code release and change management, improving the process and sampling releases to check adherence to policy

  • Post-incident reviews, including follow-up actions and sharing learnings with the right stakeholders

  • Engineering's contribution to operational resilience (DR plans and IBS technical mapping) and to managing engineering third parties alongside Operations

We expect you to shape this role

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • A hands-on engineering or technical background, including experience writing and shipping production code with an engineering-first approach to turning standards into practical controls and technical delivery

  • Experience in security, compliance, risk or assurance within a technical environment, including owning or significantly contributing to audits, certifications or attestations

  • Strong knowledge of compliance, risk and cyber security principles, and a broad understanding of change and release management, incident management, operational resilience and third-party governance

  • Sharp analytical and assurance skills: spotting gaps, assessing adherence to standards and following actions through

  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across Engineering, SMEs, auditors and control functions, with a pragmatic, proportionate approach to governance

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)

Ideally, you would also:

  • Be familiar with frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SWIFT and FPS, ideally from a regulated fintech or challenger bank environment

  • Have used automation and code to improve security, compliance or control processes and documentation

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks.

 

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team.

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.

title: Security Engineer III - Detection & Response
descriptionHtml:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Primer processes payments for some of the world's best companies, which makes us an attractive target and means getting detection and response right really matters. We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response function and own a meaningful slice of how we detect, investigate and respond to threats across our cloud infrastructure and SaaS estate.

You'll write and tune the detections in our SIEM, build the automation that speeds up how we react, and be a first responder when something looks wrong. You'll have real ownership of the areas you work on, and the freedom to shape how we detect and respond to threats across them.

You'll also work closely with our Application Security/Product Security engineers: what we learn from detections and incidents shapes how we build, and what they know about our products shapes what we look for.


What you'll be doing

Detection

  • Build, tune and maintain detections in our SIEM (Elastic), and identify opportunities to onboard new log sources (e.g. AWS, Google Workspace, Kubernetes) and build new detections on top of them.

  • Find what our current detections miss, and keep the rule set lean by removing what no longer adds value.

  • Use Python and Terraform to build and maintain the infrastructure behind your detections and tooling.

Response

  • Own investigation: triage, investigate, escalate and resolve security incidents, and write up findings clearly enough to stand on their own

  • Lead routine incidents end to end, and take a clear role in larger ones, whether that's driving the investigation or keeping stakeholders informed

  • Build runbooks and automations (Python, Tines or similar) to cut manual work out of triage and response

  • Join our on-call rotation for incident response and monitoring

Across both

  • Make and document risk decisions in your area, and know when to pull in others.

  • Keep the controls you own audit-ready and contribute evidence for audits (e.g. SOC 2, PCI DSS).

  • Use AI tools to work faster across detection and response, from drafting rules and queries to summarising investigations, while maintaining a healthy level of scepticism.

What we're looking for

  • Real experience responding to security incidents, from first alert through to write-up

  • Hands-on experience writing and tuning detections in a SIEM (Elastic, Splunk or similar), using frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK to reason about coverage

title: Semiconductor Test Engineering Team Leader
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The Role

We are seeking a senior Semiconductor Test Engineering leader to drive manufacturing test strategy and silicon production readiness for next-generation AI accelerator devices. This role combines deep technical expertise in high-performance compute silicon with leadership responsibility for internal product engineering teams and external development partners. The successful candidate will oversee all aspects of production test development — from DFT strategy and ATE bring-up through silicon characterisation, yield optimisation, advanced packaging test, and high-volume manufacturing ramp — ensuring robust, scalable, and cost-effective test solutions for advanced AI accelerator platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the manufacturing test strategy for an AI accelerator chip featuring PCIe Gen6, LPDDR, advanced CMOS nodes, and advanced packaging (e.g., 2.5D/3D, chiplet).

  • Lead and manage a team of chip test engineers responsible for test planning, test program development, pattern bring-up, silicon characterization, debug, and optimization.

  • Manage subcontracted test development partners (OSATs, ATE vendors, external engineering services). Includes scoping, technical oversight, schedule tracking, and quality control of deliverables.

  • Define and drive test software architecture, DFT usage, and test pattern development strategies for high-speed logic, SRAM, DRAM, and High Speed IO blocks.

  • Work closely with design, DFT, product engineering, packaging, and validation teams to ensure robust test coverage, manufacturability, and yield ramp success.

  • Oversee test development for high speed interfaces such as PCIe Gen6 and multi-GHz LPDDR.

  • Guide development of structural and functional test content (scan, MBIST, JTAG, HSIO tests, system-level tests).

  • Lead silicon bring-up and development on ATE: correlation, failure analysis, shmooing, corner testing, stress testing, and yield improvement activities.

  • Define KPIs and metrics for subcontractor performance, test coverage, yield, time-to-test, and cost optimization.

  • Drive continuous improvement in test methodologies, automation, data analytics, and debug infrastructure.

  • Ensure robust test flows for advanced packaging (thermals, interposer/bridge connections, TSV integrity, die-to-die IO testing).

  • Support qualification, reliability testing, and high-volume manufacturing transfer.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in semiconductor test engineering, including leadership or technical lead roles.

  • Deep experience with ATE test development (e.g., Advantest 93K, Teradyne).

  • Strong understanding of DFT (scan, ATPG, LBIST, MBIST), memory testing, and high-speed interface testing.

  • Experience managing external test development partners or OSATs.

  • Proven ability to lead and mentor test engineering teams.

  • Solid background in advanced CMOS nodes and familiarity with advanced packaging test challenges.

  • Expertise in silicon debug, characterization, and correlation across ATE and system-level environments.

  • Ability to collaborate across design, architecture, product engineering, packaging, and operations..

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI/ML accelerator chips or other high-performance compute ICs.

  • Prior involvement with PCIe Gen5/Gen6 or LPDDR4/5/6 test methodologies.

  • Familiarity with signal-integrity-aware test development and high-speed IO margining.

  • Experience with chiplets, 2.5D/3D IC test flows, or heterogeneous integration.

How we work

  • Ownership and execution: you will have full agency to drive your work forward

  • Rapid iteration: we all work directly with top leadership to move from idea to hardware on ambitious timelines

  • Full-stack engagement: hardware, software, silicon, and modelling teams all work closely together to create a product with generational impact

  • Optimistic and pragmatic: we possess the will to win, and to do the hard work to get us there

  • Team player mentality: the mission is bigger than any of us, and we have the curiosity and technical focus to see the best idea shipped, no matter who’s it is

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

title: Senior Analog Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!

Cirrus Logic is looking for a talented Senior Analog IC Design Engineer to help drive the next generation of technologies and products to serve new and exciting opportunities in Mixed-Signal IC design for consumer, automotive, health, and power management applications. We have a role for someone with experience in detailed transistor-level design and looking to develop into project and sub-system leadership. As part of a highly collaborative team, you will be responsible for the development of low-power, high-performance ICs in advanced CMOS processes, specified to drive transformational change in new applications and markets.


Responsibilities:
  • Ownership and development of advanced solutions for complex mixed-signal products and respective circuitry from concept, architecture, design, design integration through to production with an awareness of competing solutions and commercial pressures.
  • Modelling of solutions using tools such as Matlab, Simulink, Spectre, AMS Designer etc.
  • Transistor level implementation of the design.
  • Design and verification of key analog/mixed-signal building blocks such as A/D and D/A converters, LDOs, DC/DC converters, PLLs, oscillators, op-amps, analog front ends (AFEs) and other precision analog circuits.
  • Overseeing layout implementation and performing post-layout simulations and optimization.
  • Hands-on lab checkout, silicon learning, and debug.
  • Supporting post-silicon activities including product validation, characterization, and production test

    • Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • BSc, MSc, MEng or PhD in Electrical Engineering (or related fields) with proven and relevant professional experience in mixed-signal CMOS circuit design.
  • Deep understanding of analog design flows including architecture, design, and design integration.
  • Strong skills in CMOS analog design and layout of high precision, low power circuits.
  • Hands-on lab test/debug experience with a range of lab equipment.
  • Organised and detailed with strong communication skills.
  • Possess outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Results-oriented and thrive in a dynamic environment.
  • Able to operate effectively in a high-functioning interdependent team.

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Knowledge of discrete-time and continuous-time signal processing (ADC and DAC design).
  • Experience of designing low-power/high-performance analog circuits (voltage/current references, oscillators, PLLs, LDOs, DC/DC converters, op-amps, AFEs, etc.).
  • Experience in system and behavioral modelling.
  • Experience designing for different CMOS processes and aggressive geometry nodes.
  • Understanding of reliability concerns.
  • Understanding of scripting languages such as Tcl, Perl, Python etc.

    This is a hybrid position and will follow a 2+ day in-office work schedule, with in-office days based on business needs and team preference. You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.

Deine Mission

Als Senior Backend Engineer verantwortest du die Systeme hinter unserer Plattform: die GraphQL-API, das relationale Datenmodell, die Hintergrundverarbeitung, die Dokumente und Excel-Dateien unserer Kunden in strukturierte Daten verwandelt, und das Berechtigungsmodell, mit dem ein einzelner Eigentümer und eine Bank mit hunderten Portfolios dasselbe Produkt nutzen. Der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver.
Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Design und den anderen Engineers zusammen, damit wir das bauen, was zählt - nicht nur das, was dir gesagt wurde. Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung für Production: Wenn etwas langsam ist, findest du heraus, warum – egal ob die Antwort eine schlechte Query, Anwendungscode oder die Infrastruktur darunter ist.
Du hilfst uns außerdem, KI in Production zuverlässig zu machen. Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs und agentische Features sind zentral für die Richtung des Produkts - und wir brauchen Leute, die diese Workflows testbar und verlässlich machen, statt nur in der Demo beeindruckend.
Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.

Tech-Stack: TypeScript (NestJS im Backend, React im Frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (mehrere Datenbanken inkl. PostGIS), Queue-basierte Job-Verarbeitung, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), Infrastructure-as-Code, Claude

Was du konkret tust

  • Du baust Features über unsere Hasura GraphQL-API, NestJS und Postgres - vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver.
  • Du modellierst komplexe Immobilien- und ESG-Domänen in relationalen Schemas. Wir betreiben mehrere Postgres-Datenbanken parallel (eine davon geospatial), und Schema-Entscheidungen haben hier langfristige Konsequenzen.
  • Du verantwortest die Hintergrundverarbeitung: Excel-Importe, Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs. Queues, Retries, Jobs, die andere Jobs starten - und die Frage, was passiert, wenn Schritt 3 von 7 um 2 Uhr nachts fehlschlägt.
  • Du entwickelst unser Berechtigungsmodell weiter. Unsere Kunden reichen vom einzelnen Eigentümer bis zum Konzern mit Zugriff auf Organisations-, Portfolio- und Gebäudeebene. Das richtig zu bauen ist echte Design-Arbeit, keine Middleware-Konfiguration.
  • Du integrierst LLMs in Backend-Workflows - vor allem für Dokumenten- und Datenextraktion - und machst sie zuverlässig und testbar.
  • Du debuggst Production. Du nutzt Grafana Dashboards und Traces, um herauszufinden, warum etwas langsam ist oder fehlschlägt - ob in der App, der CI/Build-Pipeline oder der Infrastruktur.
  • Du erkennst überwucherte oder unnötig komplexe Teile der Codebase und vereinfachst sie, ohne dass dich jemand darum bitten muss. Komplexität abzubauen gehört zum Job, ist kein Nebenprojekt.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Du hast Features end-to-end über Schema, API und Hintergrundverarbeitung ausgeliefert, die unsere Kunden aktiv nutzen.
  • Unsere asynchrone Verarbeitung (Importe, Extraktion, Analyse-Jobs) ist messbar robuster: weniger stille Fehler, klare Retry- und Recovery-Pfade und Observability, die uns sagt, was kaputt ist und warum.
  • Du hast Ownership für mindestens einen Kernbereich übernommen - z. B. das Berechtigungsmodell, die Job-Orchestrierung oder die LLM-Extraktions-Pipeline - und bist dafür die Anlaufstelle im Team.
  • Du hast Testing und Developer Experience im Backend auf ein neues Level gehoben, und andere Engineers liefern dadurch schneller.
  • Du bist für Product und das Team ein verlässlicher Sparringspartner, wenn wir entscheiden, was wir bauen und wie.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du bist stark in Postgres. Schema-Design fällt dir leicht, du kannst einen Query Plan lesen und weißt, wann das ORM dich anlügt. Geospatial-Erfahrung ist ein Bonus, keine Voraussetzung.
  • Du bist fließend in typisiertem Backend-TypeScript. Wir arbeiten täglich mit NestJS und GraphQL; wenn deine Erfahrung aus einem vergleichbaren Stack kommt, ist das völlig okay - du arbeitest dich ein.
  • Du hast echte Queue-basierte Verarbeitung gebaut. Nicht „ich habe mal einen Job in eine Queue gelegt", sondern Worker designt, Retries und Teilausfälle behandelt, mehrstufige Workflows orchestriert.
  • Du hast Authorization für ein Multi-Tenant-Produkt designt und weißt, wo es haarig wird.
  • Du hast lieber einen Integrationstest gegen eine echte Datenbank als zehn Unit-Tests, die alles mocken. Du schreibst den Test, der die kaputte Migration erwischt.
  • Du behandelst Production als debuggbares System. Du findest über Dashboards und Traces heraus, warum etwas langsam ist, und Infrastruktur ist für dich nicht das Problem von jemand anderem.
  • Du kommunizierst klar - mit Engineers, Product und bei Bedarf direkt mit Kunden.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser und fließend Englisch. Unsere Kunden sind deutsche Banken und Asset Manager, und du wirst mit ihnen sprechen.

Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) sowie Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • LLMs in Production, vor allem Dokumenten- oder Datenextraktion - und die Fähigkeit, sie zuverlässig statt nur beeindruckend zu machen.
  • Data-Pipeline-Erfahrung: stufenweise, reproduzierbare Verarbeitung, Dataset-Versionierung.
  • Mentoring oder Führung von Engineers - oder der Wunsch, da reinzuwachsen.
  • Debugging von Tooling- und Build-Problemen, nicht nur von Anwendungscode. Unsere Toolchain entwickelt sich schnell und ist gelegentlich nicht Standard.

Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.
  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier baust, ist das, worauf sich unsere Kunden jeden Tag verlassen. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar, im Revenue und im Produkt.
  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.
  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 2,5 Tage/Woche.

title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer.

Data sits at the core of what tem does. Our time-series data is the spine that runs from pricing through to billing: every transaction depends on it working. You'll be working across a genuinely varied set of workloads: textual data, time-series data, and event streams, each with its own ingestion and reliability challenges, including TSDS.

You'll join our Data Service team of 4, owning the design, reliability, and recovery strategy of specific ingestion pipelines and systems end-to-end. This is an individual contributor role: no team to manage, full ownership of the work you do. The team has more work than hands right now, and this role exists to close that gap so the business can move faster on the data it depends on.

You'll also work closely with our AI initiatives as they grow: the platform you own increasingly becomes the foundation those efforts depend on.

You will:

  • Own the design, reliability, and recovery strategy for the ingestion pipelines and systems in your domain.

  • Maintain and improve the data platform, including working through the existing tech debt backlog.

  • Build monitoring and alerting so issues surface before they become incidents.

  • Set the data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them.

  • Help take the number of data products with a defined SLA from 2 to 10.

Responsibilities

Data Ingestion

  • Own the design, reliability, and resilience of ingestion pipelines end-to-end, including TSDS, with a clear recovery strategy when things break.

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for new and existing data sources.

  • Decide the right approach (batch vs. streaming) for each pipeline in your domain, including high-scale, low-latency requirements for time-series data.

  • Set data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them.

Platform Maintenance

  • Own the day-to-day reliability of the data platform: monitoring, testing, and fixing issues before they become firefights.

title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

  • Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

  • A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

  • Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

  • Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

title: Senior Director of Product Management, Models and Data
descriptionHtml:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It can't yet reason about real places well enough for robots, field crews and AI agents to rely on it, and closing that gap will change how factories, power grids, cities and defense operations run.

That's one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it's the one we're solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That's why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. Now we're building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

The Large Geospatial Model is Niantic Spatial's foundation model of the physical world. It learns from years of real-world captures of millions of places, and people, robots and AI agents use it to find out where they are, what is around them and what has changed. Each step up in scale has given the model capabilities it did not have before. The next problems are some of the hardest in AI: filling in the parts of a place no camera saw while marking what was inferred, measuring what changed between visits, and predicting what will change next.

Customers already use the model in production. Energy companies use it to guide field crews to equipment on large industrial sites, defense partners use it for positioning where GPS is jammed or unavailable, and robotics companies train robots in metric-scale copies of the real sites they will work in.

You will be the first product leader for the model and the data it learns from, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. You decide which capabilities it gains and in what order, the bar each release has to clear, and what data Niantic Spatial collects, licenses or partners for to get there. You set those priorities directly with the Chief Scientist and the London research team who train the model.

If you have shipped a frontier language model, most of the job will be familiar: evals, data mix and release decisions. The job differs in two ways. Every output of this model can be scored against a measured real place, so its evals rest on ground truth. And its data is collected in the physical world, so choosing what to capture next is a product decision with a real cost. Experience in 3D or mapping is welcome but not required.

By the end of your first year, research, engineering and the product leads for industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers work from one model roadmap that you own, each release ships against evals you wrote, and the model's newest capabilities are in customers' hands.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Model Roadmap - Decide the order in which the Large Geospatial Model gains its next capabilities, from filling in unseen parts of a site to measuring and predicting change, based on what industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers will pay for. Turn customer problems into specific research requirements, and bring new research results to the product leads who sell into each market.

  • Set the Release Bar - Define the evals and acceptance criteria for each capability with the Real-World Test Lab, which measures model output against ground truth in real places. Decide whether each release ships or goes back for more data or training.

  • Own the Data Plan - Decide what data Niantic Spatial collects, buys, licenses or gets through partners, and set the product terms of those deals with Legal and Business Development. Set the curation, labeling, consent, privacy and training-rights requirements every dataset has to meet, and keep a record of which data went into each model version.

  • Turn Capabilities into Products - Decide when a new model capability is ready to become something customers buy, what it promises them, and how it reaches them through Niantic Spatial's products and platform.

  • Set the Long-Term Direction - Decide where the model goes over the next several years, as it moves from describing places as they are to tracking how they change and anticipating what comes next, and make the case for the research and data investment that takes.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in product management, including at least three years shipping a large model to users or customers.

  • Experience writing evals for a model and using them to decide when a release was ready.

  • Direct work on training data, such as setting a data mix, running labeling or human-feedback programs, or negotiating data licenses.

  • Enough depth in how large models are trained, post-trained and evaluated that researchers bring you into their technical decisions. Many strong candidates for this role were ML engineers or researchers before they moved into product.

  • Experience setting direction for research and engineering teams that did not report to you.

  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in 3D computer vision, reconstruction, localization, mapping, geospatial data, robotics or autonomous systems.

  • An advanced degree in machine learning, computer vision, robotics, or a related field.

  • Experience with Gaussian splatting, neural fields or visual positioning systems.

  • Experience with government or defense requirements for data provenance and security.

Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office.

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our embedded software team develops real-time safety-critical firmware and low-level software for autonomous defense platforms. We partner closely with hardware, systems, and controls engineers to take novel designs from concept to flight-ready software. You will join an agile cross-functional team focused on high-reliability execution in mission-critical environments.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will architect, implement, and validate firmware and low-level software for autonomous defense platforms. You will drive hardware-software integration and ensure system reliability and safety standards are met across multi-domain environments.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Architect and write high-performance C/C++ software and firmware for microcontroller and RTOS-based embedded systems.
  • Develop low-level device drivers, bus communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, Ethernet), and hardware abstraction layers.
  • Lead hardware-software integration, system bring-up, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing in laboratory and field environments.
  • Optimize software for low latency, memory constraints, and deterministic execution on embedded microcontrollers.
  • Collaborate with hardware, systems, and QA teams to design robust fault-handling and safety-critical fail-safe mechanisms.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 5+ years of professional experience in embedded software development using C and C++.
  • Deep experience with Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or VxWorks) and bare-metal programming.
  • Solid understanding of microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M/R), peripheral interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet), and hardware schematics.
  • Proficiency with debugging equipment (logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, JTAG/SWD debuggers) and automated testing frameworks.
  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with functional safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, or DO-178C).
  • Familiarity with Embedded Linux, ROS/ROS2, or Rust for embedded systems.
  • Prior experience in aerospace, robotics, defense, or automotive industries.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About the Job:

As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you will play a pivotal role in nurturing and expanding relationships with large enterprise accounts within your designated territory. You should possess exceptional business acumen, a customer-centric approach, and the self-motivation to thrive with minimal supervision. Moreover, you must be adaptable and proficient in wearing multiple hats as you take on this crucial responsibility. We have full confidence in your ability to make the right decisions and drive results autonomously.

LaunchDarkly is a rapidly evolving software company with a strong mission and vision, powered by a diverse and talented team. Our mission is to accelerate software development by empowering teams. Joining our dynamic and fast-growing team, you will make an immediate impact on our product and customer success.

Responsibilities:

  • Ownership of Large Enterprise Accounts: You will be the primary point of contact and relationship owner for large enterprise accounts within your territory.
  • Territory and Account Planning: Develop comprehensive territory and account plans, proactively drive outbound pipeline generation independently, and collaborate effectively with Business Development Representatives.
  • Ensure Successful Adoption: Ensure the seamless adoption of LaunchDarkly within these large enterprises through robust account management. Coordinate closely with pre-and-post sales engineering, customer success, and support teams to guarantee client satisfaction.
  • Elevate LaunchDarkly's Visibility: Increase LaunchDarkly's visibility and communicate our value proposition effectively to Vice Presidents and C-Suite executives within these large enterprises.
  • Collaboration with Solutions Engineers: Work closely with your solutions engineer counterpart to deliver both business and technical value to prospects and customers.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams, including product support, developer relations, marketing, and revenue operations, to align our offerings with customer business needs effectively.

About You:

  • Entrepreneurial and Self-Motivated: You are driven and proactive, taking ownership of your role and responsibilities.
  • Passion for Learning and Growth: You are enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development at LaunchDarkly.
  • Intellectual Curiosity and Ambition: You have a hunger for knowledge and strive for ambitious goals.
  • Excellent Communication: Your written and spoken communication skills are outstanding.
  • Highly Organized & Autonomous: You are capable of efficiently managing your workload and thrive in an environment that encourages autonomy.
  • Adaptability: You excel in a fast-paced and dynamic organizational setting.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of Enterprise (closing) Sales Experience
  • Experience selling DevOps products or a strong technical understanding of SDLC, developer workflows and pain points, with the ability to communicate how solutions address these challenges.
  • You have a demonstrable track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota expectations.
  • You possess the expertise to navigate consultative sales cycles with Executive-level stakeholders at Fortune 500 companies.
  • You have experience implementing and succeeding with a Land & Expand SaaS Sales strategy, effectively expanding business within large enterprise accounts.
  • Recent experience working for an emerging technology software company is a significant plus.
  • Familiarity with and experience using the MEDDPIC sales methodology is advantageous.
  • Travel: expected range of 25% to 50% as needed

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

title: Senior Expansion manager France / Développeur.se Immobilier senior - Sud-Est
descriptionHtml:
Rejoins Fastned pour accélérer la transition énergétique ! En tant qu’Expansion Manager, tu contribueras à notre croissance en France sur des sites clés et tu nous aideras à atteindre notre objectif de 1 000 stations. Aux côtés de +450 collègues avec +50 nationalités, répartis dans 10 pays, nous impulsons le changement dans la transition énergétique. Ce qui nous distingue : notre engagement envers la fiabilité, la durabilité et l'énergie propre. Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Fastned France est en pleine expansion, et en tant qu'Expansion Manager, tu seras un.e acteur.rice clé de cette croissance.

Tes futures missions :

  • Identifier de nouveaux terrains pour y implanter nos stations de recharge rapide.

  • Analyser les nouveaux sites et monter les dossiers, d’un point de vue économique et juridique.

  • Nouer des relations commerciales avec divers types de propriétaires fonciers.

  • Négocier et conclure des contrats de bail.

  • Suivre et coordonner le développement des projets, de la signature des accords jusqu'à l’ouverture des stations.

  • Coordonner avec les services internes le bon déroulement des projets.

  • Cultiver et développer ton réseau, représenter Fastned lors d’évènements extérieurs.

  • Coacher les autres membres de l’équipe et se partager les bonnes pratiques.

Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

La mobilité électrique est un domaine nouveau pour toi ?

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Ce que nous recherchons

Tu aimes prendre des initiatives, tu n’as pas peur de faire des erreurs et tu as soif d’apprendre ? Si tu coches également les cases suivantes, alors postule !

  • Tu vis dans le Sud de la France, autour de Montpellier, Marseille, Toulon ou Nice ;

  • Tu as +6 ans d’expérience en développement immobilier ou d’enseigne ;

  • Tu es intéressé.e/animé.e par la transition énergétique ;

  • Tu as le contact facile, capable de nouer des relations durables ;

  • Tu as l’habitude de prendre la voiture pour visiter un site en pleine campagne et le train pour venir au bureau à Paris régulièrement ;

  • Tu as de solides compétences en matière de négociation et de communication ; tu sais gérer des deals complexes ;

  • Tu comprends et sais t’exprimer en anglais ;

  • Tu aimes guider et mentorer des collaborateurs juniors pour les accompagner et développer leur autonomie au quotidien ;

  • Tu as un permis de conduire valide afin de monter à bord de ta voiture de fonction électrique et voir nos beaux projets se concrétiser partout en France !

Nos avantages

Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly.

Nos avantages :

  • Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies.

  • Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts.

  • Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour.

  • 25 jours de congés + RTT + 2 jours de Mission Days que tu peux utiliser pour contribuer aux missions de Fastned et soutenir une cause associative qui te tient à cœur.

  • Fastned prend en charge 60 % de ta mutuelle Alan et 100 % de ton salaire pendant les 30 premiers jours d’absence pour maladie/incapacité de travail.

  • Un abonnement Gymlib avec accès à un large réseau de salles de sport et studios.

  • Plan de stock options -> nous croyons à la création de valeur partagée.

  • Bien-être mental avec nilo health : accès à une plateforme de santé mentale confidentielle offrant des séances de coaching individuel avec des psychologues, des sessions de groupe et une variété d’outils.

  • Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites.

Envie d'en savoir plus ?

On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi.

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en 4 étapes :

  • Entretien vidéo avec notre recruteuse ;

  • Entretien vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France et un Expansion Manager

  • Case study vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France, et deux membres de l’équipe ;

  • Team coffee chats dans nos locaux parisiens pour rencontrer les collègues de l’équipe France.

title: Senior Financial Control Analyst
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

Senior Financial Control Analyst

📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐ Our Financial Control Team:

Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!

Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by… 

We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.

We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.

Your day-to-day:

  • Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.
  • Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
  • Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.
  • Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.
  • Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.
  • Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.
  • Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.
  • Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.
  • Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.
  • Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment
  • You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards
  • You have a great eye for detail
  • You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls
  • You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors
  • You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds
  • You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)
  • You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process
  • You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
  • What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰£56,000 - £75,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

  • Recruiter Screening Conversation 
  • Initial HM Interview 
  • Role Specific Interview 
  • Behavioural Interview 

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

#LI-TP1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

title: (Senior) FP&A Manager
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a (Senior) FP&A Manager based in Netherlands.

We are looking for an experienced (Senior) FP&A Manager to act as a strategic finance business partner and drive financial performance across an international organization. In this role, you will lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning while transforming complex financial data into actionable business insights. You will work closely with senior leadership, commercial teams, operational stakeholders, and finance professionals to influence strategic decisions and improve business performance. Your expertise will help strengthen financial reporting, enhance planning processes, and ensure alignment between local and group-level objectives. This is an opportunity to take ownership of impactful financial initiatives in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment where analytical excellence and commercial thinking are highly valued.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will take ownership of financial planning and performance management, providing strategic insights and supporting business-wide decision-making. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Lead annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes across the business.

  • Translate financial and operational performance into actionable insights through variance analysis, identifying risks, opportunities, and recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Partner with commercial, operational, functional, local finance, and group finance teams to support strategic initiatives and improve business performance.

  • Develop and maintain robust financial models, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting packages to support decision-making and investment cases.

  • Ensure alignment between local German reporting requirements and group-level expectations within a U.S. publicly listed company environment.

  • Drive continuous improvements across FP&A processes, planning tools, data quality, reporting automation, and performance management routines.

  • Collaborate with external auditors, system implementation partners, and corporate reporting teams to ensure consistency and accuracy across financial processes.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong financial expertise with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and the ability to influence stakeholders in an international business environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

    • Approximately 7 years of progressive experience in FP&A, controlling, corporate finance, or a related finance function, preferably within an international or matrixed organization.

    • Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, management reporting, variance analysis, and business performance management.

    • Good understanding of the relationships between the balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and cash flow statement.

    • Advanced Excel skills and practical experience with ERP, financial planning, and reporting tools such as Oracle NetSuite, Oracle Fusion, Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, Hyperion, OneStream, or similar platforms.

    • Strong commercial mindset, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence strategic decisions.

    • Fluent English is required.

    • Experience preparing board materials, earnings support schedules, management review packs, or group reporting deliverables is a plus.

    • Exposure to finance transformation, planning system implementation, BI dashboards, or reporting automation projects is an advantage.

    • An MBA, CFA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent professional qualification is considered a strong asset.

    • Previous experience in a high-growth, complex, multinational, or publicly listed company environment is beneficial.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive salary: Starting from €55,000 gross per year, depending on location, skills, and experience.

      • Remote-first flexibility: Fully remote position within a time zone of approximately ±2 hours of Central European Time.

title: (Senior) FP&A Manager
