In this role, you will lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning while transforming complex financial data into actionable business insights. You will work closely with senior leadership, commercial teams, operational stakeholders, and finance professionals to influence strategic decisions and improve business performance. Your expertise will help strengthen financial reporting, enhance planning processes, and ensure alignment between local and group-level objectives. This is an opportunity to take ownership of impactful financial initiatives in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment where analytical excellence and commercial thinking are highly valued.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will take ownership of financial planning and performance management, providing strategic insights and supporting business-wide decision-making. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Lead annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes across the business.

  • Translate financial and operational performance into actionable insights through variance analysis, identifying risks, opportunities, and recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Partner with commercial, operational, functional, local finance, and group finance teams to support strategic initiatives and improve business performance.

  • Develop and maintain robust financial models, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting packages to support decision-making and investment cases.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Database Observability, Grafana Cloud | Germany | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Spain and Germany.

About Grafana Cloud Observability

Grafana Cloud is our fully managed observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to use the best open source observability software, including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

Within the Observability department, we build products that help customers understand and troubleshoot their applications and infrastructure. We work closely with product management, design and other engineering squads to provide seamless and highly curated experiences for our customers.

The squad: Database Observability

We build and evolve Grafana Cloud Database Observability. We want to help users understand the health and performance of their databases, identify slow queries and troubleshoot issues through clear, actionable insights.

As a frontend engineer on the squad, you’ll build experiences that make complex database telemetry easy to explore and understand. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product management and design to take ideas from early exploration through to production and improve them based on customer feedback.

Our frontend stack is primarily TypeScript and React, interacting with backends written in Go. Your primary focus will be frontend engineering, with opportunities to work across the stack, contributing to APIs and backend functionality to deliver complete customer experiences. Frontend engineers at Grafana also have opportunities to contribute to open source communities.

The opportunity:

  • Own technical projects from problem framing through rollout, including getting user feedback and measuring whether what you shipped actually worked.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Product Design and backend engineers to build intuitive user experiences using clean, reusable components, contributing to supporting APIs and backend functionality where needed.
  • Mentor and collaborate with other engineers. Raise the engineering bar through code review, design feedback, pairing on hard problems, and writing that leaves the team better than you found it.
  • Participate in on-call for the software you help build, contributing to incident response and learning from incidents.
  • Provide technical support in customer escalations and help us identify areas of high friction to address.
  • Collaborate with other squads on shared dependencies, contribute to design proposals, and share the team’s work through demos and technical discussions.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

  • We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind and enjoy working as a team.
  • Strong frontend engineering experience, with experience across the stack. You have experience building and maintaining production web applications with React and TypeScript, and are comfortable contributing to backend services and APIs. You value maintainability, readability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Technical ownership. You have solid experience delivering complex projects, mentoring other engineers and helping teammates work more effectively. You communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.
  • You take responsibility for operating the software you have built. You have experience being on-call, supporting software in production, ensuring reliability and responding to incidents as needed.
  • You enjoy working on complex solutions, building production software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.
  • User focus and pragmatism. You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and quality, validate their output, and share useful practices with teammates.
  • You care about our community of users and contributors and are keen to be an active Grafana Community Contributor.

Bonus Points for 

  • Open-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open.
  • An active interest in observability (metrics, logs and traces) and experience with tools like Grafana, Prometheus or other observability platforms.
  • Experience with databases, SQL or database performance monitoring.
  • Experience building backend services in Go.
  • Experience as an on-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab).
  • Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is €100,000 - €125,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (React / Typescript / Java)
descriptionHtml:
We are a high-momentum Munich-based AI startup pairing rapid frontend prototyping and product design with deliberate architecture and AI-assisted execution. As a senior full-stack engineer, you'll prototype intuitive user experiences in Storybook before building out robust full-stack features alongside the CTO and experienced peers.

Why this role matters

We are scaling our engineering team past 6+ developers and need an experienced, versatile full-stack builder who excels at frontend craft and rapid design prototyping. We design and iterate directly in Storybook before building, ensuring exceptional user experience before locking in our robust Java/Spring backend architecture. Your contributions will directly accelerate our product velocity and lift our frontend and design standards across the board.

What you'll own

End-to-end feature delivery, rapid UI prototyping, and full-stack development across our core platform.

  • Rapidly prototype, iterate, and refine UI designs in Storybook before building production code.

  • Design, build, and ship polished frontend experiences using React, TypeScript, and modern design systems.

  • Build robust, scalable backend services and APIs using Java and Spring Boot.

  • Collaborate closely with the CTO and senior developers on domain modeling (DDD/Arc42), testing (TDD/BDD), and heavy execution.

  • Leverage AI-agent pairing workflows and modern CI/CD automation on Azure and Kubernetes to maximize development velocity.

  • Coach and support junior engineers through active code reviews, pairing, and shared UI/craft standards.

Your first 90 days

  • Month 1: Ramp up on our product domain, explore our Storybook setup, and deliver your first rapid UI prototypes and production-ready contributions.

  • Month 2-3: Ship end-to-end features with polished UI design, tackle complex full-stack tasks alongside the CTO and senior peers, and introduce constructive design system or tooling improvements.

  • By end of Q1: Operate as an autonomous senior contributor and trusted peer in the Munich office who collaborates closely with the team and shares new prototyping or frontend techniques.

Who you are

  • ~7+ years of software engineering experience delivering robust, production-grade applications.

  • Strong product and visual design sensibility with deep hands-on expertise in React, TypeScript, and Storybook.

  • Solid backend proficiency building services with Java and Spring Boot.

  • Dedicated practitioner of clean code, automated testing (TDD/BDD), and rapid prototyping.

  • Comfortable collaborating closely as a peer and mentoring junior developers in a flat team.

  • Based in Munich (or relocating) for regular in-office collaboration.

What you'll get

  • High autonomy to shape product design, iterate rapidly in Storybook, and influence architecture.

  • Direct collaboration and high trust alongside the CTO and senior peers in a flat setup.

  • Modern AI-agent pairing workflows that supercharge individual delivery and eliminate busywork.

  • A culture that values thoughtful upfront prototyping, clean design, and deliberate engineering.

  • Energetic in-person team collaboration in the heart of Munich.

This probably isn't for you if...

  • You prefer pure backend work and dislike hands-on UI design, prototyping in Storybook, or frontend craft.

  • You are looking for a formal technical lead title or hierarchical management role rather than direct hands-on building.

  • You prefer purely remote work and do not want regular face-to-face collaboration in Munich.

Let's talk

If you are an experienced builder who thrives on fast-paced UI prototyping, modern frontend craft, and robust backend engineering in a flat team, let's talk. Apply with a link to your GitHub, Storybook, or design work to start the conversation.

title: Senior Fullstack Entwickler Java / Angular (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern, eingebettet in deren Teams, mit voller Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung in Enterprise- und regulierten Umgebungen
  • Architektur mitgestalten, nicht nur umsetzen
  • Code generieren, reviewen und refactoren mit Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor
  • Code Reviews und technisches Mentoring im Team
  • Abstimmung mit Product Ownern, UX und DevOps

Die meisten kommen ein bis zwei Tage die Woche in eins der Büros. Zwang ist das aber keiner. Beim Kunden vor Ort bist du nur für einzelne Termine alle paar Wochen, meist in Frankfurt am Main.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt und deiner Erfahrung:

  • Großkonzerne wie Deutsche Bahn / DB Systel (eisenbahnspezifische Domänen: Fahrplanmanagement, Vertrieb, Leit- und Sicherungstechnik)
  • Öffentlicher Sektor / Behörden (z. B. Bundesagentur für Arbeit, ITZBund, Bundesdruckerei) – regulierte Umgebungen, Barrierefreiheit, Security by Design
  • Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen

Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Erfahrung in einem dieser Umfelder ist ein starkes Plus – sag uns in den Fragen, wo du herkommst.

Was du mitbringst

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

Backend-Kern (das erwarten wir):

  • Java (17+) und Spring Boot (Microservices, Domain Driven Design)
  • REST-Schnittstellen und relationale Datenbanken, vor allem PostgreSQL
  • Docker und Kubernetes
  • Testgetriebene Entwicklung (TDD) mit JUnit – Tests gehören bei uns zur Definition of Done, nicht in die Nacharbeit
  • Apache Kafka / asynchrone Kommunikation
  • CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Git, agiles Arbeiten

Frontend (das erwarten wir):

  • Angular mit TypeScript

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • LLM-Integration in Fachanwendungen (RAG, Tool-Calling/MCP, Agenten), gern mit einem Projektbeispiel
  • Kotlin, Camunda (BPMN-Prozessautomatisierung)
  • AWS oder Azure, JPA/Hibernate
  • Monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus), Tests im Frontend (Jest, Playwright, Cypress)
  • Barrierefreiheit (BITV 2.0 / WCAG AA), DevSecOps / Security by Design (öffentlicher Sektor)

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du auf beiden Seiten sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Stacks reinfindest.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Wenn du AI-Tools für einen Hype hältst und lieber alles selbst tippst: falsche Firma. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

  • Homeoffice, Büro oder Mix, du entscheidest
  • MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)
  • Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte
  • Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner
  • Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Nach einer kurzen Video-Frage-Runde (2×90 Sekunden) melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

Is organizing truly your passion, and do you know how to turn a client request into a successful and memorable event? We are looking for a Senior G&E Executive to strengthen our team at the Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade & Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon!

WHAT DOES YOUR DAY AS A SENIOR G&E EXECUTIVE LOOK LIKE?

As a Senior G&E Executive, you are responsible for the organization and coordination of groups and events for Leonardo Royal Hotel Den Haag Promenade & Leonardo Hotel Den Haag Babylon. From the first inquiry until the final evaluation, you make sure every detail is taken care of.

You manage a broad range of meetings, conferences, dinners, group bookings, and special events. With your experience and commercial mindset, you know how to translate clients' wishes into successful events while identifying opportunities to maximize revenue. You work closely with operational departments and are a trusted point of contact for both clients and colleagues.

As a senior member of the team, you take ownership of more complex requests and events, support your colleagues when needed, and contribute to continuously improving our commercial approach and way of working.

A FEW RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Managing groups, meetings, and events from the initial inquiry through to execution and follow-up.

  • Maximizing revenue and guest satisfaction by responding quickly to requests, converting inquiries into confirmed business, and identifying upselling opportunities.

  • Using your commercial insight to strategically manage pricing, availability, and event planning in line with the hotels' revenue objectives.

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with corporate clients, agencies, event planners, and other business partners.

Centrally located, with a fantastic view and all the famous attractions within easy reach, the hotel has 143 rooms and several special meeting rooms. On the first floor of the hotel you will find our bar and restaurant "The Livingroom", where we create a real feeling of home for our guests.

As Leonardo Hotels Benelux, we are part of the larger Leonardo Hotels Group and responsible for all activities for our 28 hotels in the Netherlands and Belgium. At Leonardo Hotels, we care deeply about personal growth, connection, and making an impact together. On average, our colleagues work with us for four years because we always look for good internal career opportunities, and we are quite proud of that!


WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT ADDITION TO OUR TEAM

  • At least 2 to 3 years of relevant experience within Groups & Events, Meeting & Events, or a similar hospitality environment.

  • Bachelor-level working and thinking capability (HBO), preferably combined with a hospitality-related education such as Hotel Management or Facility Management.

  • Experience with both corporate and social events and confidence in managing larger or more complex bookings.

  • Experience with Opera Sales & Catering is strongly preferred.

  • Strong command of the Dutch and English languages, both spoken and written.

  • A strong commercial mindset and the ability to recognize opportunities to increase conversion and revenue.

  • You are organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership and making decisions.

  • Professional, service-oriented, and a true team player who enjoys sharing knowledge with colleagues.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, enabling you to connect easily with clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Strong numerical insight and the ability to think strategically while keeping an eye on the details.

  • You remain calm and solution-oriented when plans change, because in events, they sometimes do!

To be considered for this role, applicants must be an EU citizen or hold a valid work permit for the Netherlands.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE FROM US

• Overtime can be paid out or saved as extra time off.

• Training and development opportunities.

• Clear internal growth opportunities.

• Access to a mental well-being support platform.

• Tax-friendly purchase options through a benefit program.

• The mentioned salary is gross per month and applies to candidates aged 20 and above.

COME SOON TO DRINK COFFEE WITH US!

title: Senior German Tax Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

  • 1. Investment Tax Mechanics & Fund Processing

    • Daily KEST: Own the daily KEST activities, run controls, solve incidents and support the Product team.

    • Vorabpauschale (Advance Lump-Sum Tax): Support Product in the complete execution lifecycle of the annual Vorabpauschale calculation under the German Investment Tax Act (InvStG).

    2. Digital Dividend & Regulatory Reporting Transformation

    • MiKaDiv Execution: Support Product in the technical implementation and operational governance of MiKaDiv (Mitteilungsverfahren Kapitalertragsteuer auf Dividenden). Lead continuous data gathering throughout the custody chain, validate beneficial ownership timelines, and secure the electronic transmission paths required to fetch the mandatory unique tax reference numbers (UUIDs) from the BZSt.

    • NEK (Nichtentrichtete Kapitalertragsteuer): Manage reporting and exception workflows surrounding non-withheld or uncollectible capital gains tax (e.g., when an account lacks sufficient cash liquidity during a tax event like the Vorabpauschale), ensuring seamless reporting logs to the local tax offices via CPB.

    3. Customer Tax Exemptions & Account Adjustments

    • FSAk (Freistellungsauftrag / Kontrollverfahren): Support CPB with the submission and by running controls.

    • NV-Bescheinigungen: Validate, track, and audit Non-Assessment Certificates (Nichtveranlagungs-Bescheinigungen), ensuring proper single vs. joint application rules.

    • Loss Pot Management (Verlusttöpfe): Oversee the automated real-time logic of the Share Loss Pot (Aktienverlusttopf) and General Loss Pot (Allgemeiner Verlusttopf), cross-pot optimization offsets, and cross-border or marital Verlusttopf-Überträge (loss pot transfers) during account migrations or closures.

    • Deceased Account Backward Correction (Erbfall): Blueprint and implement the technical logic for backward tax corrections (rückwirkende Korrektur) in the event of an end-user's death, ensuring the immediate freeze and retro-active dissolution of exemption orders (FSA) and the automated cross-year recalculation/neutralization of loss pots (Verlusttöpfe) up to the exact date of death.

    • Church Tax Automation: Control the query process (KiStAM) to the BZSt, including ensuring the application of the correct split-tax formulas (Halbteilungsgrundsatz) to joint accounts with mixed religious denominations.

    4. Tax Documentation & Core IT Collaboration

    • Jahressteuerbescheinigung: Support CPB and Product in the flawless generation of the annual German tax certificate (Jahressteuerbescheinigung e.g., Erträgnisaufstellung), including complex edge cases for joint account primary address routing.

    • Product Tax Engine Architecture: Act as the primary business analyst for Product and Tech Engineering teams, writing technical tax specifications to translate German tax updates into automated core banking system logic.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

title: Senior HPC Engineer, GPU Compute
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior HPC Cluster Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking. 
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads). 
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication. 
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking. 
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments. 
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems. 
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing. 

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior HR Advisor
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our People team are the architects of a great workplace where brilliant minds come together to do their best work. From discovering diverse talent and nurturing future leaders, to creating spaces that spark collaboration and crafting rewards that celebrate success—we’re passionate about building a culture where everyone can thrive.

We’re looking for a Senior HR Advisor to join our Manchester team. This is a hybrid role. You’ll help us deliver a fair, consistent and high-performing employee experience by leading complex employee relations, strengthening manager capability and using people insights to improve how we work across our Merchant organisation.

Get to know our People team—what drives us, how we work and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the UKI People team, primarily supporting our Merchant organisation. Employee relations sits at the heart of the role, alongside a broader focus on employee experience, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Employee Relations and Case Management

  • Manage a varied and complex end-to-end caseload across performance, probation, absence, grievances and disciplinaries.
  • Provide clear, practical advice that balances employee experience, commercial needs, employment law and organisational risk.
  • Build trusted relationships with managers, helping them address concerns early and confidently challenging where needed to achieve fair and consistent outcomes.
  • Respond to sensitive employee and manager concerns with sound judgement, discretion and professionalism, ensuring issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
  • Maintain accurate and timely case documentation, delivering a consistently high standard of support across competing priorities.

Employee Experience and Engagement

  • Partner with managers, leaders, and People colleagues to create an environment where employees feel heard, valued and supported.
  • Use employee feedback, case themes and engagement insights to identify emerging concerns and opportunities to improve the employee experience.
  • Support feedback channels and targeted engagement activity, ensuring themes are followed through and actions are clearly communicated.
  • Coach managers on the behaviours and everyday practices that influence engagement, performance and retention.

Root-Cause Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Use case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify hotspots and underlying factors, such as onboarding, management capability or gaps in existing processes.
  • Turn insights into practical interventions that reduce avoidable cases and improve employee and manager experiences.
  • Recommend continuous improvements to People policies, guidance and processes, helping us deliver support with greater consistency and efficiency.
  • Identify recurring employee or manager questions and improve the guidance, tools and self-service resources available to them.

Manager Capability and Coaching

  • Coach and upskill managers through sensitive people matters, helping them build the confidence and judgement to handle issues effectively.
  • Deliver practical sessions on employee relations policies, UK employment legislation and effective people management.
  • Guide managers towards the right People tools and resources, encouraging greater self-sufficiency while remaining available for complex or higher-risk situations.
  • Communicate complex processes and decisions clearly to a range of audiences, adapting your approach to the situation and the people involved.

People Partnering and Strategic Support

  • Partner with leaders across our Merchant organisation, building a strong understanding of their teams, priorities and people challenges.
  • Support core People processes, including performance calibrations, engagement activity and organisational change.
  • Use data and people insights to support leadership discussions and inform practical, evidence-based decisions.
  • Contribute to targeted UKI People projects and work collaboratively across the wider People team to deliver meaningful improvements.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience managing complex end-to-end employee relations cases within a fast-paced environment, backed by up-to-date knowledge of UK employment law.
  • Strong advisory and coaching capability, with a proven ability to constructively challenge managers and balance commercial risk with employee experience.
  • Sound judgement and the confidence to navigate sensitive or ambiguous situations with limited direction.
  • An analytical mindset, with experience using case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify root causes and deliver proactive HR solutions.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, including the ability to maintain accurate documentation, meet deadlines and deliver consistently across multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex or sensitive information clearly to a range of audiences.
  • A high level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential employee information.
  • A collaborative and adaptable approach, with experience building trusted partnerships across teams and influencing without direct authority.
  • Confidence using HR systems and digital tools to manage work, identify insights and improve the employee and manager experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting commercial, operational or technology-led business units.
  • Broader exposure to, or an interest in, HR Business Partnering and organisational design.
  • Experience supporting employee listening, engagement or retention initiatives.
  • Experience improving HR guidance, self-service tools or digital processes to increase adoption and make support easier to access.
  • Familiarity with people analytics or AI-enabled tools and an interest in how emerging technology can improve HR decision-making and operational efficiency.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here, you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Make a visible impact every day
    Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
  • 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment
    Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
  • 🧠 Build a career, not just a role
    Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
  • 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture
    Join collaborative, values-driven teams that support you to do your best work.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes three to four stages. You can find out more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

+ Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde Hbo, bijvoorbeeld richting BIM, Bedrijfskunde of bedrijfseconomie.

+ Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen.
+ Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur).

Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren.
Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken.

Wat bieden wij?
Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou:
+ Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring.
+ Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling.
+ 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur).
+ Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden.
+ Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie.
+ Een professioneel en hardwerkend team, waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan.
+ Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf

Over Whitevision
Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen.

Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig.

Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen.

Doorgroeimogelijkheden

Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie.

title: Senior Lead, Trade Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

Role Purpose 

The Senior Manager, Global Compliance Risk Assessment designs and runs ASM's global compliance risk assessment program. The main focus is export control, with wider coverage of general compliance risks. The role gives leadership a clear, data-driven view of compliance exposure and makes sure risks are identified, prioritized and mitigated before they affect the business. In doing so, it protects market access, revenue and reputation. 

Key Responsibilities 

  1. Global Risk Assessment Framework
  • Design, implement and maintain a risk-based framework for export control and general compliance across all regions and business units. 
  • Define the risk methodology, including scoring, likelihood and impact criteria, risk appetite and escalation thresholds. 
  • Run the annual global compliance risk assessment and targeted assessments when the business or regulations change. Examples include new markets, products, customers and export control developments. 
  1. Export Control Risk (Primary Focus)
  • Assess risks under U.S. (EAR), EU (Regulation 2021/821), Japanese, Singapore, Korean and Chinese export control regimes. 
  • Evaluate exposure in high-risk areas, such as:  
  • Classification 
  • Licensing 
  • End-use and end-user due diligence screening 
  • Technology transfer and deemed exports 
  • Spare parts and service 
  • U.S. Persons Rules 
  • Assess the business impact of new regulations, such as BIS rules, entity list expansions and China countermeasures, and translate it into concrete mitigation actions. 
  • Test the effectiveness of the Internal Compliance Program (ICP) and of system controls, for example in ERP and Teamcenter. 
  1. General Compliance Risk
  • Extend risk assessment to general compliance related risks. 
  • Work with Internal Audit so there is one consistent view of risk and no duplication. 
  1. Monitoring, Testing and Assurance
  • Develop and carry out a risk-based compliance monitoring and testing plan, including site and process reviews in Europe, the U.S. and Asia. 
  • Identify control gaps and root causes, agree corrective actions with the business, and track them to closure. 
  • Prepare the organization for regulator inquiries, government audits and external reviews. 
  1. Reporting and Governance
  • Produce clear, executive-level risk reporting for the Corporate Director, the Management Board, the Audit Committee and the Supervisory Board. 
  • Maintain the compliance risk register and key risk indicators (KRIs). 
  • Turn complex regulatory risk into business terms such as revenue at risk, operational disruption and reputational impact. 

Qualifications and Experience 

Required 

  • Master's degree in Law, Business, Economics, International Trade, Finance or a related field. 
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience, including significant experience in internal audit, compliance risk assessment or risk management. 
  • Proven track record of designing or running risk assessment or audit programs in a multinational environment. 

Competencies 

  • Analytical and risk-based thinking, with the ability to set priorities 
  • Business acumen: positions compliance as a business enabler, not a barrier 
  • Clear, concise communication at executive and Board level 
  • Independence, integrity and sound judgment 

Travel 

International travel of about 20–30%, mainly to the U.S. and Asia.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Legal Counsel, Product
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Job Description

🎯 You will be a trusted legal partner to our Product and R&D leadership and teams, as our privacy and product counsel. As such you will specifically be supporting our Product and R&D teams, developing further our readiness for AI regulation and advising on wider digital regulatory requirements, to allow n8n to keep building and be early. You will also help shape a modern, AI-first legal strategy as part of a growing Legal team, and bring your product insight to the technology and commercial deals where it makes the difference. You will report to the General Counsel.

What success looks like after 6 months: you are the go-to legal partner in Product and R&D roadmap, you design and launch reviews, our AI regulation readiness plan is in place with clear owners, and templates and playbooks are updated so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without R&D and Product related escalation.

Responsibilities:

Partner with Product and R&D (c. 80% of the role)

  • Partner with the existing Legal team to build out our current approach to AI regulation: EU AI Act readiness and risk classification, AI risk assessments, model and provider due diligence, AI use policies, and customer-facing AI transparency commitments.

  • Partner with others in the Legal team on our response to the wider digital regulatory landscape for software (for example the EU Data Act, and other digital regulation), from horizon scanning through to product readiness and compliance roadmaps.

  • Be the embedded Product and Engineering partner, joining roadmap, design and launch reviews, advising on platform and product terms from the design stage, and turning legal requirements into clear product requirements engineers can build against.

  • Advise on open-source, fair-code and open-core licensing, and on IP questions around AI-generated outputs, machine learning models and training data.

  • Partner with others in the Legal team on privacy questions that arise in product design.

  • Support Product and Engineering with customer, community and regulator questions about how our products meet legal requirements.

Support complex technology and commercial deals (c. 20% of the role)

  • Review, draft and negotiate technology-heavy agreements (SaaS and self-hosted), partnership and integration, and AI model and cloud provider contracts.

  • Partner with sales, partnerships and revenue teams on complex enterprise deals with AI or product requirements.

  • Deliver creative, risk-based solutions that protect the business, and feed deal learnings back into product decisions.

Scale legal as a business enabler

  • Solve legal questions in real time with a builder mindset.

  • Improve and maintain scalable legal templates, playbooks and training materials together with the Legal team, so that standard deals and product questions do not need legal involvement, so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without escalation.

  • Collaborate with our Automation and Legal Operations to improve our self-serve legal processes and tooling.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • ⚖️ Qualified lawyer (Europe-based): You are a qualified legal professional with 5+ years' post-qualification experience (PQE), with at least 3 of those years within an in-house SaaS or technology environment with a start up or scale up company.

  • 💬 Fluent English: You can clearly communicate legal nuance in plain terms to global stakeholders.

  • 🤖 Product, AI and digital regulation expert: You have substantial, hands-on experience of acting as a trusted business partner to and advising technology teams on regulatory matters such as the EU AI Act and related digital regulation and a clear track record of getting up to speed on new regulation quickly.

  • 🔓 Open-source and licensing: You have working knowledge of open-source, fair-code or open-core licensing and how it applies to software products.

  • 🌍 Cross-functional collaborator: You have experience supporting engineers, product managers and sales teams, and can demonstrate how you balance legal risk with product and revenue goals.

  • 🛠️ Builder mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy solving problems with and without a playbook, and look for ways to improve how legal works.

  • 🏃 Fast-scaling environment experience: You have worked where priorities shift quickly and your impact is immediate.

  • 📄 Commercial and technology contracts: You have solid working experience with SaaS and self-hosted software license agreements.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🧠 Curiosity for tech and automation: You are excited to experiment with legal tech, AI tools and scalable internal systems.

  • 🎓 AI or technology law credentials: for example AIGP, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 💬 Other Languages: You can communicate in German with customers and stakeholders.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a shared drive. It will shape how a category-defining company builds products and does deals. You will be embedded with Product and R&D, with commercial work where your product expertise matters most. You will join a senior Legal team, helping embed AI-first thinking into everything we do, in a fast-growing, remote-first team that values ownership, pragmatism and speed.

Sound like a challenge you are excited to take on? Apply now, and help us build the future of automation. If you meet most but not all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior Amazon Marketplace Manager übernimmst du eine zentrale fachliche Rolle bei der strategischen Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von Marken auf Amazon. Dabei verbindest du Datenanalyse, Marketplace Expertise und konkrete Wachstumsmaßnahmen.

  • Erfahrung darin, komplexe Analysen verständlich aufzubereiten und sicher gegenüber internen Stakeholdern und externen Markenpartnern zu präsentieren.
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und ein ausgeprägtes Ownership Mindset sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen und am direkten Austausch mit Marken und Geschäftspartnern.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Nice to have:

title: Senior Mass Properties Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Senior Mass Properties Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and lead mass properties engineering activities for the Microliner aircraft. You will be responsible for establishing, maintaining, and communicating the aircraft mass properties baseline throughout the development lifecycle. Working closely with the Overall Aircraft Design, Airframe, Systems, Propulsion, Technology, Flight Physics, and Configuration Management teams, you will guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in establishing reliable mass data and consolidate this information into a consistent, traceable, and configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline.

As a senior member of Central Engineering, you will provide mass properties expertise across the organization, support technical and programme decision-making, and ensure that mass properties objectives are consistently considered throughout design, verification, certification, and production.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead mass properties engineering for the Microliner across aircraft, system, subsystem, and lower levels, ensuring reliable, traceable, and configuration-controlled mass data throughout design maturation, verification, certification, and transition into production.

  • Maintain, further develop, analyse, and communicate the consolidated aircraft mass properties baseline.

  • Manage and continuously refine mass targets, allocations, margins, and weight-saving objectives in collaboration with aircraft, system, and discipline owners.

  • Guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in estimating, substantiating, and maintaining mass properties data for their respective scope, providing methods, quality assurance, and configuration-control guidance.

  • Perform aircraft weight and balance analyses, including operational loading conditions, centre-of-gravity envelopes, loading scenarios, and compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements.

  • Evaluate mass properties across aircraft configurations, managing applicability, effectivity, and consistency within the aircraft mass model.

  • Assess and communicate the mass-properties impact of design changes, technical trades, system integration decisions, and configuration changes.

  • Define mass properties verification and weighing requirements, and coordinate with suppliers and system owners to ensure that measured data is appropriately substantiated, reconciled, and incorporated into the configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline.

  • Further develop and continuously improve mass properties processes, methods, tools, reporting, governance, and interfaces with configuration management and the wider engineering toolchain.

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Minimum 8 years of professional experience in aircraft mass properties engineering, preferably within the development and certification of civil aircraft under EASA CS-23 or FAA Part 23. Relevant experience from CS-25/Part 25, military or eVTOL development is also considered.

  • Experience with the mass properties of battery-electric aircraft, electric propulsion systems, high-voltage systems, or other electric aviation technologies is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated experience managing aircraft mass properties throughout the product development lifecycle, including mass estimation, target setting, allocation, tracking, reporting, configuration control, and the incorporation of substantiated mass data into the aircraft baseline.

  • Strong expertise in aircraft weight and balance, centre-of-gravity envelope development, loading analysis, moments of inertia, mass margins, uncertainty management, and mass-properties substantiation.

  • Demonstrated experience working across the complete aircraft product hierarchy, from aircraft-level mass objectives and operational loading conditions through system, and lower-level hardware mass data, ensuring consistency and traceability between levels.

  • Good understanding of aircraft design, systems integration, configuration management, certification, and the interaction between mass properties, aircraft performance, structures, stability and control, and operational capability.

  • Proficiency with mass properties databases and analysis tools, as well as experience integrating mass data within product lifecycle management and configuration-controlled engineering environments; experience with Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE is a strong plus.

  • Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong ownership of aircraft-level outcomes, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate mass properties implications effectively across technical disciplines and programme stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset

  • Strong motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

     

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it?

AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.

Why a designer now

We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market.

That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind.

Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Product Designer, you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster.

You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set.

Journeys and engagement

  • Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit.

  • Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky.

  • Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data.

Growth surfaces

  • Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels.

  • Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from.

Craft and UI ownership

  • You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence.

  • During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent.

Design system and enablement

  • Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan.

  • Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with.

How you work

  • You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision.

  • You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision.

  • You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign.

On a typical week

On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities.

In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience.

On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves.

In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details.

On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined.

We offer

  • A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution;

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation;

  • The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work;

  • Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals;

  • Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here

  • Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;

  • Pension plan;

  • 5 Mental health days per year;

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

Apply for the job

Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.

P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.


Who you are

You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if:

  • You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech.

  • You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around you.

  • You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas.

  • You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion.

  • You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence.

  • You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard.

  • You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same.

  • You see feedback as a way to improve the work, hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so.

  • You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week.
