title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

About the role

Underwriters at the world's largest insurers still do much of their work in spreadsheets, email threads, and systems that were never designed for the decisions they are making. We are rebuilding that from the ground up.

You will join the Workflow Underwriting stream, building the next generation of our underwriting platform. This is not a platform with AI features bolted on. We are designing it around the agents we build, which means the architecture, the domain model, and the interaction patterns are all genuinely open questions. You will help answer them.

You will contribute at code, architecture, and domain level from your first weeks, and you will talk directly to the underwriters who use what you build.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, build, and operate backend services in Kotlin or Java, and own them in production.

  • Turn ambiguous underwriting problems into simple, reliable software. Much of the work is deciding what to build, not just building it.

  • Shape architectural decisions: APIs, domain models, persistence, reliability, observability, and how the platform evolves without collapsing under its own weight.

  • Build real depth in the underwriting domain, to the point where you can challenge a requirement rather than only implement it.

  • Design and build agent-assisted workflows, and make judgement calls about where an agent should act, where it should advise, and where a human must stay in control.

  • Use AI coding tools, including Claude, as a core part of how you work. You delegate substantial work to them and you remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of everything you ship.

  • Work across boundaries with frontend engineers, product partners, and client-facing teams, and step outside your specialism when the problem demands it.

  • Give and take direct feedback, and raise the engineering bar around you.

 

What you’ll need to have done

  • Strong professional experience building and running backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another JVM language.

title: Senior Product Manager - 12 Month FTC
descriptionHtml:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 12 month FTC.

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team for a 12-month maternity cover contract. It's an interesting time to join us. 

Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers' expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn't exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we're rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades. 

That means there are interesting product problems to solve - not just features to deliver. 

You'll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions. 

Although this is a fixed-term role, it isn't a caretaker role. You'll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it. 

How we work 

We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty. 

We don't expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions. 

You'll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them. 

You'll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something. 

And you'll make the team's thinking visible - explaining what we're trying to achieve, what we've learned, what we're uncertain about and why we're making the choices we are. 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll: 

  • Understand the problem. Build a deep understanding of our users, their needs and behaviours, as well as the organisational, operational and technical context surrounding them. 
  • Shape product direction. Work out where the greatest opportunities lie within your area and help translate PLOS's objectives into clear product outcomes and priorities. 
  • Practise continuous discovery. Work closely with design, engineering and others to explore problems, identify assumptions and regularly test ideas with users and through data. 
  • Turn uncertainty into learning. Frame hypotheses, design useful experiments and look for the smallest sensible way to learn whether we're heading in the right direction. 
  • Make good product decisions. Weigh evidence, impact, effort, risk and opportunity when deciding what to pursue - and what not to pursue. 
  • Measure whether things are getting better. Define useful measures of success and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand whether our work is having the intended effect. 
  • Work iteratively. Help the team deliver in small steps, learn from what happens and adapt rather than treating plans as fixed commitments. 
  • Communicate your thinking. Clearly explain problems, evidence, choices, trade-offs and learning to people with very different levels of technical and product knowledge. 
  • Create strong feedback loops. Use conversations, demos, reviews and other forums to get useful feedback early rather than presenting finished thinking late. 
  • Work as part of a team. Create the conditions in which designers, engineers and other specialists can contribute to product decisions rather than treating product management as something the PM does alone. 
  • Look beyond the product interface. Understand the wider service, including processes, systems and teams around it, and recognise when solving a user problem requires changing more than software. 

Experience and qualifications 

Essential 

  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent professional experience.  
  • At least three years' experience working as a Product Manager in a multidisciplinary digital product team, working closely with disciplines such as design, engineering, research and delivery. 
  • Experience using product discovery alongside delivery - for example, user research, data, experimentation and hypothesis testing - to understand problems and inform what a team should do next. 
  • Experience working with significant uncertainty or ambiguity: identifying what is known, what is assumed and what needs to be learned before making larger commitments. 
  • Experience taking complex problems and helping a team turn them into clear priorities, outcomes and practical next steps. 
  • Experience making product decisions using a combination of user evidence, data, organisational goals, technical constraints and product judgement. 
  • Experience communicating product thinking clearly to a wide range of people, including explaining evidence, uncertainty, trade-offs and why particular decisions have been made. 
  • Experience working collaboratively with people outside the immediate product team, particularly where different groups have different needs, incentives or perspectives. 

Particularly useful 

We'd be especially interested in candidates who have experience of one or more of the following: 

  • Working in an organisation going through significant product, digital or organisational transformation. 
  • Working in complex service environments where improving the user experience involves changes to technology, operations, policy or organisational processes - not simply changing an interface. 
  • Helping teams move towards more iterative, outcome-focused or evidence-led ways of working. 
  • Working in a mission-led, research, publishing, education, scientific or other knowledge-based organisation. 

Experience of scholarly publishing is useful but isn't required. 

What we're looking for in a Senior Product Manager 

For us, seniority isn't about having a larger backlog or knowing more product framework: it's about judgement. 

You'll be able to take a complex and uncertain problem, help people understand it, decide what we most need to learn, bring a team together around a sensible course of action and change that course when the evidence tells us to. 

You'll be comfortable making decisions without perfect information while being clear about the assumptions and risks involved. 

And you'll help the people around you think more clearly about the product - not simply tell them what to build. 

Working at PLOS 

You'll join PLOS's Product team and work collaboratively with colleagues across Digital and the wider organisation. 

The role has no direct line-management responsibility. 

The job is fully remote. Some flexibility to work across time zones and occasional national or international travel may be required. 

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is (UK) £65,000 - £73,500. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below. 

BENEFITS: 

  • Private medical insurance 
  • Life assurance 
  • Income protection  
  • Personal accident insurance 
  • Pension with up to 10% employer match 
  • 25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave 
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off 
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year 
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all. 

Visit plos.org/careers to learn more.

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
descriptionHtml:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.
  • Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.
  • Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.
  • Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.
  • Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.
  • Experience building products for a specific industry or use case, combined with enough technical depth to work directly on the data underneath: where it comes from, how good it is, and what it takes to make it usable.
  • A track record of real customer discovery: you have gone deep on how a particular kind of team works, and shipped something because of what you found.
  • Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows.
  • A technical background, through a degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent hands-on experience, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Domain experience in market intelligence, news, financial research, or another data-heavy industry.
  • Background at a data provider, enrichment vendor, market intelligence platform, or vertical search company, or experience building vertical data products in-house.
  • Experience evaluating and working with external data providers, including judging quality and negotiating what you actually need.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.

title: Senior Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Senior Product Owner who gets energy from structure, flow and a perfectly organised backlog. Someone who wants to make sure great ideas actually reach healthcare professionals through product developments.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App, we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

Our product and development team is growing fast. Our Product Lead, a former nurse, owns the what and the why: our users, the roadmap and experiments. To keep up with the pace, we’re looking for someone who owns the how and the when: turning that roadmap into well-structured, realistic and predictable delivery, together with our development team leads.

Your Role
As Senior Product Owner at Attendi, you will:

  • Translate roadmap items, experiments and MVPs into epics and user stories, with clear acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (performance, security, privacy, platforms).

  • Own the development backlog in Jira: clear, up to date and one to two sprints ahead with work that’s ready to build.

  • Set up and guard our Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.

  • Prepare and lead refinement and sprint planning with our dev team leads.

  • Propose 6-week cycle goals and sprint goals, based on capacity, dependencies, risk and effort.

  • Propose the balance between features, bugs, tech debt and maintenance.

  • Be the first point of contact for developers on tickets, and handle small scope questions yourself.

  • Spot blockers, risks and delays early and solve them with the dev leads.

  • Help turn uncertain AI work into small, measurable experiments.

  • Accept delivered work, prepare phased rollouts and pilots, and write release notes for sales, implementation and support.

  • Make sure our requirements are traceable from requirement to story, test and release, as required for our medical device (MDR) certification.

  • Align technically with EHR vendors and partners on integrations, APIs and releases.

  • Make progress visible with Jira dashboards and delivery metrics.


You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in software product teams.

  • Strong command of Scrum and agile delivery, and you know when to adapt it.

  • Technical enough to discuss solutions with engineers, understand trade-offs and help make realistic estimates.

  • You keep the customer at the centre of the backlog, and link technical work to what users need.

  • You love structure: a clear backlog, a steady rhythm and predictable delivery give you energy.

  • Low ego, high ownership. You’re a builder who wants to ship a bit better every week.

  • You move fast, but carefully. You understand that in healthcare, getting it right matters.

  • Experience with Jira.

Strong candidates may also

  • Have a background in software engineering.

title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

title: Senior Robotics Engineer - State Estimation, VIO & Sensor Fusion
descriptionHtml:
About Promethion Industries

Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. Our mission is to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces through tightly integrated autonomy stacks designed and built in Europe. Our focus is defensive and counter-system capabilities, including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions.

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Engineer - State Estimation, VIO & Sensor Fusion to build the estimation backbone that allows our aircraft to understand their own motion without depending on GNSS.

Your mission with us

  • Build the state-estimation and sensor-fusion backbone of our autonomous aerial systems.

  • Develop robust vehicle-state estimation for high-dynamic flight and GNSS-degraded or GNSS-denied environments.

  • Fuse IMUs, cameras, optical flow, airspeed, GNSS, barometers and other sensors into reliable low-latency estimates.

  • Develop, integrate and deploy VIO, visual odometry, ego-motion optical flow and inertial-estimation approaches.

  • Own temporal calibration, sensor synchronisation, coordinate frames and estimator consistency.

  • Diagnose drift, bias, observability and timing problems from first principles.

  • Work directly with real flight logs and hardware to reproduce estimator failures and rapidly improve performance.

  • Build graceful degradation when individual sensors become unreliable or unavailable.

  • Quantify estimator uncertainty and expose meaningful confidence and health information to downstream autonomy and control systems.

  • Evaluate alternative estimation architectures including direct velocity estimation and continuous-time approaches where they provide advantages at high dynamics.

Your contribution to the team (required)

  • Strong practical experience in robotics state estimation, localization or inertial estimation.

  • Deep understanding of IMU-based estimation and multi-sensor fusion.

  • Strong experience with EKF, error-state filtering or comparable nonlinear-estimation techniques.

  • Practical experience with VIO, visual odometry, optical flow or closely related systems.

  • Strong understanding of rigid-body transformations and coordinate frames.

  • Strong C++ skills.

  • Experience deploying estimators onto real robots or vehicles.

  • Strong understanding of sensor calibration and time synchronization.

  • Experience analyzing raw sensor data, logs and estimator performance.

  • Ability to work with high-rate, noisy and imperfect real-world measurements.

Big plus

  • High-speed UAV or fixed-wing experience.

  • GNSS-denied flight.

  • PX4 estimator experience.

  • ROS2.

  • GTSAM / Ceres / Eigen.

  • Event-camera VIO or optical flow.

  • Continuous-time estimation.

  • Radar-aided or RF-aided estimation.

  • Air-data integration.

  • Aviation, defence, autonomous vehicles or space systems.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Aggregation & Search
descriptionHtml:
The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and creating products that build trust in cryptocurrencies. We’re a global organization with teams in Denmark, UK, Canada, the USA who thrive on the challenging work we do and doing it with other exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry changes every day and our job is to create user facing products supported by a flexible and scalable data platform allowing us to adapt to those rapid changes and bring value to our customers.

Chainalysis has become known as the leader in blockchain investigation and compliance software. Our products have built trust in blockchains by taking down terrorist financing campaigns, disrupting major ransomware operations, identifying the Twitter hackers, and more.

We are building the data platform for blockchain, cryptocurrency, and web3. We’re looking to bring onboard a Senior Software Engineer with deep PostgreSQL and Java Spring Boot experience who executes high-impact projects and is excited about building at a significant scale!

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own and improve our data ingest Java service for enriched transfers generation and aggregations.

  • Design and tune PostgreSQL transaction batching, indexing, and replication strategies.

  • Contribute to the next-generation architecture. The team is evaluating a wide stack of cutting edge technologies. You will run PoCs, benchmark latency, and write ADRs and contribute to delivering the next generation to PROD.

  • Build and maintain scalable API services on AWS that handle thousands of requests per second

  • Help automate network onboarding end-to-end.

  • Debug production issues across microservices, define SLOs, and participate in the on-call rotation

  • Integrate LLM-based tools into daily engineering work and build agentic automation for operational tasks: automated incident triage, self-healing pipelines, and intelligent alerting

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • 8+ years with PostgreSQL in production: schema design, query optimization, partitioning, replication, and performance tuning under write-heavy, high-throughput workloads

  • 8+ years building Java Spring Boot services: REST APIs, JDBC, connection pooling, and JVM performance profiling

  • Experience with Kafka or equivalent streaming systems: consumer groups, offset management, and partition lag debugging

  • Track record operating distributed systems on AWS: microservices, multi-silo deployments, Terraform

  • Strong cross-system debugging skills: tracing a serving delay from a Datadog metric to a Humio log to a code path

  • Comfort with AI-assisted development and agentic engineering practices

  • A bias to ship and iterate alongside product and design partners

  • A genuine excitement for significantly scaling large data systems

Technologies

Core (experience required):

  • PostgreSQL

  • Java Spring

  • Kafka

Expected familiarity:

  • AWS

  • Kubernetes

  • Terraform

  • Python

  • Github including Github Actions

  • DataDog

  • Humio

  • PagerDuty

Nice to have

  • Database migration experience (evaluating and cutting over between storage systems)

  • Flink, Spark, or lakehouse formats (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Parquet)

  • Kubernetes operations (StatefulSets, HelmReleases, stateful workloads)

  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical decisions through RFCs/ADRs

  • Interest in the cryptocurrency

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
descriptionHtml:
Op zoek naar een werkplek waar jouw ideeën het verschil maken en waar je op niveau kan sparren met een team van ambitieuze developers? Als Software Engineer bij IXON werk je aan een modern cloudplatform dat door duizenden machinebouwers wereldwijd wordt gebruikt. Geen remote eilandjes of kortlopende projecten, maar samen bouwen aan een product waar onze klanten fan van zijn. Klaar om impact te maken?

Hier krijg jij energie van

Binnen jouw rol als Software Engineer werk je niet aan een statische applicatie, maar aan een continu evoluerend cloudplatform met een diversiteit aan functionaliteiten. Samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het hart van de IXON Cloud: van complexe autorisatiestructuren tot een naadloze gebruikerservaring. Het doel? Onze klanten hun beheerprocessen zo efficiënt mogelijk laten uitvoeren.

Om dat voor elkaar te krijgen, werk je met een moderne tech stack die onder andere bestaat uit Angular en TypeScript. Je krijgt de vrijheid om actief mee te beslissen over technische keuzes die ervoor zorgen dat onze applicaties niet alleen vandaag snel en strak draaien, maar ook op de lange termijn schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar blijven.

Wat je concreet gaat doen:

  • Je pakt de verantwoordelijkheid, en draagt zorg voor jouw kwalitatief sterke code;

  • Je bent een sparringpartner voor je collega’s en om features technisch uit te diepen;

  • Je tilt graag ons front-end delivery proces naar een hoger niveau, op gebied van observability, testing en deployment

  • Je krijgt de ruimte voor PoC’s en research spikes om de nieuwste technologieën te valideren voor ons platform.

Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol

Jij bent een Software Engineer die gelooft dat een interface pas écht goed is wanneer de logica erachter vlekkeloos werkt. Frontend is jouw passie, maar je snapt ook wat er in de backend gebeurt. Dit maakt je een belangrijke schakel in ons multidisciplinaire Scrum team. Je werkt iteratief, leert van feedback en streeft voortdurend naar verbetering. Bovendien inspireer je jouw collega’s door best practices te delen en samen te groeien.

Daarnaast zou het fijn zijn als je jezelf herkent in het volgende rijtje:

  • Je beschikt over een WO werk en denk niveau

  • Minimaal 5+ jaar relevante werkervaring;

  • Sterke kennis van Typescript en Angular of een vergelijkbaar framework;

  • Je hebt sterke affiniteit met User Experience en begrijpt hoe een gebruiker door een applicatie beweegt;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel in het Nederlands als Engels.

  • Kennis en/of ervaring met Python en Docker.

Dit hebben wij jou te bieden

Streven naar topkwaliteit en een goede werksfeer gaan bij ons hand in hand. We streven naar ontwikkeling op hoog niveau, werken met een geavanceerde tech stack en dagen elkaar inhoudelijk uit. Tegelijkertijd is de sfeer open en informeel. Vragen stellen, kritisch meedenken of een nieuw concept pitchen? Dat hoort er bij ons gewoon bij. Daarnaast krijg je alle ruimte om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Leef je uit tijdens onze vrijdagmiddagprojecten, denk mee in de Frontend Guild en verbreed je horizon tijdens onze interne tech events.

Dit vullen we graag aan met:

  • Een goed salaris passend bij jouw niveau en ervaring;

  • Uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden: Een 13e maand, 8% vakantiegeld, Vitaliteitsbudget, WIA-hiaat verzekering en een pensioenregeling;

  • 30 vakantiedagen om op te laden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden;

  • Persoonlijke groei: Een uitgebreide onboarding, ruim persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget en coaching;

  • Een gezellige werkplek inclusief een volle kalender met teamactiviteiten, uitjes en spontane borrels.

Wat wij doen?

Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten. Naarmate machines complexer worden en de verwachtingen van klanten stijgen, moeten machinebouwers hun services continu professionaliseren om de concurrentie voor te blijven. En dat is precies waar wij in beeld komen.

Wij helpen machinebouwers wereldwijd om hun activiteiten te stroomlijnen en hun service naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Dit doen we met een pakket aan innovatieve oplossingen: van veilige remote access tot klantenportalen en geavanceerde data dashboarding. Onze oplossingen zijn ontworpen om zonder beperkingen mee te schalen en naadloos te integreren, zodat onze klanten hun services maximaal kunnen optimaliseren.

Klaar om impact te maken?

We houden van een laagdrempelige aanpak. Na een korte eerste kennismaking laten we je graag een live demo van ons platform zien. Zo ontdek je precies hoe en wat wij bouwen. Daarnaast maken we graag ruimte voor een kennismaking met het team, zodat je zelf kunt ervaren hoe de sfeer is en met wie je gaat samenwerken.

title: Senior Software Engineer  (Java)
descriptionHtml:

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

What we're looking for

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing backend systems that power our innovative products. You’ll collaborate with a talented team to create solutions that drive financial inclusion and transform the way people manage their money.

What you'll be doing

  • The work will focus on greenfield development and improvement of existing systems

  • Projects will include building REST APIs, engineering microservices and evolving a number of systems that our business depends on (e.g. card payments, treasury management, transactions booking, crypto liquidity)

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Retire the ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our AI-native financial platform gives modern, global companies automated accounting, real-time reporting and financial flows that move at the speed of the business. In a short time we've become the operating core for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot.

Multinational companies don't stop at one market, and neither do we.

Come help us take Light into Benelux, Latin America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific, and make it the global default for next-gen finance.

The role

TLDR: Own pre-sales from first discovery to signed contract across four growth regions, and build the local know-how that lets Light win there at scale.

Every new market brings its own GAAP, tax rules, e-invoicing mandates, banks and incumbent ERPs. Finance leaders there want proof that Light handles their reality, not just the UK or US version of it.

You'll work hand in hand with Account Executives in each region, pull in Product and Engineering when a requirement is new, and as a senior early hire you'll define how we sell technically in markets where we're starting from scratch.

What you'll do

  • Run the technical sales cycle. Lead discovery, solution design and tailored demos for CFOs, controllers and finance teams at multinational companies across Benelux, LATAM, the Middle East and APAC.

  • Own the hard questions. Handle objections on integrations, data migration, security, controls and audit trail, and run proofs of concept against each prospect's own data and success criteria.

  • Make Light local. Map country requirements such as local GAAP and IFRS, VAT and GST, e-invoicing (Peppol, CFDI, NF-e, ZATCA), multi-currency and statutory reporting to how Light handles them, and flag clearly where it doesn't yet.

  • Build the regional playbook. Create demo environments, localized scenarios, RFP answers and technical collateral for each market, so the next deal there moves faster.

  • Work with local partners. Support accounting firms, implementation partners and resellers in each region with technical enablement and joint deal work.

  • Feed the roadmap. Turn what you hear in each market into clear localization priorities for Product and Engineering, and use AI tooling to cut the time each evaluation takes.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years as a Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Pre-Sales lead for ERP or finance software, ideally vendor side, with a record of closing complex multi-entity deals.

  • A strong accounting foundation: close, consolidation, intercompany, multi-currency, revenue recognition and controls, with hands-on knowledge of local requirements in at least one of our growth regions.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or Workday) and real implementation work: data migration, integrations, APIs.

  • Experience selling across countries and cultures, and comfort working across time zones and travelling regularly to customers.

  • Executive presence and crisp writing. You make complex things simple, in a demo, a workshop or a one-page proposal.

  • Genuinely AI-native. You've changed how you work because of AI tooling, not just added it to your workflow.

Bonus points

  • Professional fluency in Dutch, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Arabic, in addition to English.

  • A qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA or a local equivalent), or a background at a Big 4 or regional accounting firm desirable

  • Experience being the first technical hire in a new region and building its playbook.

  • You've configured AI agents in production or built your own tools with them.

Probably not for you if: you've used ChatGPT once and weren't impressed, or you'd rather follow a proven playbook than write the first one.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Andela

At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries, the majority residing in emerging markets across Africa and Latin America. As one of the world's largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies the flexibility to deploy qualified technologists fast — across Application Development, AI, Cloud & DevOps, and Data Engineering. Andela Talent Cloud (ATC) is our platform for managing the complete global talent lifecycle.

We're at the intersection of two industry transformations — one in staffing and hiring, one in software development — both accelerated by AI. We're looking for a builder who wants to own the platform at the center of it.

About the Role

Andela is building a modern Sales Engineering function that helps customers solve complex technology and organizational challenges across our three primary offerings:

  • Talent Solutions - specialized technical expertise that works as part of the customer’s team.

  • AI Solutions - managed delivery and repeatable solutions where Andela owns defined outcomes.

  • Learning & Assessment Solutions - assessing, training, and upskilling customer teams.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will serve as a technical partner to customers, Sales, and Delivery. You'll lead discovery, translate ambiguous business needs into technical and delivery requirements, shape solutions across Andela's portfolio, and help ensure that what we sell can be successfully delivered.

Sales Engineering also helps improve how Andela sells. The team is developing new approaches to technical qualification, AI-assisted assessment, solution design, demonstrations, and sales tooling. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to those systems and practices while working directly on some of Andela's most complex customer opportunities.

This reflects the department's broader mandate to support opportunities across Talent Solutions, AI Solutions, and Learning & Assessment Solutions rather than operating within a single offering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery and qualification with business and technical stakeholders to understand customer objectives, environments, constraints, capabilities, and desired outcomes.

  • Shape customer solutions by developing initial recommendations around architecture, scope, delivery model, team structure, technical requirements, timelines, risks, and dependencies.

  • Work across Andela's full portfolio, identifying when customer needs are best addressed through Talent Solutions, AI Solutions, Learning & Assessment Solutions, or a combination.

  • Bring technical depth to the sales process, including architecture discussions, technical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, proposals, and RFPs.

  • Partner closely with Delivery and specialist teams to validate proposed approaches and ensure opportunities are well-defined before commitments are made.

  • Contribute to Sales Engineering technology and methodology, including technical assessments, AI-assisted qualification, discovery frameworks, demonstrations, internal tooling, and automation.

  • Improve how Andela sells by turning field experience into reusable playbooks, technical content, solution patterns, and better sales-to-delivery processes.

  • Bring the voice of the customer back into Andela, identifying patterns and opportunities that can improve our offerings, technology, and go-to-market approach.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Solution Architecture, technical consulting, professional services, engineering leadership, or another customer-facing technical role.

  • Strong technical fluency across modern software development, cloud architecture, data platforms, APIs, and AI-enabled systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead technical discovery and translate ambiguous business problems into practical solution approaches.

  • Experience evaluating architecture, technical tradeoffs, dependencies, risks, and delivery considerations.

  • Strong customer-facing communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage both senior business stakeholders and deeply technical audiences.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Delivery, Product, Engineering, or related teams.

  • Familiarity with modern AI technologies such as generative AI, LLM-based applications, agents, retrieval systems, AI-assisted software development, or related platforms.

  • Comfort experimenting with technical tools, APIs, automation, prototypes, or AI-enabled workflows. This is not a full-time software engineering role, but strong technical curiosity is important.

  • A builder mindset and comfort operating in an evolving environment where processes, offerings, and tools are still being developed.

  • Experience with managed services, technical assessments, training/enablement, application modernization, data engineering, or enterprise technology solutions is a plus.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior / Staff Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve. Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems.

Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.

  • Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows.

  • Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on.

  • Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation.

Have a look at what we’re building for finance and insurance.

The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have

  • You’ll own V7 Go. That’s the whole product, not a corner of it, working with engineers, designers and with the founders close by.

  • Go 4x-ed revenue last year with 160%+ upsell, and we’re running tens of millions of documents through it for customers in finance, insurance and real estate. What you choose to build next is what decides where that goes.

  • The product does a lot of different things for a lot of different teams. A big part of the job is having a view on what it should be, and being willing to say no to the rest.

  • It’s a small product team, so there’s not much process to hide behind. If something’s broken or missing, it’s yours to sort out.

What you’ll be doing from day one

  • Owning the roadmap. Deciding what gets built, killing the stuff that doesn’t matter, and shipping continuously rather than in quarterly chunks.

  • Working out which problems are actually worth solving. Sales wants one thing, the loudest customer wants another, and the interesting bet is usually neither.

  • Defining what good looks like before anything gets built, then checking afterwards whether it landed. Adoption, not shipped tickets.

  • Making the trade-off calls. What’s in, what’s out, what’s deliberately a bit rubbish for now, and being able to explain why to whoever asks.

  • Writing things down clearly. Decisions, trade-offs, why we said no to something. It’s how a small team stays pointed the same way.

  • Keeping the whole thing coherent. Workflows, Context Graph and chat need to feel like one product rather than three that happen to share a login. Most of the features are self-serve, so if it needs explaining, that's a product problem.

Who you are

  • You’ve owned a product properly, at a startup or somewhere with a serious product culture. Not running a backlog someone else set.

  • You've owned a real product area end to end at a startup or a company with a serious product culture. Discovery through launch, not backlog management.

  • You've built for expert users who know their domain better than you do. B2B SaaS, fintech, insurtech, developer tools, data platforms.

  • You're genuinely hands-on with LLMs and agents. You build with them, you have views on what they're good and bad at, and you can tell a demo from a product.

  • You can hold a conversation with engineers about trade-offs without needing everything translated.

  • You’re happy without much certainty. Priorities move here more than they would somewhere bigger.

  • Opinionated but not precious about it.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

title: Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation
locations: United States, United Kingdom, Nigeria, Rwanda, Ethiopia, DRC, India
descriptionHtml:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  

Position Purpose

The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.

Reporting to the Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. Eligible for candidates based in the US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Rwanda, India, France and DRC.

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation

  • Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.
  • Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.
  • Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.

Change Management and Institutional Strengthening

  • Lead the development and adaptation of change management and implementation approaches to enable government and health facility teams to introduce, adapt and sustain improvements in service delivery.
  • Provide strategic accompaniment and coaching to strengthen government leadership, management and institutional capabilities, including decision-making processes, performance management, accountability mechanisms and continuous improvement practices.
  • Design and guide practical implementation approaches, including change management plans, improvement processes, team-based coaching and mechanisms to address barriers to implementation.
  • Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.

Country Implementation and Technical Support

  • Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.
  • Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.
  • Provide technical leadership on country assessments, programme design and implementation planning, ensuring interventions respond to demonstrated system bottlenecks and country priorities.

Learning, Evidence and Innovation

  • Guide the application of data, implementation learning, and performance measurement to assess the effectiveness of service delivery changes, identify emerging challenges, and inform course correction.
  • Document and synthesise implementation experience, developing practical tools, approaches and lessons that can be adapted and applied across countries and other priority health areas.

Qualifications

Education

  • Clinical qualification in medicine, nursing, midwifery or a related health profession, with experience in clinical service delivery. An advanced degree in public health, health systems, health management or a related field is desirable.

Experience

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in clinical service delivery, health systems strengthening and service delivery transformation, including substantial experience in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Demonstrated experience working with government institutions and health service managers to strengthen institutional capabilities, embed new ways of working and sustain improvements beyond individual projects.
  • Experience using routine performance data, quality improvement methods, and implementation learning to inform technical decisions, assess results, and adapt interventions.

Skills & Abilities

  • Expertise in applying systems thinking, change management and health systems transformation approaches to diagnose complex service delivery challenges, design practical solutions, and achieve measurable improvements.
  • Proven track record of leading or supporting the implementation of complex health service delivery reforms, including changes to clinical pathways, care models, management practices or health system processes.
  • Deep, nuanced understanding of clinical quality and patient safety, including the organisational, workforce and system factors that influence the reliability and effectiveness of frontline health services.
  • Strong technical leadership, facilitation, coaching, problem-solving, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate resistance to change and work effectively across clinical, technical and management teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex health systems challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and to influence diverse technical, clinical, government and management stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success. 

The salary range for applicants based in the US is $120,000 to $135,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement  
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays 
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year  
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits 
  • Up-to-date computer equipment 

Anticipated Application Deadline: 27 November 2026 (This position may close earlier if a high volume of applications is received before the stated deadline)

RTSL believes its programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
descriptionHtml:

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.


If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.


Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
