title: Senior UX & Interaction Designer (m/w/d) | Industrial Software | Teilzeit
descriptionHtml:
HappyOps entwickelt moderne Softwarelösungen für die produzierende Industrie. Unsere Anwendungen unterstützen Maschinenbediener, Schichtleiter, Instandhalter und Produktionsmanager bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit, von der Produktionsüberwachung über Qualitätsmanagement bis hin zu digitalen Arbeitsabläufen und KI gestützten Assistenzsystemen.

Wir verfügen über ein erfahrenes Engineering Team, das unsere Kunden von der Anforderungsanalyse über die technische Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung begleitet. Gleichzeitig entwickeln wir uns zunehmend vom individuellen Lösungsgeschäft hin zu einer skalierbaren Softwareplattform.

Was uns dabei noch fehlt, ist eine konsequente Spezialisierung auf User Experience, Interaktionskonzepte und intuitive Nutzerführung.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Prozesse versteht, sich in unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen hineinversetzen kann und daraus einfache, effiziente und konsistente Bedienkonzepte entwickelt.

Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht primär um visuelles UI Design. Unser Team kann moderne Oberflächen mit bestehenden Designsystemen und KI gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen bereits sehr gut umsetzen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Frage, wie unsere Software funktioniert und wie Menschen mit ihr interagieren.

Welche Informationen benötigt ein Nutzer in welcher Situation? Wie navigiert er durch komplexe Anwendungen? Welche Aktionen müssen unmittelbar verfügbar sein? Wie lassen sich mehrstufige Arbeitsabläufe vereinfachen? Wie vermeiden wir unnötige Klicks, Medienbrüche und kognitive Belastung?

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam und unseren Software Engineers zusammen und prägst die User Experience unserer wachsenden Softwareplattform.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine erfahrene Person, die eigenständig UX Konzepte entwickeln und fundierte Produktentscheidungen treffen kann.

Die Position ist auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit in Teilzeit mit etwa 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche ausgelegt. Über das konkrete Arbeitsmodell sprechen wir gerne individuell.

Aufgaben

  • Interaction & Workflow Design: Du entwickelst intuitive Interaktionskonzepte für komplexe industrielle Softwareanwendungen und optimierst die Abläufe zwischen Informationen, Entscheidungen und Aktionen.

  • User Journey & Task Flow Design: Du analysierst, wie unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen ihre täglichen Aufgaben erledigen, und entwickelst daraus effiziente, verständliche und möglichst reibungslose Bedienabläufe.

  • Information Architecture & Navigation: Du konzipierst die Informationsstruktur und Navigation unserer Anwendungen. Nutzer sollen relevante Informationen und Funktionen schnell, intuitiv und ohne unnötige Schritte erreichen.

  • User Research & Prozessanalyse: Du verstehst die Arbeitsrealität von Maschinenbedienern, Schichtleitern, Instandhaltern und Produktionsmanagern und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete UX Konzepte.

  • Komplexität reduzieren: Du hinterfragst bestehende Workflows, identifizierst unnötige Interaktionen und entwickelst Lösungen, die auch unter Zeitdruck und in anspruchsvollen Produktionsumgebungen funktionieren.

  • Produktübergreifende UX: Du entwickelst konsistente Navigations- und Interaktionsmuster für unsere wachsende Softwareplattform und sorgst für ein einheitliches Nutzererlebnis über verschiedene Anwendungen hinweg.

  • Konzeption & Validierung: Du visualisierst Konzepte durch User Flows, einfache Wireframes oder interaktive Prototypen und validierst sie gemeinsam mit Entwicklern und tatsächlichen Anwendern.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem erfahrenen Entwicklerteam zusammen, diskutierst technische Möglichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Nutzerfreundlichkeit von Anfang an in die Produktentwicklung einfließt.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich User Experience, Interaction Design, UX Architecture oder Product Design, idealerweise mindestens fünf Jahre.

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Konzeption komplexer B2B Software, Enterprise Applications oder datenintensiver Anwendungen.

  • Ausgeprägte Kompetenz in Information Architecture, Navigation Design, User Journeys, Task Flows und Workflow Optimierung.

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe fachliche Prozesse zu analysieren, zu strukturieren und in einfache, intuitive Interaktionskonzepte zu übersetzen.

  • Erfahrung mit nutzerzentrierten Methoden wie User Research, Usability Testing, Journey Mapping und Prototyping.

  • Verständnis für unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen, ihre Aufgaben, Entscheidungsprozesse und Arbeitsumgebungen.

  • Fähigkeit, UX Entscheidungen fundiert zu begründen und eigenständig mit Produktverantwortlichen und Softwareentwicklern zu diskutieren.

  • Pragmatische, analytische und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit einem klaren Fokus auf funktionierende Lösungen statt aufwendiger Designprozesse.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Erfahrung mit industrieller Software, MES, ERP oder vergleichbaren komplexen Fachanwendungen ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Wichtig: Wir suchen keinen klassischen UI Designer, dessen Schwerpunkt auf visueller Gestaltung, Branding oder der Erstellung schöner Screens liegt. Entscheidend ist deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Software durch bessere Interaktionen, Navigation und Workflows einfacher nutzbar zu machen.

Benefits

  • Direkter Einfluss auf das Produkt: Du definierst, wie Nutzer mit unserer Software arbeiten, und prägst grundlegende Interaktions- und Navigationskonzepte.

  • Erfahrenes Engineering Team: Du konzentrierst dich auf UX Konzeption und Nutzerführung, während unser Entwicklerteam die technische Umsetzung übernimmt.

  • Schnelle Umsetzung: Deine Konzepte können mit modernen Entwicklungswerkzeugen und KI Unterstützung schnell prototypisiert, getestet und produktiv umgesetzt werden.

  • Direkter Zugang zu Anwendern: Du erhältst Einblicke in reale Produktionsumgebungen und kannst deine Ideen mit den Menschen validieren, die unsere Software täglich nutzen.

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung: Du entwickelst eigenständig Konzepte und arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam zusammen.

  • Flexible Teilzeit: Etwa 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung und der Möglichkeit zu hybridem Arbeiten.

  • Langfristige Perspektive: Du gestaltest die User Experience einer wachsenden industriellen Softwareplattform mit.

title: Senior Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Our ideal candidate could have 6+ years’ experience. This is a unique opportunity to accelerate your development, working with an experienced and collaborative team and gaining exposure to a broad range of disciplines. At Fractile, we value ideas from everyone, regardless of title or tenure, and we believe the best engineering happens when people share, question, and learn together. You’ll be joining a culture where your curiosity is encouraged, your input matters, and there’s real room to grow.

As a Silicon Verification Engineer, you will be based in either our Bristol or London office in the UK. We are looking for you to take an active role in building world-class ML/AI IC products for scale-out to data centre applications. You will be ambitious and have a proven track record in working in high-performance delivery organisations in the discipline of pre-silicon RTL verification.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about verification – not someone content to go through the motions, but rather looking to push the field further forwards. If you get excited about bringing software concepts to hardware workflows, and enjoy improving established practices to increase tape-out quality and bring down costs, then this is the role for you.

Our preferred candidate will be comfortable working alongside colleagues across the organisation from disciplines such as modelling, system architecture and RTL design. You’ll be frequently collaborating to ensure our RTL releases are of the highest functional quality, and that the entire company shares the same definition of a functionally correct product. This means contributing to discussions around specification, architecture and the workflows surrounding them. You’ll be a key contributor to our highly disruptive and ambitious product.

We look for engineers with the following mindset:

  • Software mindset for solving hardware problems

  • The desire to be in a high impact role in a small team

  • A disrupter of the “status quo” of hardware development

  • Eagerness to contribute to and improve working practices and help build connections between hardware and software teams

  • Detail-focused, with rigour as the baseline for all work

  • Humility, desire to learn

  • Happy to be part of a fast-paced, open and collaborative environment

Required skills and experience:

  • Strong software skills

    • Python (or another object oriented language e.g C++)

  • Understanding of digital hardware concepts

    • Ability to read and debug RTL in SystemVerilog

    • Familiarity with debugging waveforms

Candidates with a UVM or a strong software background are encouraged to apply even without an RTL background

Desirable skills and experience:

  • Pre-silicon RTL verification

    • Verification planning and execution from specification

    • Building testbenches

    • Stimulus creation

    • Functional modelling of hardware blocks

    • Checker creation

    • Coverage definition/closure

  • Transaction-Level Modelling

    • Whether in UVM, SystemC or another methodology

  • SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA)

  • Software fluency in multiple languages

  • Open source tools for silicon development

    • Cocotb (used for all our testbench collateral), Verilator, Icarus Verilog

  • Commercial EDA tools

  • Formal verification

  • Working in a monorepo environment alongside software

    • Bazel is our chosen tool, familiarity is not expected

  • Contributing to architecture discussions

How we work

  • Ownership and execution: you will have full agency to drive your work forward

  • Rapid iteration: we all work directly with top leadership to move from idea to hardware on ambitious timelines

  • Full-stack engagement: hardware, software, silicon, and modelling teams all work closely together to create a product with generational impact

  • Optimistic and pragmatic: we possess the will to win, and to do the hard work to get us there

  • Team player mentality: the mission is bigger than any of us, and we have the curiosity and technical focus to see the best idea shipped

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior Veterinary Surgeon - Small Animal
descriptionHtml:
Senior Vet Surgeon

Salary up to £75,000 DOE

Relocation Allowance up to £5,000 plus a Welcome Bonus of up to £5000

Dragon Vets, part of inspiring vet care, are seeking an enthusiastic Veterinary Surgeon to join our Rissington site as a Senior Vet, The role will require you to help shape the future of the branch by developing the staff and supporting senior management to ensure the site thrives.

We promote further growth and development within the team, giving you access to a large client base with a wide variety of cases, equipment, CPD and a supportive team. In this role you will be working with a large team of dedicated Vets, Nurses and support team members to deliver excellent client and patient care.

The role will be based at our Rissington branch and is a full-time position, working four days per week.

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

Practice Highlights

Located in the heart of Cheltenham, renowned for horse racing and a thriving bar and restaurant scene, Dragon Vets is an established practice and has invested in specialist equipment including CT, DR, rigid and flexible endoscopy, high-end Doppler ultrasonography and well-equipped operating facilities including laparoscopic kits and TPLO kits, and much more.

We have a team of 16 vets, including certificate holders with Advanced Practitioner status in Small Animal Surgery, Cardiology and Medicine, and value evidence-based medicine with regular clinical discussions and readily available colleague support.

We function as more than a first-opinion practice, often performing complex surgeries and treating intensive medical cases that may otherwise have been referred. Having been established for decades, we have a huge client base which comes with lots of variety in caseload.

We have a dedicated, separate out-of-hours team – Vets Now – based within the same building, enabling 24-hour care. Our nursing team is made up of 17 RVNs and 4 SVNs in various stages of their training.

Working Pattern

* Average of 37 hours per week over 4 days * 1 in 4 Saturday mornings * No out-of-hours or on-call requirements * Flexible options available for both part-time and full-time applicants

Here's what the team have to say

"I started at Dragon Vets nine years ago working after school as an ACA. After leaving to go to vet school, I was welcomed back into the team as a new graduate vet in 2023. Dragon have given me a supportive and exciting start to my career. We are lucky to have the facilities in house to advance diagnostics and care beyond first opinion. I enjoy working with all the team and am proud to be a part of it." – Sofia, Vet.

How You’ll Make a Difference

As Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you will be the most senior veterinary clinician within the practice, responsible for leading clinical standards, governance and the delivery of outstanding patient and client care.

You’ll provide clinical leadership to the veterinary team, oversee complex cases and act as the primary source of clinical guidance and decision-making within the practice. Working closely with the senior practice leadership team, you’ll support the strategic direction of the practice and drive continuous improvement in clinical quality, outcomes and ways of working.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

You are a highly experienced veterinary surgeon with strong clinical expertise and a passion for leadership and clinical excellence. You’ll bring:

* A Veterinary degree and registration with the RCVS, with significant experience in small or mixed animal practice, including advanced surgical and medical capability * Proven experience in mentoring, coaching and supporting veterinary colleagues * Strong leadership, communication and decision-making skills * Experience contributing to or leading clinical governance, audits and quality improvement initiatives * The ability to manage clinical complaints and provide professional guidance in complex situations * Professionalism, integrity and a commitment to the highest standards of patient and client care

How We’ll Support You

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership and specialist roles * Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC Academy training centres and role-relevant courses * £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet * Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches and peer networks * Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities * A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement

What We Offer Our Team

* 6.6 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays * Private medical insurance * Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy * BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees * Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies) * Retail discounts and cashback offers * Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

title: Senior Web Engineer - Subscriptions
descriptionHtml:
The Subscriptions Mission is shaping the future of how millions of people discover, purchase, and experience Spotify Premium. We build the platforms and tools that power Spotify's global subscription business, enabling new offers, pricing strategies, and commerce experiences that help our business move quickly while delivering exceptional experiences for listeners.

From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services.

As a Senior Web Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale.


What You'll Do

  • Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows.

  • Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services.

  • Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows.

  • Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability.

  • Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain the reliability and availability of services powering Spotify Premium.


    • Who You Are

  • You have experience building and delivering production software across on the front end.

  • You have built modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

  • You have experience designing or consuming GraphQL APIs and enjoy building schema-driven applications.

title: SEO & GEO Lead (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:

title: Service Desk L3 - IT Operations Technical Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

#LI-IV1

The role

The Service Desk IT Operations Lead is the senior individual contributor on the Service Desk path and the senior technical escalation point for Service Desk across EMEA and APAC. The role owns and improves Service Desk processes, runbooks, escalation paths, the employee hardware lifecycle and new-hire IT onboarding, administers Service Desk tooling on behalf of its owners, and leads improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects. It acts as the bridge between the Service Desk and Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications and Security, and leads through expertise, judgment and influence rather than formal authority. It carries no line-management responsibility.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Serve as the final technical escalation point within Service Desk for high-severity, high-complexity and business-critical issues, before engagement of Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, Security or vendors; coordinate major-incident response, communication and post-incident follow-through with the relevant teams.

  • Act as consultation point for L1/L2 on complex or unusual cases: advise on troubleshooting approach, ownership, escalation path and resolution before issues are escalated.

  • Act as subject matter expert for the end-user computing environment: endpoints (Windows, macOS), mobile devices, identity and access (Entra ID / Active Directory, SSO, MFA), Microsoft 365, MDM, collaboration tools and meeting-room technology.

  • Administer and configure Service Desk tooling (e.g. Jira Service Management workflows and automation, device enrolment and MDM policy, hardware asset management tooling) as agreed with the tool and platform owners, and propose and implement improvements, including request workflows and automations used by adjacent functions. Ownership of the tools and platforms sits with IT leadership and platform owners.

  • Administer selected corporate IT systems and services according to operational requirements, including access and permissions management, service configuration and automation.

  • Maintain and improve Service Desk procedures, runbooks, escalation paths and knowledge base; propose technical standards for approval by Service Desk management and maintain them once approved; advise on operational priorities.

  • Contribute to creating and updating documentation: runbooks, process documents, technical standards and knowledge-base articles, setting the standard for documentation quality across the team.

  • Analyze ticket, escalation and SLA data to identify systemic issues and contribute to SLA reporting; lead root-cause analysis and problem management; design process, tooling and automation changes that improve first-time resolution and reduce escalation volume.

  • Assess proposed solutions and operational changes for supportability and user impact; advise management and partner teams on the support implications of technology decisions.

  • Provide organizational context on existing and legacy IT processes, systems, decisions and ownership structures; apply it when evaluating current processes, and improve legacy practices where appropriate.

  • Identify gaps or ambiguities in operational ownership and work with the relevant stakeholders to establish practical solutions.

  • Own and improve employee-lifecycle processes, including hardware provisioning and, with Onboarding and People teams, new-hire IT onboarding across EMEA and APAC.

  • Recommend standards for company-provided laptops, peripherals and other end-user equipment, balancing business need, supportability, lifecycle and market availability; maintain the approved standards.

  • Own employee hardware lifecycle processes, provisioning, replacement, reuse, return, disposal and employee resale, and provide demand forecasts and regional requirements (including Bill & Hold) to IT Supply Chain and Procurement; recommend routine purchases against agreed standards, approving only within a documented delegated spend limit.

  • Lead and continuously improve equipment reuse and employee resale, including TechShop.

  • Contribute to forecasting and budget planning for employee technology and Service Desk requirements.

  • Support Service Desk contracts, renewals and licensing; maintain working relationships with hardware and Service Desk vendors.

  • Lead Service Desk projects, system migrations, new technology rollouts, process optimization, and contribute Service Desk expertise to company initiatives such as regional expansion, office launches, organizational changes and onboarding improvements, working with Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, Security, HR/People, Onboarding, Recruiting, Procurement, Workplace/Facilities and the AV/Builds team.

  • Advise partner functions on Service Desk capabilities, procedures, requirements and dependencies, and work with them to define and improve shared operational processes (e.g. joiner/mover/leaver with People, office launches with Workplace).

  • Act as technical interviewer in Service Desk recruitment, providing structured feedback and hiring recommendations to management, and technical input to role requirements.

  • Deliver technical onboarding for new team members and mentor L1 and L2 through joint troubleshooting, coaching and knowledge transfer, documenting approaches to reduce reliance on individual knowledge.

  • Stay hands-on: support the IT Bar, queue and events alongside L1/L2 when needed, and lead by example on ticket quality and communication.

  • Provide operational evidence for audits and compliance (including equipment lifecycle and offboarding); follow security, access-governance and procurement requirements; escalate material concerns to the appropriate owner.

We expect you to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of IT support or service desk experience with demonstrated progression in responsibility.

  • Advanced technical certifications (Microsoft 365, Azure, ITIL Intermediate, Security+, etc.) strongly preferred.

  • Deep knowledge of enterprise IT systems, networks, and security practices.

  • Strong leadership, coaching, and collaboration skills.

  • Proven ability to manage high-priority incidents and lead cross-functional troubleshooting efforts.

Related Competencies

  • Knowledge & Skills

    • Recognised expert in end-user computing and support operations, with breadth across endpoints, identity, collaboration, device management and security touch points.

      Diagnoses ambiguous, cross-platform issues; experienced in root-cause analysis and process optimisation.

      Translates complex issues into clear guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Autonomy

    • Operates with a high degree of independence and trusted judgment.

      Takes the most sensitive escalations from intake to follow-up.

      Independently identifies improvements and drives them to completion; proactively pitches projects within the Service Desk domain.

      Advises management and partner teams on the support implications of technology decisions. Significant spend, strategic or organisational changes, and decisions outside delegated authority are aligned with management.

  • Complexity

    • Handles the most complex technical and operational problems in the support function: multiple systems, conflicting signals, incomplete data, elevated business risk.

      Leads escalations, often coordinating multiple IT functions.

      Designs and improves workflows and procedures where no precedent exists.

  • Impact

    • Broad impact on service reliability, SLA performance, support maturity and user experience across EMEA and APAC.

      Reduces downtime, repeat incidents and escalation volume.

      Shapes employee technology from onboarding through equipment return; ensures knowledge transfer and team readiness.

  • People / Leadership

    • Leads through expertise, coordination and example, not formal authority.

      Escalation point and mentor for L1 and L2; shapes team capability over time. Technical interviewer.

      No line management: hiring decisions, performance, compensation and other people-management accountabilities sit with Service Desk management.

 

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Embedded Linux/Software Engineer to join our Platform team (folks looking after the spacecraft). The successful candidate will play a crucial role in developing software for our satellite systems, contributing to the expansion and enhancement of our space-based data collection capabilities. Ideal candidates will embrace the commercialization of nanosatellite systems and adapt to low-cost, fast-paced systems design, development, and implementation methodologies that set Spire apart from our competition. In this fast-paced environment, the design to launch cycle is measured in weeks and months, not years!


What You’ll Do as a Embedded Linux/Software Engineer:

  • Maintain and develop daemons that interface with embedded systems using low-level protocols and higher-level protocols for business logic
  • Implement communication interfaces between embedded systems and higher-level processes
  • Integrate C libraries for specific hardware interfaces
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of fault-tolerant systems
  • Collaborate closely with the Electrical Engineering team to ensure optimal software-hardware integration
  • Spin up new designs and maintain existing products with Yocto - focused on Xilinx MPSoC systems, but we also support number of other systems


Key Skills:

  • C/C++, Bash and Python
  • Proficiency working with the Yocto framework: (for application design and base OS modifications including kernel modules)
  • Knowledge of a Linux-based development environment (Ubuntu)
  • Experience with real-time communication protocols (low level: CAN/UART/SPI/I2C)
  • Experience with inter-process communication protocols (higher level mostly IP based)
  • Understanding of electronics and ability to communicate effectively with hardware engineers (especially for board bring up and test)
  • Excellent documentation skills


Preferred Skills:

  • Working knowledge or Rust would be a bonus
  • Familiarity with safety-critical embedded systems in any industry
  • Knowledge of version control systems, particularly Git and GitHub
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with project management tools
  • Understanding of cybersecurity principles for embedded systems
  • Knowledge of telemetry and command systems
  • Experience with formal verification methods for critical software components
  • Experience in implementing Fault Detection, Isolation, and Recovery (FDIR) systems for embedded applications


Tools and Technologies: 

  • C, C++
  • Scripting languages (Bash/Python)
  • Yocto, Bitbake
  • Ubuntu (development environment)
  • Version control using Git


We value adaptability and a willingness to learn new tools and technologies as needed for the role.

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying. #LI-MI


Global Perks

🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP)
🚀 Launch Attendance
🌴 Generous Time Off Policy
🎓 Education Assistance Program
🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
👣 Family Leave
💪 Fitness Reimbursement
🧡 Employee Referral Program
🍉 Healthy snacks & beverages in every office

About Spire

We improve life on Earth with data from space.

Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire’s data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth.


Spire is Global and our success draws upon the diverse viewpoints, skills and experiences of our employees. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

To help maintain a safe and secure workplace for Spire employees, all candidates who receive a conditional offer will be required to complete a background check. This may include criminal history and employment verification.

Please take a moment to review Spire's Global Data Privacy Notice for Employees, Contractors, Candidates and Visitors, as well as Spire's Privacy Policy.

title: Solution Architect - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & IA
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Tes missions

Tu es l'architecte de la stratégie technique de nos deals Data & IA. Tu prends le lead technique des ventes de bout en bout, de la qualification du lead entrant jusqu'à la passation aux équipes de delivery. Concrètement, tu vas :

  • Qualifier techniquement les leads entrants : recueillir les exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles, identifier les préférences et contraintes du client (sécurité, performance, stack, existant) et orienter la stratégie du projet.
  • Auditer l'existant : analyser les architectures data/IA, les modèles de données, les sources et les usages en place, puis proposer une trajectoire technique crédible.
  • Concevoir la solution : définir une architecture ingénieuse et adaptée aux critères de performance du produit, en t'appuyant sur les technos classiques comme sur l'état de l'art, et en mobilisant les bons experts (dans le groupe ou à l'extérieur). Livrables : schémas d'architecture, ADR.
  • Chiffrer et construire la stratégie de réponse : estimer en fonction de la complexité technique et du budget client, construire le deck avec le Sales, et soutenir la proposition face à un métier, une DSI ou une direction data exigeante.
  • Anticiper les risques : sécuriser la faisabilité technique et la conformité des solutions vendues, et vendre de la qualité pour mettre les équipes dans les bonnes conditions.
  • Préparer le delivery : définir les équipes à staffer avec l'équipe commerciale, puis assurer la passation au kickoff pour aligner les équipes delivery sur la stratégie définie.
  • Faire de la veille et tirer l'amélioration continue : suivre les évolutions data/IA, évaluer leur pertinence pour nos offres, et capitaliser sur les deals gagnés comme sur les deals perdus.

Les sujets varient beaucoup d'un deal à l'autre : modernisation et migration de plateformes data, mise en production de modèles, plateformes GenAI, architectures agentiques, accélération du delivery par l'IA. C'est précisément cette diversité qui fait la richesse du rôle.

Tes premiers paliers

  • 3 mois : tu shadows un Solution Architect, tu mènes des qualifications en autonomie, tu as closé une première vente en binôme et participé à un cadrage.
  • 6 mois : tu es autonome sur 80 % du process, tu sais andonner au bon moment, et tu es pertinent sur les offres GenAI platform et data platform / data migration.
  • 12 mois : tu vends en autonomie un projet Data & IA, de la qualification à la négociation.

Tes perspectives d'évolution

  • Technique : Architecte senior / référent technique de la practice
  • Business / Influence : Thought Leader (animer une communauté tech) ou Intrapreneur (porter une nouvelle offre)
  • Managériale : Engineering Manager ou VP Tech

Tes moyens pour réussir

  • Accompagnement direct par le leader de la practice Data & IA et les dirigeants du groupe
  • Formations au Lean management par les plus grands coachs Lean
  • Écosystème de 500 expert·e·s tech & produit à mobiliser sur tes deals
  • Plusieurs dojos (sessions de mise en pratique) par semaine : "archi dojo", "projet dojo", etc.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience, dont un rôle au-delà du développement : Tech Lead, Architecte ou Staff Engineer.
  • Une expérience en société de services / conseil et une vraie aisance en interface client.
  • Basé·e en région parisienne, avec une présence majoritaire au bureau attendue pour ce rôle d'avant-vente.
  • Énorme envie de progresser, curiosité pour le Lean management, et attrait pour un environnement startup qui évolue vite.

Le process de recrutement

  • Call de qualification (30 min) avec un membre de l'équipe recrutement
  • Entretien valeurs & culture fit (1h)
  • Test d'architecture (1h)
  • Test storyline : soutenance d'une proposition technique (1h)
  • Entretien final avec un dirigeant (1h)
  • Remise de proposition (30 min)
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Data & IA ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Qantev is the most advanced AI Platform dedicated to helping health insurers deliver superior healthcare and claims experience to their members. By leveraging insurers' historical health claims data and applying advanced Machine Learning techniques and Generative AI, Qantev predicts patient journeys, optimizes healthcare outcomes and streamlines healthcare payers operations

Founded in 2019 and backed by top investors and industry leaders, Qantev has over 60 talented and diverse professionals based in Paris and Hong Kong, serving clients across Europe, the United States, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East.

If you are passionate about technology and the insurance industry, join Qantev and be a part of revolutionizing the insurance claims landscape with AI-driven solutions!

We are seeking a client-facing Solution Architect to own our demo experience and the technical design of our solutions for prospects and clients. The role is based in Paris.

Tasks

The Team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

You will join our Tech team, and as our Solution Architect, you will be the technical bridge between our clients, the Sales team and our Product, Data Science and Engineering teams, and the go-to expert on how Qantev's platform fits into each insurer's environment.

About the role 🚀

  • Demo Ownership: Design, build and deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of Qantev's AI-driven claims platform, from first-meeting demos to in-depth deep dives with insurers' business, medical and IT teams.
  • Demo Environments: Own and maintain our demo environments, scripts and datasets, making sure they are reliable, aligned with the latest product releases and adaptable to each client's market and use cases.
  • Proofs of Concept: Scope, plan and run POCs and pilots on client data together with our Data Science and Engineering teams, define success criteria and present the results to client decision-makers.
  • RFP/RFI & Security Reviews: Own the technical sections of RFPs/RFIs, as well as IT, security and compliance questionnaires (architecture, hosting, GDPR and local data regulations).
  • Trusted Advisor: Act as the technical point of contact for clients throughout the sales cycle, build strong relationships with their IT and business leaders, and ensure a smooth handover to the delivery team.
  • Assets & Enablement: Create and maintain reusable assets (demo scripts, architecture diagrams, technical documentation, recorded demos) and train the Sales team to deliver first-level demos.
  • Feedback Loop: Bring client and market feedback to the Product and Engineering teams to inform feature enhancements and roadmap planning.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in a solution architect, solutions engineer, pre-sales , ideally in SaaS, AI/data, insurance or healthcare.
  • Education: Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. .
  • Languages: Fluent English is required. French, Spanish, Portuguese or an Asian language are a plus.
  • Proven track record of delivering engaging, high-impact demos to both C-level and technical audiences, with strong storytelling skills.
  • Solid technical background: software and cloud architecture (AWS, Azure or GCP), APIs and integration patterns, data pipelines, security; hands-on with SQL and/or Python to prepare demo data.
  • Good understanding of AI, Machine Learning and Generative AI concepts. Knowledge of health insurance or claims processes is a strong plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical topics simple and convincing, both orally and in writing.
  • Client-first mindset: you enjoy being in front of clients, listening to their challenges and shaping tailored solutions.
  • Autonomous and structured, able to manage several opportunities in parallel in a fast-paced scale-up environment.
  • Willingness to travel internationally (Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East, Latin America) as required.

Benefits

Professional Growth & Impact:

Opportunity to join a challenging environment among top-notch engineers and experienced entrepreneurs.

Develop a deep understanding of the health insurance industry.

Take part in scaling a global tech start-up.

Compensation & Perks:

Best-in-class laptop and equipment.

Annual company off-site.

Access to the vibrant start-up ecosystem benefits.

Swile (daily lunch vouchers).

Navigo reimbursement.

Process ⌚

  • Screen call with CTO
  • 1st interview - Business Case with VP Delivery
  • 2nd interview - Tech test with CTO + team
  • 3rd interview - Meet the team & CEO

title: Solutions Architect - Pre Sales
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're the agentic platform for end-to-end underwriting work that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

Solutions is the technical core of our go-to-market organisation. The team sits at the intersection of product, sales, and customer success, owning the technical win in each opportunity and making hx platform real for some of the most demanding insurers in the world. We work with underwriters, actuaries, IT, and security leaders to design solutions they can trust with their most critical pricing and underwriting decisions.

This is a team that thrives at the edge of what’s possible for our product and our customers. We specialise in the hardest integration and implementation challenges, where deep technical understanding, domain insight, and creativity are all required. As a Solutions Architect, you’ll be one of the first hx’ers many prospects meet, shaping how they understand our platform and what it can do for their business.

Solutions Architects at hx are the voice of IT, security and infrastructure - both inside hx and in front of customers. We figure out how hx fits into complex, often ancient system landscapes, translating between modern cloud architectures and 1990s reality without losing sight of the bigger transformation.

The culture is high-ownership, collaborative, and very visible: every engagement is high stakes, every interaction leaves a lasting impression, and your work feeds directly into both revenue outcomes and product direction. You’ll partner closely with Sales and Product Engineering, acting as a trusted advisor and helping customers realise the full value of hx agentic platform.

What you’ll be doing

  • Accelerating the Tech Win by translating prospect requirements and legacy constraints into clear, actionable integration approaches aligned to our onboarding and integration playbooks.

  • Run focused, high-impact technical discovery and design workshops with underwriters, actuaries, and IT stakeholders to deeply understand their workflows and shape viable solution architectures.

  • Act as the trusted technical voice guiding stakeholders through RFPs, RFIs, due diligence, and security reviews to remove friction and keep deals moving.

  • Design, build, and present compelling POV (Proof of Value) materials, Proofs of Concept and demos that showcase the hx agentic platform integration capabilities and how we can transform customers’ pricing and underwriting processes.

  • Partner with Product Engineering as “Customer Zero”, testing new features in real-world scenarios, surfacing edge cases, and feeding back insights that improve product quality and relevance.

  • Create and maintain reusable assets – from integration libraries and reference architectures to demo environments and technical presentations – that scale the impact of the Field Engineering team across multiple deals and regions.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Led technical solution design and integration for complex B2B or enterprise software opportunities, ideally in data-heavy domains such as insurance, financial services, or adjacent regulated industries.

  • Run technical evaluations and POVs with multiple stakeholder groups (e.g. business, IT, security), successfully navigating RFP/RFI processes, due diligence, and technical Q&A to a clear “Tech Win”.

  • Designed, documented and positioned solution architectures within known patterns (e.g. APIs, event-driven integrations, identity and access management), clearly articulating assumptions, risks, and trade-offs.

  • Built and delivered tailored Proofs of Concept or Proof of Value that directly contributed to winning or expanding high-value accounts, ideally with measurable commercial impact.

  • Collaborated closely with Sales teams, using structured sales methodologies to align technical work with deal strategy, timing, and stakeholder influence.

  • Contributed to shared technical assets and standards – such as playbooks, reference diagrams, or demo environments – and used structured learning habits (enablement, shadowing, self-study) to quickly ramp up on new products or domains.

  • AI-native in practice - Uses AI tools as a natural part of technical and delivery work - documentation, troubleshooting, first-pass analysis - not exploring what's possible but already doing it.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer to follow a fixed, prescriptive playbook rather than dealing with ambiguity, evolving requirements, and messy legacy environments.

  • You’re uncomfortable being highly visible – with customers, internally with senior stakeholders, and in situations where the stakes (and expectations) are high.

  • You see yourself purely as either “sales” or “engineering” and don’t enjoy operating in the grey space between commercial outcomes, technical depth, and product thinking.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  • Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off

  • Manager interview with our Director of Solutions Engineering

  • Skills Assessment Stage

  • Values interview

  • Meet the CEO

  • We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Our Solutions Architecture team understands high-level business strategy and translates it into technical requirements for our customers. We love figuring out ways to stretch the limits of what is technically possible. Our job is to provide technical leadership and guidance to customers, prospects, and partners, helping them visualise the steps to achieve their business objectives, and then delivering the outcome with them.

This role spans the whole customer journey. Before the sale, you are the technical lead alongside our Sales team, shaping the solution and earning the technical win. After the sale, you stay with the customer and deliver it, owning the hands-on work that turns a signed contract into a working, adopted capability. You own the outcome, not just the design. When a customer asks a question, you answer it.

As a Solutions Architect, you'll develop a deep understanding of Chainalysis' solutions and offerings, explaining complex topics to a variety of audiences in a compelling yet understandable way. You'll directly impact some of our most strategic private sector customers, and throughout all of these activities you'll provide feedback that improves the value and experience customers have with Chainalysis' solutions.

In this role, you'll:

  • Partner with the Sales team as the technical lead, running discovery, demonstrations, and proofs of value, and leading the discussions on value creation and solution development that achieve the technical win

  • Design customer-specific solutions for the deployment and integration of Chainalysis products, and give guidance on technical challenges ranging from high-level architecture to code implementation

  • Own the post-sale customer experience end to end, configuring, deploying, and tuning our products yourself rather than coordinating others who do it, and working alongside customer teams so they become self-sufficient

  • Drive sustained adoption and measurable value, from fast onboarding through to the ongoing work of monitoring usage, reviewing product health, tuning rules and alerts, and intervening when adoption slips

  • Map customer workflows to capabilities across the product suite, including investigations, compliance, security, and data analysis solutions

  • Investigate using Chainalysis tooling to a competent standard, tracing, attributing, and analysing on the platform, so you can surface actionable insights and integrate Chainalysis into the customer's compliance and risk workflows

  • Be the person customers look to for answers, resolving technical, compliance, analytical, and operational questions directly, and owning time-sensitive decisions by validating signals quickly and moving the right matters through the correct escalation path

  • Communicate and translate complex technical requirements to our Product and Engineering teams, including data gaps such as unclustered or unattributed services that you find in the field

  • Become a trusted technical advisor to both internal and external customers, identifying business opportunities and substantially increasing our foothold with private sector customers and prospects

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • Worked in or directly with our private sector customer types: banks, cryptocurrency exchanges, payment processors, and blockchain developers

  • Practical understanding of compliance, investigative, and risk workflows, and can speak credibly from practitioner experience in investigations, compliance, fraud, risk, or security

  • A technical generalist background, comfortable with REST API integrations and familiar with how data is structured in SQL, and always interested in learning more

  • Experience of account or customer management for an enterprise SaaS business, including commercial awareness and partnering with sales counterparts on renewals and expansion

  • The ability to communicate clearly with both technical and executive audiences

  • Curiosity, fast learning, and motivation to solve difficult customer problems

  • A collaborative approach and generosity with knowledge

  • Fluency in English

Nice to have experience:

  • Financial compliance and anti-money laundering obligations

  • Proficiency in Python, REST API integrations, and SQL databases

  • Hands-on use of AI tooling to improve delivery quality or speed

  • Experience handling sensitive data and proprietary methods, and protecting them while using them effectively

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet - PACA)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

  

- Tu intègres Pennylane et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

  

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

 

Compétences requises

 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

 

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

title: Sr. Director, Evergreen Subscription Sales (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

The Sr. Director, Evergreen Subscription Sales leads the strategy, vision, and execution of Evergreen subscription sales across EMEA. This role translates global portfolio direction and company objectives into segment-specific commercial strategies, sales motions, operating models, and performance mechanisms that increase subscription adoption, recurring revenue, pipeline progression, customer value, and commercial effectiveness worldwide.

The Senior Director leads a global Evergreen Subscription Sales organisation and establishes the priorities, standards, resources, and operating cadence required to execute consistently across regions. The role partners with the Strategics and GSI segment leadership teams, Regional Sales, Account Executives, alliance and partner leaders, and executive stakeholders across Product, Finance, Customer Success, Marketing, Services, and Operations. The role has broad responsibility and significant operational latitude within the defined segments, while the Global VP retains overall ownership of the Evergreen portfolio strategy and global portfolio direction.

Key Responsibilities

title: Staff Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.

You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval.

What you'll work on:

  • Designing an agent-native search system that handles everything from low-latency single-hop search to complex deep search tasks requiring iterative planning, querying, refinement and reasoning.

  • Training ranking and retrieval models optimized for agent-driven workflows under real world constraints

  • Bringing the latest advances from the research community to our search stack and ship it to production.

Your responsibilities:

  • Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems

  • Design and evolve multi-stage retrieval architectures (query understanding, rewriting, retrieval, reranking and iterative retrieval)

  • Lead experimentation on modern retrieval approaches (embedding research, sparse and hybrid retrieval, reranking, context compression) and bring them into production

  • Develop methods for grounding LLMs in real-time web data at scale, using trust, quality and freshness signals to surface reliable sources

  • Partner with the evaluation team to define new metrics for agentic systems, where correctness is not reducible to clicks

  • Analyze trade-offs across relevance, latency, and cost, and work closely with engineering to deploy systems that operate at web scale

  • Mentor researchers and engineers and help raise the technical bar of the team

Must haves:

  • 8+ years of experience in applied AI, ML, or software engineering

  • Proven track record of shipping ML or AI systems to production at scale

  • Deep experience with search, retrieval, ranking or building RAG-based assistants

  • Strong understanding of modern deep learning, especially transformers and embeddings

  • Experience with LLM-integrated or knowledge-intensive systems

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks and metrics for ML systems

  • Strong programming skills in Python

  • Top-tier publications (ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, AAAI, EMNLP, ACL)

  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving, product-driven environment with high ownership and autonomy

Nice to haves

  • Background in agentic AI systems (agents, tool use, autonomous workflows)

  • Experience with RL post-training of LLMs or VLMs
