title: Staff Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About us 

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. 

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of a family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. 

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. We bring together specialists across AI research, silicon design, software engineering and systems to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful impact. 

Job Summary 

Initially reporting to the Head of Data & Transformation, you will help business teams improve how they work and make decisions through process change, data analytics and AI-assisted and agentic workflows. Working closely with the Data Enablement Lead, you will independently lead complex, agreed initiatives from discovery and process mapping through requirements definition, hands-on analysis, prototyping, implementation and adoption. You will help teams find and use trusted data, embed analytics and agentic workflows into everyday activities, and achieve measurable improvements in business outcomes. 

The Team 

The Data & Transformation team brings together data capability and business transformation to improve how Graphcore operates and makes decisions. The team builds trusted data foundations, enables effective access to information and delivers cross-functional change to business processes, systems and ways of working. 

You will partner directly with business teams, the Data Enablement Lead, Analytics Engineers and Project Managers. The Data Enablement Lead owns the overall data enablement approach, opportunity pipeline and shared solution standards. You will own end-to-end delivery of agreed initiatives within those approaches and standards, contributing new opportunities and improvements through practical delivery experience. 

Responsibilities and Duties 

  • Lead business discovery and identify opportunities. Facilitate workshops to understand business objectives, information needs, current ways of working and underlying problems. Identify recurring needs and bring evidence-based opportunities to the Data Enablement Lead, considering business value, feasibility, risk and potential for reuse across teams. 
  • Map and improve processes. Document current-state and future-state processes, including activities, decisions, ownership, handovers, controls, systems and data flows. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort and improve the quality and timeliness of decisions. 
  • Own requirements definition. Translate business needs into clear, prioritised requirements, business rules, user stories and acceptance criteria. Build agreement with stakeholders and maintain traceability between the original need, proposed changes, delivered functionality and intended outcomes. 
  • Deliver hands-on analytics. Use SQL to explore organisational and warehouse data, test hypotheses, investigate discrepancies and identify patterns or causes of operational problems. Build and validate repeatable analyses, reports, dashboards and measures that support business decisions, communicating findings and data limitations clearly. 
  • Enable agentic self-service data use. Work with the Data Enablement Lead and Analytics Engineers to translate business questions and process needs into practical self-service data experiences. Help users discover data, ask questions, interpret trusted metrics and act on results. Validate that analytical and agentic interactions use agreed business definitions and meet user needs. 
  • Recommend practical solution approaches. Assess whether a need is best addressed through process changes, self-service analytics, existing tools, conventional automation or agentic workflows. Work with the Data Enablement Lead and technical colleagues to balance business value, usability, complexity, risk, implementation effort and ongoing support. 
  • Design agentic workflows. Map how users, agents, systems and data should interact, using agreed solution patterns and access controls. Define business rules, proposed agent actions, human approval points, exception handling and fallback processes. Work with the Data Enablement Lead and technical colleagues on decisions affecting shared architecture or controls. 
  • Prototype, evaluate and validate solutions. Use AI-assisted development tools to develop and iterate analytical and agentic workflow prototypes, reviewing generated code and outputs against agreed quality standards. Work with technical colleagues to test realistic business scenarios, outputs, actions and failure cases. Coordinate user acceptance testing and validate solutions against agreed requirements. 
  • Use trusted data and appropriate controls. Partner with Analytics Engineers to define data requirements, clarify metric definitions and resolve data-quality issues. Apply agreed expectations for data access, sensitive information handling, documentation and traceability of automated actions. 
  • Own delivery of agreed initiatives. Develop practical delivery plans, coordinate business and technical contributions, and manage scope, priorities, dependencies and risks. Make evidence-based decisions within your remit, working with your line manager and the Data Enablement Lead to resolve wider prioritisation or design decisions. 
  • Support implementation and adoption. Help business teams introduce new processes and incorporate analytics and agentic workflows into daily activities. Clarify ownership, provide guidance and training, support operational handover and help users understand appropriate use, limitations and escalation routes. 
  • Measure outcomes and improve reliability. Agree success measures and establish baselines with business stakeholders. Review adoption, analytical accuracy, workflow reliability and business outcomes after implementation. Use evidence and user feedback to improve solutions and address unintended results. 
  • Strengthen shared capability. Contribute reusable analytical methods, process-mapping approaches, workflow patterns and testing practices. Provide constructive peer review, coaching and practical guidance to help colleagues and business users develop their skills and confidence. 

Candidate Profile 

Essential 

  • Demonstrated experience combining hands-on data analysis with business process improvement, taking complex initiatives from problem definition through delivery, implementation and adoption. 
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to explore analytical or warehouse data, investigate discrepancies, validate assumptions and assess data quality. 
  • Strong business analysis skills, including stakeholder discovery, current-state and future-state process mapping, requirements definition, business rules and acceptance criteria. 
  • Hands-on experience prototyping or evaluating AI-assisted or agentic workflows using business data, including testing outputs and actions, identifying failure cases and defining appropriate human oversight. 
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools for prototyping, analysis or technical problem-solving, with the ability to critically review generated code and outputs. 
  • Experience using business intelligence or data visualisation tools to develop practical analyses, reports or dashboards, supported by clearly defined and reliable measures. 
  • Strong analytical judgement and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify underlying causes, evaluate solution options and recognise when a simpler approach is more appropriate. 
  • Strong facilitation, communication and influencing skills, including the ability to lead workshops, explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences and build agreement without relying on formal authority. 
  • Ability to independently plan and lead complex work, coordinate contributions across business and technical teams, manage competing priorities and make pragmatic delivery decisions. 
  • Experience testing and validating solutions, documenting changes and supporting users through implementation and adoption, with an understanding of appropriate data access and sensitive information handling. 

Desirable 

  • Experience implementing and supporting agentic workflows in production, including monitoring reliability, managing exceptions and supporting user adoption. 
  • Experience using Python or comparable tools for repeatable analysis, workflow prototyping or lightweight automation. 
  • Familiarity with APIs, curated datasets, semantic-layer concepts and analytics engineering practices. 
  • Experience enabling self-service analytics or applying structured process improvement and change management methods. 
  • Experience working in a technology, engineering or fast-moving product environment. 

Benefits

In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications

descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Location: France, Germany, Spain, or Italy — remote within these hiring locations.

Join us as a Staff Applied AI Engineer, Backend to build production systems in which AI is a core runtime capability. You'll help Qonto's Anti-Financial Crime teams investigate cases faster and with greater confidence by turning complex operational workflows into dependable, measurable tools.

➡️ As a Staff Applied AI Engineer you will

  • Build production AI systems: Design and ship agentic tools and AI-powered workflows that gather context from multiple internal systems, orchestrate models and tools, parse structured outputs, and handle uncertainty and failure safely

  • Own projects end to end: Lead discovery with AFC stakeholders, shape the solution, make architectural decisions, implement and launch it, then operate, maintain, and improve it in production

  • Design robust backend foundations: Build reliable, maintainable, and extensible services, APIs, databases, and integrations around evolving AI models and tooling

  • Make AI behaviour measurable: Define evaluation approaches, observability, fallbacks, and human-review mechanisms; monitor output quality, acceptance and edit rates, throughput, and operational impact

  • Deliver measurable operational value: Reduce investigation lead time and expand automation across AFC workflows through pragmatic, incremental delivery

  • Shape the team’s technical direction: Lead design discussions, anticipate risks, balance speed with quality, and help raise the team’s capability in production agentic systems

➡️ What you can expect

  • AI at the heart of the system: This is not a conventional backend role using AI only as a coding assistant, nor an ML research role. You’ll build real products where model behaviour, orchestration, evaluation, and failure handling are production concerns

  • High autonomy: There is no dedicated Product Manager. Engineers work directly with AFC stakeholders and own the path from an ambiguous operational need to a measurable production outcome

  • Lean, iterative delivery: The team uses a daily 15-minute blocker sync, bi-weekly 1:1s, and lightweight tracking, leaving engineers focused on building and solving problems

  • A close user feedback loop: You’ll collaborate directly with operational teams and measure success through investigation lead-time reduction, output quality, human acceptance and edit rates, adoption, throughput, and resources saved

  • A complex, meaningful domain: You’ll learn how to build safe, scalable AI automation in a regulated environment where reliability and auditability matter

➡️ Your future team

You’ll join Qonto’s AI Compliance Tooling team within the Financial Crime Compliance domain. The current team brings together Ioannis, the Tech Lead and a hands-on contributor; Staff Backend Engineer Enrique; Staff Machine Learning Engineer Luca; and Senior Backend Engineers Izan and Robson. The team is growing with two additional staff-level hybrid backend/AI hires.

One important clarification: the team does not build fraud-detection engines or KYC/KYB rule engines. It consumes upstream signals and builds the AI-powered automation and intelligence layer used by human investigators. One current system gathers information from 10–15 internal tools and produces a structured compliance analysis for a person to approve or edit, reducing treatment time from approximately 15–20 minutes to about 30 seconds.

➡️ About you

  • Production AI experience: You have shipped an AI agent or agentic workflow used by real users and can explain its orchestration, tool use, state, structured outputs, evaluation, retries, and failure modes

  • Strong backend engineering: You bring solid system-design fundamentals across architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, reliability, observability, maintainability, and scalability

  • Staff-level autonomy and judgement: You make sound decisions independently, communicate trade-offs clearly, and know when to optimise for speed and when quality is non-negotiable

  • Product and stakeholder thinking: You can turn ambiguous operational pain into a valuable solution, challenge assumptions, prioritise scope, and define success without relying on a PM

  • End-to-end ownership: You are willing to discover, build, ship, operate, maintain, and continuously improve the systems you create

  • Learning agility: You are curious about AFC and regulated workflows and can ramp up quickly in a complex domain; prior fintech or compliance experience is helpful, not required

  • Pragmatic technology choices: Python experience and familiarity with current model providers or agent frameworks are useful, but transferable production principles matter more than expertise in a specific language or vendor

Flow Engineering is an AI-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor.

title: Stage of Afstuderen: Toepassing van Augmented Reality
descriptionHtml:
Wat ga je doen?

Binnen Service & Support onderzoeken we hoe Augmented Reality (AR) kan bijdragen aan een efficiëntere en effectievere dienstverlening. Nieuwe technologieën bieden steeds meer mogelijkheden om klanten en monteurs op afstand te ondersteunen en stilstand van machines te beperken. Wij willen inzicht krijgen in welke toepassingen voor Voortman relevant zijn en hoe deze structureel ingezet kunnen worden binnen onze serviceorganisatie.

Tijdens deze stage onderzoek je de technische en organisatorische mogelijkheden van Augmented Reality binnen service en remote support. Je analyseert verschillende toepassingsmogelijkheden, waaronder het gebruik van een RealWear Smart Glass voor ondersteuning op afstand. Daarnaast onderzoek je welke procesveranderingen nodig zijn om AR succesvol te implementeren en welke voordelen dit kan opleveren voor de kwaliteit, snelheid en efficiëntie van onze serviceprocessen.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het onderzoeken van de mogelijkheden van Augmented Reality binnen customer service, remote support en field service;

  • Het analyseren van de inzet van de RealWear Smart Glass voor het ondersteunen van monteurs en klanten op afstand;

  • Het in kaart brengen van benodigde procesveranderingen voor de implementatie van Smart Glasses;

  • Het bepalen van mogelijke procesverbeteringen op het gebied van efficiëntie, reactietijd en servicekwaliteit.

Het eindresultaat van de opdracht is een onderbouwd implementatieplan waarmee Voortman de inzet van Augmented Reality binnen haar serviceorganisatie kan beoordelen en verder ontwikkelen.


Wij vragen

  • Een HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Applicatie Technologie of vergelijkbaar.

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

title: Stagiair(e) Digitale Transformatie & Publieke Innovatie
descriptionHtml:
Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Digitalisering verandert de manier waarop overheden en publieke organisaties werken, besluiten nemen en dienstverlening organiseren. Tegelijkertijd groeit de behoefte aan praktische oplossingen, toepasbare kennis en slimme instrumenten die organisaties helpen om complexe digitale vraagstukken beheersbaar te maken.

Wil jij ervaring opdoen binnen een toonaangevend adviesbureau en bijdragen aan vraagstukken op het gebied van digitalisering, data, digitale autonomie en publieke innovatie? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou.

Dit ga je doen

Als stagiair(e) binnen het team Digitale Transformatie ondersteun je adviseurs bij uiteenlopende opdrachten voor ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, provincies, gemeenten en andere maatschappelijke organisaties.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ondersteunen bij onderzoeken, analyses en adviesopdrachten.

  • Voorbereiden en ondersteunen van workshops, werksessies en bijeenkomsten voor opdrachtgevers.

  • Meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van praktische handreikingen, methodieken en kennisproducten.

  • Uitwerken van onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete producten voor opdrachtgevers.

  • Actualiseren en verrijken van onze website, publicaties en online kennisproducten.

  • Structureren, actualiseren en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande kenniscollecties tot een deelbare kenniscatalogus.

  • Uitvoeren van markt- en deskresearch naar ontwikkelingen op het gebied van digitalisering, data en digitale autonomie.

  • Ondersteunen bij de doorontwikkeling van onze digitale-autonomie-quickscan en andere proposities.

Afhankelijk van jouw interesses en achtergrond draai je bovendien mee in lopende adviesprojecten.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één,

krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je wordt onderdeel van het team Digitale Transformatie binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur van Berenschot.

Ons team ondersteunt organisaties bij vraagstukken rond digitale strategie, informatiehuishouding, digitale autonomie, datastrategie, cybersecurity en continuiteit, governance, dienstverlening en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij combineren we inhoudelijke kennis van technologie met inzicht in recht, bestuur, beleid en organisatie.

Je werkt samen met adviseurs met uiteenlopende achtergronden, waaronder bestuurskunde, informatiemanagement, bedrijfskunde, data en technologie. Vanaf dag één krijg je verantwoordelijkheid en lever je een concrete bijdrage aan opdrachten en producten.


Dit neem je mee

Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding op het snijvlak van data, digitalisering, IT en organisatievraagstukken, bijvoorbeeld informatiemanagement, business IT & management, digital business, data science & business, technische bedrijfskunde, bestuurskunde (met een focus op digitalisering), bedrijfskunde (met een focus op technologie of innovatie) of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je affiniteit met digitalisering en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

  • Ben je analytisch sterk en nieuwsgierig.

  • Werk je zelfstandig en gestructureerd.

  • Kun je complexe informatie helder opschrijven.

  • Vind je het leuk om kennis te ontwikkelen én praktisch toepasbaar te maken.

Dit bieden we jou

  • Een meewerkstage van 4 tot 6 maanden.

  • Startdatum januari/februari 2027.

  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,- per maand (op fulltimebasis).

  • Een laptop.

  • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding door een ervaren adviseur.

  • Een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng.

  • De mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven.

  • De mogelijkheid om in te stromen in het traineeship van Berenschot.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Marielle Boer via WhatsApp (06 10 48 71 59) of per e-mail ----- voor informatie over de procedure.

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve eerste indruk nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Als dat goed aansluit, ontvang je een concreet aanbod.

title: Strategic Account Executive - Switzerland
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced, driven Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Switzerland's largest enterprises. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Swiss brands and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

In this role you will:

  • Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Switzerland to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

  • Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for consumer and retail brands.

  • Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to Swiss consumer and retail organizations operating at scale.

  • Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.

  • Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Swiss consumer and retail sector, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

  • Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

  • Well-connected in the Swiss consumer and retail landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

  • Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Switzerland, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

  • Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

  • Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

  • A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.

  • Swiss German is the preferred default language for this role; fluency in both Swiss German and French is a strong plus given Switzerland's multilingual market. Strong English is also required for internal collaboration.

Location

This is an in-country role based in Zurich.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Supply Chain & Operations Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What you will do

  • Support in process design and development. Working together with our engineering team to implement new processes to increase efficiency of business processes and reduce manual processes

  • Create strong, reliable and long-term relationships with our business partners through quality work and clear communication

  • Identify and engage with potential suppliers and service providers, cultivating strong relationships to drive user acquisition and transaction volume on the platform.

  • Support the team in day-to-day operational activities and contribute to the overall success of the business's operations

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills in German and English. C1 German is required for this role.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

  • Initially focus on non-technical questions related to account management, account access, plans, subscriptions, and billing.

  • Provide clear, helpful, and timely responses that solve customer problems while gradually expanding your expertise into more technical topics.

Automate and Scale Support Operations

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, non-technical ticket categories and reduce manual support work.

  • Build and improve automations that help Team Delta handle growing ticket volumes efficiently without compromising the customer experience.

  • Continuously spot opportunities to streamline support workflows and make it easier for customers to get the answers they need.

Strengthen Product Alignment and Knowledge Sharing

  • Collaborate with Product to share recurring customer questions, highlight friction points, and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Create and maintain documentation that enables customers to self-serve and helps the team resolve common issues more efficiently.

  • Participate in team meetings and cross-functional discussions to share insights, align on priorities, and improve the support experience.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Technical Support Expertise: You have 3+ years in technical support, solutions engineering, or similar roles

  • n8n Experience: You have hands-on experience building and debugging n8n workflows in production environments

  • APIs & Integrations: You’re comfortable debugging APIs, webhooks, authentication, and data flows

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: You’re familiar with AWS, GCP, or Azure and have basic Linux fundamentals for troubleshooting

  • Networking & Databases: You understand networking basics (DNS, SSL/TLS, HTTP/HTTPS)

  • Communication: You explain technical issues clearly and document troubleshooting steps effectively

  • Containerization: You can work with Docker or Kubernetes to deploy and debug automation environments

title: System Engineer – MFT, EDI & Email Security 80%-100%
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind ein spezialisiertes IT-Unternehmen mit weniger als 10 Mitarbeitenden und konzentrieren uns auf die Bereiche Managed File Transfer (MFT), Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) und Email Security.

Als IT-Reseller und Lösungsanbieter begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle – von der technischen Beratung und Konzeption über die Implementierung und Integration bis hin zum Betrieb und Support.

Unsere Lösungen sind häufig ein zentraler Bestandteil der IT- und Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden. Entsprechend wichtig sind uns technische Qualität, zuverlässige Umsetzung, saubere Kommunikation und ein professioneller Umgang mit Kunden und Partnern.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen System Engineer, der unsere Kundenprojekte technisch begleitet und gemeinsam mit unserem Team anspruchsvolle Integrations- und Infrastrukturaufgaben umsetzt.

Als System Engineer bist du Teil unseres technischen Teams und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Implementierung, Integration und Betreuung unserer Lösungen.

Du arbeitest sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team und hast direkten Kontakt zu unseren Kunden. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Applikationen, Infrastruktur, Netzwerken und Geschäftsprozessen.

Je nach Erfahrung und Interesse übernimmst du zunehmend Verantwortung für eigene Kundenumgebungen und Projekte.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Engineering & Projektumsetzung

  • Planung, Installation, Konfiguration und Inbetriebnahme unserer Softwarelösungen

  • Technische Umsetzung von MFT-, EDI- und Email-Security-Projekten

  • Integration unserer Lösungen in bestehende Enterprise-IT-Infrastrukturen

  • Umsetzung von Schnittstellen und Systemintegrationen

  • Konfiguration und Anbindung von Kommunikationspartnern, Applikationen und Umsystemen

  • Begleitung von Migrationen, Upgrades und Systemerweiterungen

  • Durchführung von technischen Tests und Abnahmen

  • Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Systemarchitekturen

  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen und Betriebskonzepte

Troubleshooting & Support

  • Analyse und Behebung komplexer technischer Störungen

  • Systematisches Troubleshooting auf Applikations-, Netzwerk- und Infrastruktur-Ebene

  • Analyse von Logs, Systemmeldungen und Kommunikationsabläufen

  • Unterstützung bei Incidents und Problem Management

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Herstellern und deren 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support

  • Technische Unterstützung unserer Kunden im laufenden Betrieb

Kunden & Projekte

  • Direkter technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden

  • Aufnahme und Analyse technischer Anforderungen

  • Erarbeitung und Umsetzung von Lösungsansätzen

  • Technische Beratung unserer Kunden und Unterstützung bei Architekturentscheidungen

  • Mitarbeit bei der Planung und Durchführung von Kundenprojekten

  • Koordination technischer Aufgaben mit Kunden, Partnern und Herstellern

Dein technischer Hintergrund

Du verfügst über eine solide technische Basis und hast Freude daran, dich auch in komplexe Systeme und neue Technologien einzuarbeiten.

Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche mit:

Systeme & Infrastruktur

  • Windows Server und/oder Linux

  • Virtualisierung und grundlegende Kenntnisse moderner Infrastrukturplattformen

  • Active Directory und grundlegende Identity-Konzepte

  • Netzwerk- und Infrastrukturkomponenten

  • Backup, Monitoring und Systemmanagement

Netzwerk & Kommunikation

  • HTTP/HTTPS/AS2

  • TLS/SSL und Zertifikatsmanagement

  • Firewall- und Netzwerkgrundlagen

  • SFTP/FTPS/SSH

  • Verständnis für sichere System- und Datenkommunikation

Integration & Automation

  • REST APIs und Web Services

  • Sicherheit im Umgang mit XML, JSON, CSV und weiteren strukturierten Datenformaten

  • Scripting und Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit PowerShell oder Bash

  • Verständnis von Datenflüssen und Systemintegrationen

  • Kenntnisse von EDI-Prozessen und gängigen EDI-Standards sind von Vorteil

Security

  • Grundverständnis von IT-Security-Konzepten

  • Verschlüsselung und Zertifikatsmanagement

  • Grundverständnis von Security Best Practices

Das bringst du persönlich mit

Neben deinen technischen Fähigkeiten sind uns folgende Eigenschaften besonders wichtig:

  • Analytische und strukturierte Denkweise

  • Ausgeprägtes Interesse an technischen Zusammenhängen

  • Selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Zuverlässigkeit

  • Freude am Troubleshooting und an der Suche nach nachhaltigen Lösungen

  • Professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kunden

  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit – auch bei komplexen technischen Themen

  • Teamorientierung und Bereitschaft, Wissen zu teilen

  • Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und Aufgaben selbstständig zu organisieren

  • Interesse an neuen Technologien und kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung

Was wir dir bieten

Bei uns arbeitest du nicht an beliebigen Standard-IT-Aufgaben, sondern an spezialisierten Lösungen mit direkter Relevanz für die Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden.

Du erhältst Einblick in unterschiedliche Kundenumgebungen und Technologien und kannst dein Know-how in den Bereichen Integration, Security, MFT und EDI kontinuierlich erweitern.

Kleines Team, grosse Verantwortung

Mit weniger als 10 Mitarbeitenden sind unsere Hierarchien kurz und die Kommunikationswege direkt.

Bei uns kannst du:

  • Verantwortung für eigene Kunden und Projekte übernehmen

  • technische Lösungen aktiv mitgestalten

  • eigene Ideen einbringen

  • direkt mit Entscheidern und technischen Ansprechpartnern unserer Kunden arbeiten

  • dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln

  • Wissen mit erfahrenen Kollegen austauschen

Unser Arbeitsumfeld

Als engagiertes Team legen wir grossen Wert auf ein offenes, kollegiales und respektvolles Arbeitsklima.

Wir arbeiten professionell und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch, ohne unnötige Hierarchien oder Konzernbürokratie. Gegenseitige Unterstützung und ein unkomplizierter Umgang miteinander gehören für uns genauso dazu wie eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten.

title: Tacto Labs: Fast-Track Builder Program
descriptionHtml:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto's sales-led motion in DACH works: more than 300 industrial companies run on Tacto. Tacto Labs is where we build what comes nest: new products and wedges that don't scale linearly with headcount. Each bet starts on a whiteboard and either becomes a real business inside Tacto or gets killed fast.

 

What you'll do

  • Take a bet from idea to first paying users, working directly with our founders

  • Build it yourself with AI: prototype, landing pages, agents, outreach, whatever proves or kills the idea fastest

  • Talk to customers and suppliers until you know. more about the problem than anyone else in the company

  • Find the next compounding loop and scale what works

 

How it fits

Everybody in Tacto Labs is a Builder: same role, same bar, pointed at earlier stage problems. We believe in building over strategizing.

 

Who we're looking for

  • You've built something from zero: as a founder, early at a startup, or during a side project.

  • You want to found something someday. We're looking for people we'd back if they did.

  • You don't come from engineering? Great, as long as you build. If you've shipped something with with AI tools, you're technical enough to start and get better.

  • Extreme ownership, no ego.

  • Fluent in German; English is a strong plus.

 

How the process works

  1. Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)

  3. On-site day: a case with three Builders and Pool Leads (1 hour), Meet the Team (30 min)

How we work

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes. Trust is high and feedback is direct. We offer competitive salary and meaningful equity.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

At VÆRIDION, we're building the Microliner, a fully electric aircraft, and the battery technology that powers it. To make that happen, we need great people, and as our Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders), you'll play a key role in bringing them on board.

As part of our People & Culture team, you'll own recruiting end to end for your positions and advise our hiring managers as a true partner. You'll make sure every candidate gets a process that is fast, honest, and personal. You'll also keep improving how we find and hire talent. Our goal is to ensure that every candidate leaves the process with a positive impression of VÆRIDION, regardless of the outcome.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Understand your hiring managers' requirements and advise them on recruiting, including relevant market insights, realistic timelines, and candidate availability.

  • Design and run sourcing strategies, including direct outreach, talent mapping, and networks, to reach passive candidates in competitive markets.

  • Lead complex and cross-functional hiring processes, and influence hiring decisions with structured interviews and data-driven recommendations.

  • Negotiate offers and close candidates.

Your Profile:

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Teamlead Content Strategist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
ÜBER NEOLYMP

NEOLYMP ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir erfolgreich über Amazon sowie unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Als schnell wachsende E-Commerce-Marke arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, unsere Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Kompetenzen intern aufzubauen. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt dabei auf dem Aufbau unseres Inhouse-Grafikbereichs sowie der Entwicklung moderner, KI-gestützter Creative-Prozesse.

Aufgaben

WARUM DIESE ROLLE

  • Du bestimmst, was gebaut wird: Angles, Hooks, Konzepte, Funnel-Logik – du entscheidest, welche Creatives entstehen und warum. Das Grafikteam setzt um, was du konzipierst.
  • Direkter Hebel auf Umsatz: Deine Konzepte laufen auf Meta und weiteren Paid-Kanälen, auf Landingpages und im Shop. Was du testest, siehst du in ROAS, CTR und Conversion Rate – nicht in Quartalsberichten.
  • Führung mit Substanz: Du leitest ein Grafikteam, das Video und Statics in-house produziert, und gestaltest, wie dieses Team arbeitet, wächst und besser wird.
  • Kein Agentur-Ping-Pong: Research, Konzept, Briefing, Produktion, Test, Iteration – die gesamte Kette liegt bei uns im Haus. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit Performance, Shopify-Entwicklung und Creator-Management.
  • Eine Marke, die noch Spielraum hat: Wir sind groß genug für echte Budgets und klein genug, dass deine Handschrift Sichtbar wird.

DEINE AUFGABEN

Strategie & Konzeption

  • Du entwickelst die Content-Strategie für unsere Performance-Kanäle (insbesondere Meta) und unseren Onlineshop – von der übergeordneten Creative-Roadmap bis zum einzelnen Ad-Konzept.
  • Du konzipierst Angles, Hooks und Formate auf Basis von Zielgruppen-Insights, Awareness-Stufen und Wettbewerbsanalysen und baust daraus eine systematische Testing-Pipeline.
  • Du entwickelst und optimierst Landingpages und Funnel-Seiten konzeptionell – Aufbau, Argumentation,Einwandbehandlung – gemeinsam mit unserem Shopify Manager.
  • Du setzt die komplette content-gesteuerte Seite unserer Sales-Events auf: Dramaturgie, Creative-Konzepte, Landingpages, Timing über alle Kanäle hinweg.

Research & Positionierung

  • Du führst Produkt- und Zielgruppen-Research durch: Wer kauft, warum, mit welchen Einwänden – und wie sprechen wir diese Menschen an?
  • Du entwickelst die Positionierung unserer Produkte und entscheidest, an wen wir welches Produkt mit welchem Angle richten.
  • Du beobachtest Markt, Wettbewerb und Plattform-Trends und übersetzt sie in konkrete Content-Hypothesen.

Teamführung & Briefing

  • Du führst unser Grafikteam fachlich und disziplinarisch, setzt Prioritäten, gibst klares Feedback und entwickelst die Menschen in deinem Team weiter.
  • Du schreibst präzise Creative-Briefings – mit Zielgruppe, Angle, Hook, Referenzen und Erfolgskriterien – und sorgst für eine Produktion, die schnell, strukturiert und qualitativ hochwertig läuft.
  • Du koordinierst mit Creator-Management und Shooting-Planung, welcher Content produziert werden muss, damit deine Konzepte umsetzbar sind.

Analyse & Iteration

  • Du analysierst die Performance von Creatives und Landingpages gemeinsam mit dem Performance-Team und leitest daraus Learnings, Iterationen und neue Konzepte ab.
  • Du baust eine Wissensbasis auf: Was funktioniert bei welcher Zielgruppe, welche Hooks tragen, welche Formate skalieren.

Qualifikation

WAS DU MITBRINGST

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Scaling von Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta (und idealerweise TikTok, Google oder YouTube) – du hast Creatives konzipiert, die mit relevantem Budget profitabel gelaufen sind, und kannst darüber konkret sprechen.
  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein Team oder Kreativschaffende geführt, kennst den Unterschied zwischen Anweisung und Entwicklung und weißt, wie man ein Team gleichzeitig fordert und hält.
  • Tiefes Verständnis für Direct-Response-Prinzipien, Awareness-Stufen, Hook-Mechaniken und Funnel-Psychologie – du kannst erklären, warum ein Creative funktioniert, nicht nur dass es funktioniert.
  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption von Landingpages, Funnel-Seiten oder Sales-Events im E-Commerce / D2C.

title: Teamleider Logistiek Eindhoven
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een leidinggevende die energie krijgt van een dynamische logistieke omgeving en het werken in ploegendiensten, waaronder nachtdiensten? Als Teamleider Logistiek bij DPD in Oirschot zorg jij er samen met je team voor dat onze operatie dag en nacht soepel blijft draaien. Je coacht medewerkers, bewaakt de voortgang en denkt actief mee over verbeteringen. Geen dienst is hetzelfde en jouw leiderschap maakt iedere dag zichtbaar verschil. Daar staat een aantrekkelijk salaris, interessante ploegentoeslagen en volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen tegenover. Lees verder en ontdek of deze baan bij jou past.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je werkt samen met de Operations Manager en collega-teamleiders binnen ons depot in Oirschot. Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 35 medewerkers, bestaande uit vaste collega's en uitzendkrachten. Samen zorgen jullie voor een veilige, efficiënte en succesvolle operatie. Je werkt in een drieploegendienst:

  • 07:00 - 14:00 uur

  • 14:00 - 22:30 uur

  • 22:30 - 07:00 uur

Wat ga je doen?

Aan het begin van je dienst stem je de planning af en verdeel je de werkzaamheden. Tijdens de shift houd je overzicht, stuur je medewerkers aan en zorg je dat de operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt. Aan het einde van je dienst verzorg je een duidelijke overdracht.

Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Aansturen, coachen en motiveren van medewerkers.

  • Coördineren van de dagelijkse logistieke processen.

  • Bewaken van de planning, kwaliteit en productiviteit.

  • Monitoren van KPI's en doorvoeren van verbeteringen.

  • Signaleren en oplossen van operationele knelpunten.

  • Zorgen voor een veilige werkomgeving.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen €2.931,25 en €4.187,50 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een functie van 38,75 uur (1 fte) per week.

  • Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag):

    • 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur;

    • 45% tussen 00:00 uur en 06:00 uur;

    • 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen;

    • 100% op feestdagen.

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Veel extra's, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen.

  • Volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien binnen DPD.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting logistiek.

  • Ervaring in een logistieke omgeving en met het aansturen van medewerkers.

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse of Engelse taal.

  • Een proactieve, stressbestendige en coachende instelling.

  • Bereidheid om in een drieploegendienst te werken.

  • Ervaring met LEAN, uitzendkrachten of een 24/7-operatie is een pre.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer direct bij DPD door op de rode knop ‘solliciteren’ te klikken. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

Heb je eerder vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze corporate recruiter, Jordi Ernest via +31 6 29 10 50 26.

Klik hier voor meer informatie over ons sollicitatieproces.

title: Tech Lead AI Coding - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Pour participer à la redéfinition de ce que c'est que travailler avec l'IA

  • 5 ans d'avance sur le sujet : Theodo investit massivement sur l'IA appliquée au développement logiciel depuis 2020. Nous ne suivons pas la vague, nous la construisons.
  • Partenariats stratégiques avec Anthropic et Google : un accès direct aux dernières avancées des modèles, aux équipes produits, et aux best practices de l'écosystème.
  • Un positionnement hybride entre conseil et opérations : tu ne fais pas que des slides, tu ne fais pas que du code. Tu construis la stratégie ET tu la mets en œuvre, sur le terrain, avec les équipes du client.
  • Un terrain d'expérimentation unique : nos clients (grands groupes du CAC 40, scale-ups, secteurs régulés) font face à des défis concrets de transformation. Tu seras au cœur de la définition des nouveaux standards du métier.

Ta mission : transformer la façon dont les organisations construisent du logiciel

En tant que Consultant AI Coding, tu accompagnes nos clients dans leur transformation IA-native du delivery logiciel. Tu interviens à la croisée de la stratégie, de la tech et de la conduite du changement.

Ce que tu feras concrètement

1. Définir la feuille de route IA des organisations

  • Auditer la maturité IA de l'organisation (codebase, processus, knowledge management)
  • Construire des roadmaps de transformation alignées sur les enjeux business
  • Prioriser les chantiers d'impact (productivité, qualité, time-to-market)

2. Piloter la transformation des organisations

  • Accompagner les CTO, VP Engineering et Engineering Managers dans le changement
  • Co-construire les nouveaux modes de travail entre humains et agents
  • Lever les freins culturels, organisationnels et techniques

3. Développer la stack agentique

  • Concevoir et déployer des agents IA adaptés au contexte du client (codegen, code review, migration, testing, documentation)
  • Intégrer ces agents dans les chaînes CI/CD et les IDE des développeurs
  • Itérer sur la stack en fonction des retours terrain et des évolutions des modèles

4. Construire les compétences via Learning Expeditions, training et accompagnement RH

  • Organiser des learning expeditions pour les équipes de direction
  • Concevoir et animer des programmes de formation pour les développeurs
  • Travailler avec les RH sur l'évolution des fiches de poste, des grilles d'évaluation et des parcours de carrière à l'ère de l'IA

5. Mesurer l'impact via les bons metrics tech

  • Définir les KPIs de productivité, de qualité et d'adoption pertinents
  • Mettre en place les outils de mesure (dashboards, télémétrie IDE, analyse de code)
  • Démontrer le ROI de la transformation auprès des sponsors

6. Préparer l'agentic readiness des organisations

  • Codebase : refactoring, documentation, modularisation pour rendre le code "agent-friendly"
  • Process : adapter les workflows de delivery (revue, déploiement, gestion d'incident) à la collaboration humain-agent
  • Knowledge : structurer la base de connaissances pour qu'elle soit exploitable par des agents (specs, runbooks, ADRs)

Profil recherché

  • 5 ans minimum d'expérience en développement de logiciel
  • Diplôme d'ingénieur (ou équivalent grande école / Master en informatique)
  • Double expertise tech et consulting : tu sais coder, architecturer ET tu sais embarquer un COMEX, structurer une recommandation, conduire un atelier, naviguer dans les organisations complexes et porter des démarches de change management
  • Passion pour l'IA : tu testes les modèles, tu lis les papers, tu as déjà construit des choses avec Claude / Cursor / Claude Code, tu suis l'écosystème (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Mistral)
  • Excellente communication écrite et orale en français et en anglais (tu interviendras chez des clients internationaux)
  • Posture de transformation : tu es à l'aise pour challenger, tu sais écouter, tu portes des convictions

Ce qui fait la différence

  • Une expérience en ESN ou en cabinet de conseil : tu connais les codes du client, les rythmes d'intervention, les enjeux de delivery sous contrainte
  • Une expérience de la transformation à grande échelle dans un grand groupe
  • Une pratique régulière du développement (tu es resté connecté à la tech)
  • Une appétence pour la mesure et la donnée (KPIs, metrics, dashboards)
  • Une expérience du change management ou du coaching d'équipes tech

Le Partnership Theodo

Chez Theodo, les meilleurs talents ont vocation à devenir Partners du groupe. Le Partnership Theodo, c'est un modèle où ceux qui construisent l'entreprise en deviennent actionnaires et co-dirigeants. C'est un horizon concret, pas une promesse vague : plusieurs dizaines de Partners pilotent aujourd'hui les practices, les entités et les offres du groupe. Si tu veux à la fois faire le métier et construire la boîte, c'est ici que ça se passe.

Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Data & IA ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Technical Account Executive UK
descriptionHtml:
About EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. 

At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. 

We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. 

The role

Retailers and brands use EDITED's market data to make pricing, assortment and trading decisions. More of them now want that data inside their own systems, through our API and our MCP server, which lets their AI tools query EDITED directly. So the person evaluating us is often a Head of Data, an Engineering lead or an Ecommerce tech lead, as well as the commercial buyer.

We're hiring a Technical Account Executive to win those accounts. You'll report to our CRO and join a small new logo team.

This is a full-cycle, quota-carrying sales role. You find the opportunities, run them and close them. It isn't pre-sales or Sales Engineering. What makes it different is that you can hold your own with a technical buyer on the first call and still take a commercial deal all the way to signature.

You don't need to know retail yet. We'll teach you. You do need to know how to sell B2B SaaS and close.

What you'll do

  • Build and run outbound into target accounts, including technical people who ignore a standard commercial pitch

  • Run discovery with commercial and technical stakeholders to understand the problem they're solving and how our data would fit into their stack

  • Walk a prospect's Data or Engineering lead through how our API and MCP server work, and know when to bring in product for deeper questions

  • Write and present proposals that make the commercial case and the technical case in the same deal

  • Negotiate and close, working with legal, finance and P&E on contracts

  • Forecast your pipeline accurately and keep the CRM up to date

  • Build relationships with senior and technical decision-makers in each account

What you'll need

  • 4 + years in a full-cycle, quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales role, winning new logos yourself. Pre-sales, Sales Engineering or solutions consulting experience on its own isn't enough for this role.

  • A track record against quota you can talk through in numbers: targets, attainment, deal sizes and sales cycles

  • Experience closing deals of $200,000 + ACV with mid-market and enterprise organisations, with several stakeholders and a procurement process

  • Experience selling technical products, such as APIs, data platforms, analytics or BI tools, developer tools or AI/ML products

  • Confidence in technical conversations about integrations, APIs, data pipelines or agentic AI tooling. You don't need to write code. You do need to understand how the pieces connect and keep control of the conversation when the questions get specific.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You qualify hard, you know where a deal really stands, and you can explain why in a forecast call.

  • Clear writing and presenting for commercial and technical audiences

  • Willingness to travel

Nice to have

  • Experience selling to retailers, brands or ecommerce teams

  • Experience where Data, Engineering or Product teams were your main buyer

What We Offer You As A Technical Sales Executive

We value our team and to attract exceptional people, we offer an excellent package! This year, we were recognised as one of the top companies to work for in the UK.

  • At EDITED we are set up to work remotely and can also offer hybrid working via our London and Sofia offices

  • Enhanced parental leave policy

  • 25 days annual leave + public holidays (and an extra day for every year at EDITED)

  • Healthcare via SimplyHealth Cash Plan

  • You can utilise our flexible working policy to ensure you can work around your schedule

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

  • Access to an Employee Assistance Programme

  • Employee Referral Programme

  • Gifts for work anniversaries and big life events

  • Find out more here: https://edited.com/careers/

Apply now and don't miss the opportunity to join our journey to revolutionise the retail industry!

title: Technical Director, Fire Engineering

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. title: Technical Product Manager - Delivery & Availability Management (DAM)
descriptionHtml:
📍 Location: Flexible (UK)

🧩 Remit: Delivery & availability systems, monolith to domain-driven architecture, AI-native product work

🎯 Focus: Shape what our customers can buy, when it arrives and how it gets there, and untangle the monolith behind it.

About Product at Bloom & Wild 🌸

We're Europe's largest direct-to-consumer flower and gifting business (Bloom & Wild, bloomon and Bergamotte), now growing into cakes, candles and hampers. Our 16-strong Product team works in 8 squads, with fortnightly sprints and quarterly OKRs, across London, Amsterdam and fully remote. The Delivery & Availability (DAM) squad sits behind every order: it shapes what customers can buy, when it arrives and how it gets there.


The Role

You'll own the roadmap for our delivery and availability systems and guide a squad of 6 alongside a technical lead. Much of this lives in a large monolith that has grown with the business, and you'll help us untangle it: setting clear domain boundaries and making sure every change lands safely, especially around Christmas and Mother's Day. You'll work with Operations, Commercial and Logistics, and use AI to move faster.

Key Responsibilities

  • Roadmap Ownership: Own the DAM roadmap, balancing a cleaner domain-driven architecture with commercial value along the way.

title: Technical Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Technical Support Engineer

 

Location: London

Salary: Competitive

 

Join the Options Support Team in London!

Working for Options

 

Developing and engaging our people is a strategic priority for our business. We are looking for talented individuals to join our team and contribute to Options’ future growth and success. We want to hear from candidates that are motivated, self-driven and have a passion to learn and develop their skills in the world of financial technology.

 

Who are we?

 

Options is the largest global financial technology company headquartered in Belfast. We are at the forefront of banking and trading infrastructure, serving clients globally with offices in New York, Chicago, Toronto, London, Cambridge, Paris, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Singapore, and Auckland. At Options, our services are woven into the hottest trends in global tech, including high-performance Networking, Cloud, Security, and AI (Artificial Intelligence).

 

Why Options?

  

Global travel: We have offices in New York, Chicago, Toronto, Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo, Paris, London, Cambridge, Belfast and more.

 

Career Development: You will have access to professional skills development and technical training designed to help you grow throughout your career with us.

 

High-Performing, Autonomous Teams: Join a self-sufficient, successful team where your ideas can make a real impact.

 

Competitive Rewards: In addition to a competitive salary, we reward our employees with a range of bonus incentives and a comprehensive benefits package.

The Role

 

As an Options Technology Support Engineer, you will play a critical role in supporting our options trading operations and technology infrastructure. You will work closely with client’s technology team, and other technology professionals to ensure the smooth operation of our options trading platform.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment and contribute to the success of a global alternative investment firm. We are seeking a talented and motivated individuals to join our dynamic team in London. Please note as a graduate, placement, intern or apprentice you will be expected to work from the office on a full time basis for at least the first 12 months of your employment.

 

We’re looking for someone who has technical proficiency in:

 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Technical Expertise: desirable to have specifically strong knowledge of 365, Azure, Endpoint Management, Device Deployment. AV troubleshooting.

  • Experience: Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a similar role within the financial services industry, providing on-site technical support and troubleshooting.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to analyse complex technical issues, identify root causes, and propose effective solutions. Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills with the ability to handle high-pressure situations calmly.

  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey technical information clearly and concisely. Strong interpersonal skills to build relationships with clients and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Client Focus: Demonstrated ability to understand and fulfil client requirements while providing exceptional customer service. Proactive in anticipating client needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Adaptability and Flexibility: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Willingness to adapt to changing priorities and take on additional responsibilities as required.

 

Typical Job duties would include:

 

  • Technical Support: Serve as a technical point of contact for clients, providing remote or on-site support for all options trading technology systems.

  • System Monitoring and Maintenance: Monitor the health and performance of internal systems, ensuring that they are operating optimally. Conduct regular maintenance activities, including software updates and configuration changes, to keep systems up to date.

  • Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues. Escalate complex problems to appropriate internal teams and coordinate with them to find timely solutions.

  • Incident Management: Respond to incidents and service requests raised by the client, adhering to defined service level agreements (SLAs) and following established incident management processes. Document incidents and their resolutions accurately.

  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders, understanding their requirements and proactively addressing their concerns. Serve as a technical advisor to the client.

  • System Enhancements and Upgrades: Collaborate with the Options Technology development team to implement system enhancements and upgrades. Participate in testing and validation activities to ensure smooth deployment.

  • Training and Knowledge Sharing: Conduct training sessions for the client's technical staff to enhance their understanding of the options trading systems. Share technical knowledge and best practices with both internal teams and the client to foster continuous improvement.

 

We’re also looking for candidates with:

 

  • Strong research, writing and communication skills.

  • Exceptional organisational skills and strong attention to detail.

  • Desire to travel and see the world.

  • Ability to work independently and manage your own projects in a professional manner.

  • A passion for innovation and the financial technology sector.

  • Project management skills and proven ability to manage own workload.

 

What We Offer

We provide a competitive benefits package tailored to the technology and financial services sector:

Health & Wellness: Comprehensive healthcare support, risk benefits and digital wellness resources.

Family Support: Enhanced family leave benefits.

Professional Growth: Access to professional learning platforms and internal development programs.

Retirement: Pension/retirement schemes to support your long-term financial planning.

 

How to apply

 

Submit a CV and cover letter to the Technical Support Engineer role. On your CV, please include a section on your hobbies and interests and on the covering letter please detail the role you are applying to, along with your availability.

descriptionHtml:

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time.
