title: Thermal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role

We are looking for a skilled Thermal Engineer with experience in spacecraft thermal management at both the subsystem and spacecraft level.

You’ll work closely with a cross-functional team - including mechanical, propulsion, electronics, and mission planning - to ensure reliable thermal performance of our satellite throughout all mission phases: from launch to operation in orbit and end-of-life.

descriptionHtml:

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

Hands-on research

  • Run mixed-methods research in a B2B2C setting, combining qualitative studies with behavioural data in Mixpanel, that sets the standard for good research and shapes team roadmaps and client conversations

  • Research the whole chain, from client teams and subject matter experts to their end customers and the developers using our SDKs and APIs, and look for patterns that hold across clients so we build once and reuse

  • Make sure research has impact: track whether it changed a decision and what result followed, and use that to make the case for research investment

Research enablement and operations

  • Democratise research: coach and mentor colleagues in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own studies with rigour, through workshops, guidance and lightweight methods

  • Make insight easy to find and trust, through our insights agents, knowledge bases and journey management artefacts, backed by data you can rely on (quality, privacy, bias), so people can find and question evidence themselves

  • Help run research operations: improve how we recruit participants (frameworks, lead times, consent and data protection), and set clear guardrails so teams run ethical, compliant research

What will set you apart

title: Venture Scout
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Venture Scout to find companies worth our diligence, and to open relationships with investors who back private companies directly.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE
This role works across both sides of Pairs. It is for people who bring in deals on their own. You bring founders from your own network who are raising, learn what makes their companies worth an investor's time, and bring the strongest to Pairs.

Most of the work is first contact done well. You write to founders and investors in a way that earns a reply, turn those replies into calls, and bring the right ones into the network.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about direct investors, not fund LPs.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to the conversations, and to learning which companies and investors are ready.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team, on a process that already works. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

This is an early-career role. Drive and judgement matter more to us than years in a seat.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Company sourcing. Founders raising Series A and later, found early and brought to Pairs with the context our team needs.

  • First conversations. Messages that read like a person wrote them, and replies turned into calls.

  • Investor research. Who is investing right now, in what, at what stage and cheque size.

  • Your growing network. Every founder and investor you open, kept current and qualified. The network you build here is yours.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Already have an active network of founders you can bring to the table, built through an accelerator, a VC role, a startup community or your own work.

  • Can write a short, specific message to a stranger that gets a reply.

  • Keep your pace high without letting quality slip, and follow a process without needing a reminder.

  • Understand the basics of a round: stage, cheque size, SAFE versus priced, and why an investor passes.

  • Treat discretion as second nature. Please do not include any investor or company names in your application.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A fully remote, asynchronous role

  • Direct access to the co-founders and our investor team

  • Close collaboration with our internal team

  • Live mandates from your first week, and access to the opportunities that clear our diligence

  • Insight into our internal processes, including how we screen deal flow

  • Room to grow into a Venture Partner role as your network grows

  • A base salary plus commission

Compensation: $90K – $150K

Finton wurde 2023 von Jan, Julian und Neil gegründet und betreut Kunden in der gesamten DACH-Region von Hamburg, Köln und München aus. Mehr als 150 abgeschlossene Projekte sprechen für sich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Sparring und Transaktionen: Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit CFOs und Geschäftsführern, unterstützt bei Budgets, Finanzmodellen, Bewertungen und begleitest Transaktionen, Fundraisings und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitungen.

Das bringst Du mit

💼 About the role

PQShield is looking for a VP of Technical Marketing to make PQShield the technology and the brand the industry thinks of first for post-quantum security.

You will be the commercial team's technical voice in the market. You'll build the solutions and partnerships that help our sales team grow the pipeline, develop the semiconductor ecosystem around our IP, and lead technical thought leadership with customers, partners, standards bodies, and industry analysts.

Since NIST published its first post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, which the PQShield team co-authored, semiconductor companies, OEMs, and system builders across automotive, defense, industrial IoT, networking, and enterprise face a hard and urgent transition. This role puts PQShield at the center of that transition — through the partners who build with our IP, the solutions customers deploy, and the industry relationships that shape how the market moves.

This is a senior role for someone who combines a security IP background with deep industry relationships, and who knows how to turn both into revenue.

⚒️ What you’ll be doing

  • Build solutions that grow pipeline: Create reference solutions, joint offerings, and use-case packages that give sales clear, repeatable ways into accounts. Combine PQPlatform, PQPerform, PQCryptoLib, and PQMicroLib with partner technology into solutions customers can adopt quickly.

  • Develop the semiconductor ecosystem: Build and manage relationships with semiconductor suppliers, foundries, EDA and IP partners, processor and security-subsystem providers, and design services firms. Make PQShield IP the default choice for PQC in their roadmaps, reference designs, and platforms.

  • Drive partnerships that create demand: Identify, structure, and launch technical partnerships that open new markets and channels. Own the technical case for each partnership and ensure it produces pipeline, not just announcements.

  • Lead technical thought leadership: Be the senior technical voice of the commercial team. Speak at industry conferences, brief analysts and press, author white papers and technical articles, and represent PQShield in standards and industry forums.

  • Use industry relationships to build the brand: Leverage your network across semiconductors, security, and system OEMs to establish PQShield as the key technology and brand for post-quantum security.

  • Arm the commercial team technically: Give sales, FAEs, and partners the technical narratives, architectures, competitive positioning, and solution content they need to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals with engineers, architects, and executives.

  • Shape the market narrative: Define how the industry thinks about the post-quantum transition, cryptographic agility, side-channel and fault-injection protection, and certification (FIPS 140-3, SESIP, Common Criteria, ISO 26262) — and where PQShield fits.

  • Lead technical launches: Plan and deliver the technical go-to-market for new products, certifications, reference designs, and partner integrations.

  • Bring the market back in: Feed customer, partner, and competitive insight into product and engineering so our roadmap stays ahead of where the market is heading.

  • Solutions: Launch 3 solution packages that combine PQShield products with partner technology for priority use cases, each with a reference architecture, a solution brief and a demo.

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications

We're looking for a senior technical marketing leader with a security IP background, a strong industry network, and a track record of turning partnerships and technical credibility into revenue.

  • 12+ years in semiconductor IP, security, or embedded technology, with at least 5 years in technical marketing, solutions, business development, or ecosystem leadership roles.

  • A background in security IP — for example, hardware security modules, root of trust, secure enclaves, cryptographic accelerators, or embedded security software.

  • Established relationships across semiconductor suppliers, IP and EDA vendors, system OEMs, and the security industry that you can use to open doors and build PQShield's position.

  • A proven record of building ecosystem programs and partnerships that measurably grew pipeline and revenue.

  • Credibility as a technical thought leader: experience speaking at industry events, writing for technical audiences, and engaging analysts, press, and standards bodies.

  • Ability to work in depth with cryptographers and engineers, and to explain complex security technology to engineers, architects, CISOs, CTOs, and business executives.

  • A strong commercial mindset: you measure success by pipeline, design wins, and revenue.

  • Experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in semiconductor or OEM markets.

  • Comfortable building in a fast-moving company where the market narrative is still being written.

Strong advantages

  • Experience at Arm, or in the Arm ecosystem.

  • Knowledge of cryptography, post-quantum cryptography, side-channel and fault-injection countermeasures, or security certifications such as FIPS 140-3, SESIP, or Common Criteria.

  • Familiarity with functional safety standards such as ISO 26262, or with automotive, defense, or industrial IoT markets.

  • Travel for customer meetings and marketing events as needed.

  • …and other great benefits.

If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value the security of our daily digital lives, and love solving hard problems - then we’d love to hear from you.

title: Website Product Manager - Growth
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Join us as a Website Product Manager to own conversion strategy on qonto.com, the primary acquisition engine for 600,000+ businesses across 8 European markets.

You will report to Sarah, our Lead Website PM. This is a hands-on product role inside a dedicated feature squad — you'll work daily with Growth Engineers and Designers, not just coordinate from a distance.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own a section of qonto.com end-to-end: You'll be responsible for a defined part of the website — from identifying conversion problems to shipping the fixes. That means defining the strategy, running the sprints, and tracking the impact.

  • Run a continuous experimentation cycle: Set up and analyse A/B tests using tools like AB Tasty or VWO, draw conclusions from GA4 and Contentsquare data, and iterate fast. You'll be expected to have tests running at all times.

  • Align cross-functional stakeholders: You'll work weekly with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Legal, and the French market. Getting alignment without authority is part of the job.

  • Promote Qonto's products on the website: Work with product teams to translate new features into compelling, conversion-optimised website experiences — landing pages, navigation flows, upsell surfaces.

  • Benchmark and bring new ideas: Regularly analyse competitor websites and best-in-class B2B SaaS sites to identify opportunities Qonto hasn't tried yet.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • 3-4 years of PM experience: You've shipped features end-to-end and can show the before/after on a metric. B2B SaaS or growth-focused product experience is a strong plus.

  • Hands-on with web analytics and CRO tools: You've used GA4, Contentsquare, Hotjar, or equivalent. You can pull your own data, spot patterns, and build a hypothesis without waiting for an analyst.

  • A/B testing methodology: You know how to size a test, define a success metric, and avoid common pitfalls (peeking, underpowered tests). You've run tests that failed and learned from them.

  • Clear communicator across functions: You can write a crisp brief for a designer, explain a prioritisation call to a sceptical stakeholder, and present results to a non-technical audience.

  • Working language: English and French fluency is required. Italian, Spanish, German or Dutch is a genuine plus given our 8-market scope.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A website that is actually the product: At Qonto, qonto.com is not a marketing brochure — it's the #1 source of new customers. The PM who owns conversion has direct revenue impact, which means your work gets attention and resources.

  • A real feature team: You'll work in a squad with dedicated Growth Engineers and Designers — daily standups, weekly sprints, shared OKRs. You're not a lone PM throwing specs over a wall.

  • 8 markets, real complexity: The website serves France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal, and Austria — with different regulatory contexts, languages, and user behaviours. That's a genuine product challenge, not a copy-paste localisation exercise.

  • A test-and-learn culture with senior support: Bamby brings nearly 20 years of product and growth leadership. You'll get autonomy on execution and direct access to someone who has built products at scale — a combination that's harder to find than it sounds.

➡️ Your future manager

You’ll report to Sarah, Lead Product Manager for our Website. Sarah joined Qonto in 2021 as a Senior Product Manager and stepped up as interim Head of Website in 2023. Before Qonto, she built digital products at Sodexo and BNP Paribas.

Wir erwarten nicht, dass du bereits fertige:r Entwicklungsingenieur:in bist. Wir suchen eine Person mit guten technischen Grundlagen, Lernwillen und Sorgfalt, die an echter Produktentwicklung wachsen möchte.

Ecalia ist ein Deep-Tech-Startup aus Stuttgart. Wir entwickeln Scroll-Kompressor-Expander-Systeme, die Heiz- und Kühlsysteme deutlich effizienter machen sollen. Dafür verbinden wir Physik, Maschinenbau, Versuche und KI-gestützte Entwicklungsarbeit. Wir arbeiten am Institut für Kunststofftechnik der Universität Stuttgart direkt an unseren Prototypen und Testanlagen.

Umfang: min. 15 Std./ Woche, vor Ort in Stuttgart-Süd

Aufgaben

Du steigst nicht mit der Verantwortung für ein ganzes Kompressorsystem ein. Gemeinsam wählen wir einen Schwerpunkt, der zu deinen Vorkenntnissen passt, und schneiden daraus klare Entwicklungspakete.

Das kann konkret heißen:

  • Technische Fragestellungen bearbeiten: Anforderungen verstehen, Annahmen festhalten, Lösungswege vergleichen und Ergebnisse plausibilisieren.

  • Berechnungen und Parameterstudien durchführen: Kleine Auslegungen oder physikalische Modelle mit Handrechnung, Python oder geeigneten Simulationstools bearbeiten.

  • In CAD mitentwickeln: Bauteile oder Baugruppen modellieren und unter Review fertigungsgerecht verbessern, beispielsweise mit Autodesk Inventor.

  • Versuche vorbereiten und Daten auswerten: Messpläne, Datensätze und Versuchsergebnisse strukturiert bearbeiten und daraus nächste Schritte ableiten.

  • KI als Ingenieurwerkzeug einsetzen: Für Recherche, Berechnung, Code und Dokumentation — mit kritischer Prüfung statt blindem Übernehmen.

  • Nachvollziehbar dokumentieren: Annahmen, Entscheidungen und Ergebnisse so ablegen, dass andere im Team damit weiterarbeiten können.

  • In Werkstatt und Prüfstand dazulernen: Verstehen, wie aus einer Berechnung ein reales Bauteil wird und welche Rückmeldung die Praxis an das Design gibt.

Du wirst dabei von unserem CTO und unserem Prototypenbau-Ingenieur begleitet. Mit wachsender Sicherheit kann auch die Eigenständigkeit deiner Aufgaben wachsen.

Qualifikation

Das brauchst du

  • Du studierst Maschinenbau, Energietechnik, Physik, Mechatronik oder ein vergleichbares technisches Fach.

  • Du verstehst technische und physikalische Grundlagen und willst wissen, warum eine Lösung funktioniert — nicht nur, welches Ergebnis ein Tool ausgibt.

title: Wirtschaftsprüfer als M&A-Berater (a)
descriptionHtml:
Beraten Sie Mandate im Umfeld von erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen!

Als Teil eines interdisziplinären Teams aus Wirtschafts- und Finanzberatern, Rechtsanwälten und Steuerberatern beraten Sie insb. Familienunternehmen, Vermögensverwalter und Beteiligungsgesellschaften (Family Offices, Private Equity) zu notwendigen Transaktionen und wirtschaftlichen Opportunitäten. Sie sind daher nicht bloß als unparteiischer Amtsträger sondern insb. als Parteienvertreter tätig und übernehmen umfassende umfassende Mandatsverantwortung, von der konzeptionellen Vorbereitung bis zur praktischen Umsetzung. Apropos Umsetzung: Aufgrund des integrierten Beratungsansatzes sind Sie nicht "Zulieferer" für externe Auftraggeber, sondern bringen Ihre Kenntnisse allenfalls intern, an der Schnittstelle zur Finanz-, Rechts- und Steuerberatung ein.

Die Position eignet sich für Sie, wenn Sie gerne methodisch frei an wertschöpfenden Mandaten arbeiten möchten.

Aufgaben

  • Beraten von (oft inhabergeführten) Unternehmen bzw. deren Mehrheitsgesellschaftern (oft Familienunternehmern), Beteiligungsgesellschaften und Vermögensverwaltern (oft Family Offices) sowie involvierter Erben

  • Beraten zu Unternehmensübernahmen, Spaltungen („carve out“), Verschmelzungen, Beteiligungen und Ausschlüssen („squeeze-out“), oft im Rahmen von Unternehmensnachfolgen, Umstrukturierungen, strategischen Beteiligungen und Erbschaften

  • Bewerten von Unternehmen, Teilwerten, Anlagevermögen, Sacheinlagen, Barabfindungen und Besteuerungsgrundlagen

  • Durchführen von finanziellen und steuerlichen Risikoprüfungen (financial, tax due diligence)

  • Begleiten von durch Dritte erstellte Bewertungen

  • keine Buch- und Berichtsprüfung

Anforderungen

  • Bestellung zur Wirtschaftsprüfung

  • Sichere Kenntnisse relevanter Normen und Verfahren insb. HGB, AktG, BewG, IDW S, Multiplikatoren, IFRS

  • Interesse an direkter Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmern, Rechts- und Steuerberatern

  • Kenntnisse von Datenanalysesoftware

  • Englischkenntnisse

  • idealerweise (keine Voraussetzung) erste Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement z. B. durch Tätigkeit im Bereich Corporate Finance/Transaktionsberatung/Transaction Advisory/Services

Angebot

  • abwechslungsreiche, unternehmerische Mandate

  • keine Buch- und Berichtsprüfung

  • kollegiale und vertrauensvolle Arbeitsatmosphäre

  • überschaubare Teamgröße

  • interdisziplinäres Team

  • eigenverantwortliche Tätigkeit mit Raum zur Weiterentwicklung

  • strukturierte und individuelle Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • moderne Ausstattung

  • Büro im Herzen der Stadt

  • Unbefristete Anstellung in Vollzeit

Wir behandeln Bewerbungen aller (a) Personen gleich.

Vincent Schwerd freut sich auf eine unverbindliche und vertrauliche Kontaktaufnahme. Weitere (Kontakt-) Informationen erhalten Sie auf unserer Website, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn und Xing.
